review.reason: Frames own the layers placed inside them (frame-parenting), moving a frame moves its contents, and pages provide document-level organisation; the unticked bullet about auto-arranging artboards in a grid is a convenience beyond those concrete items.
review.varveAssessment: Frame parenting and page organisation.

title: Allow ending paths and splines on mobile devices

review.reason: Ending a path without a keyboard depends on touch affordances; Varve's inputPolicy separates navigation and drawing contacts, but the packet gives no evidence about how a touch user terminates a pen path.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool termination on touch input (inputPolicy).

title: Allow moving objects on mobile devices

review.reason: Whether a one-finger drag moves the selection or deselects on touch depends on Varve's pointer-input policy for touch contacts, which the packet does not establish.
review.varveAssessment: Touch selection dragging in SelectTool/inputPolicy.

title: Allow zooming with two fingers on touchpads and mobile devices

review.reason: inputPolicy assigns touch contacts a navigation role, including post-pinch contact ownership, and wheel/pinch normalisation feeds camera zoom.
review.varveAssessment: Camera zoom input path (inputPolicy/inputNormalizer).

title: Using the text tool on firefox for android zooms page in

review.reason: The report is a browser-specific zoom-on-focus behaviour tied to in-page text entry; whether Varve's text editing reproduces it on Firefox for Android cannot be determined from the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Text tool mobile input path (TextTool).

title: Adding points to shapes with the Path Tool

review.reason: NodeEditTool inserts a point into a segment (insertPointOnPath) and deletes selected anchors with dissolve semantics.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool point insertion/deletion.

title: Pixel-based color sampling for the Eyedropper tool

review.reason: EyedropperTool samples rendered artwork through artworkSampling, and a separate pixelProbe tool reports exact pixel values, rather than reading a shape's fill colour.
review.varveAssessment: EyedropperTool/artworkSampling and the pixel probe.

title: Add a shortcut to pick a random color

review.reason: There is no random-colour command in Varve's action registry or shortcut map, so the primary colour cannot be randomised from the keyboard.
review.varveAssessment: ActionRegistry/ShortcutManager colour commands.

title: Improve the snapping system

review.reason: snapping.ts already builds candidate sets with rough filtering, excludes self/ancestor/descendant candidates, ranks by distance and emits snap indicators.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping system (tools/snapping.ts).

title: Rotation of layer with a gradient does not rotate the gradient line also

review.reason: A node's gradient geometry is stored in the node's local space (gradientHandleGeometry), so rotating the object rotates the gradient with it.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient geometry/transform handling.

title: Add support for radial gradients

review.reason: Varve supports linear, radial and conic gradients, editable in the Inspector's GradientEditor and on canvas via GradientHandleOverlay.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient paint types.

title: Move the menu bar entry definitions to the backend

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's Rust-side layout-definition/menu message system and its backend action API. Varve's menubar is defined in TypeScript from the action registry, so there is no backend menu definition to port.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Undoing while drawing with pen causes app to panic and freeze

review.reason: Undo while a pen gesture is in flight is a tool-state/undo-interaction case; Varve commits completed document transactions, but the packet provides no evidence that a mid-gesture undo is safely aborted rather than leaving the tool holding a removed node.
review.varveAssessment: Undo/history interaction with the pen tool.

title: Undoing during freehand line results in editing previous undo state

review.reason: Same undo-during-active-tool class as #558; Varve's history records completed transactions, but whether an in-flight freehand stroke is cancelled (instead of merging into the previous revision) is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Undo/history interaction with the pencil/freehand tool.

title: Migrate/upgrade to Vue CLI 5

review.reason: A Graphite build-tooling upgrade to Vue CLI 5; Varve is React with Vite and pnpm and has no Vue toolchain.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Export clean SVGs with user-specified metadata

review.reason: Varve's scene model and SVG exporter carry no per-node id/class/style metadata, so exported markup cannot be given user-chosen identifiers or clean animation attributes.
review.varveAssessment: SVG export and a potential Inspector 'SVG metadata' section.

title: The editor sometimes panics without displaying a crash dialog

review.reason: @varve/crash provides privacy-first crash reporting and recovery, and the editor mounts error boundaries, so a failure surfaces instead of silently blanking the app.
review.varveAssessment: Crash handling (@varve/crash, error boundaries).

title: Editor GUI keyboard navigation

review.reason: Varve's UI follows APG keyboard contracts: shared dialog focus containment, FloatingPortal initialFocus/yieldTabToAnchor, and keyboard-operable custom Select/dropdown components.
review.varveAssessment: Accessibility contracts in @varve/ui.

title: Closing shapes with the Pen tool

review.reason: The pen tool closes a path when the first anchor is clicked again, producing a closed shape.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool path closing.

title: Add stroke properties for dashed lines

review.reason: Stroke styling already carries dashArray/dashOffset from the scene model into the render IR, with stroke controls in the Inspector.
review.varveAssessment: Stroke paint properties.

title: Add stroke properties for line corner styling

review.reason: Stroke cap and join/miter options exist in the stroke style model (lineCap in the strokeStyle token codec, join/miter handling in path offsetting).
review.varveAssessment: Stroke paint properties.

title: Frontend for the node graph

review.reason: This is the node-graph panel frontend: nodes, ports, flow/composite link curves and graph panning. Varve has no node graph and is not building one.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Release Linux builds through common app stores via Flatpak/AppImage/Snap/Nix packages

review.reason: Varve ships Linux AppImage plus .deb/.rpm through its release pipeline and records the channel decisions in docs/release/distribution-decision-matrix.md, where Flathub is deferred and Snap is deliberately rejected.
review.varveAssessment: Release/packaging pipeline; no work implied beyond the already-sequenced Flathub step.

title: Real-world units of measure

review.reason: Varve has a document unit model with exact metric/imperial conversion (units.ts: convertDocumentUnit, physicalToPx, pxToPt/cm/mm) keyed off a document DPI/PPI factor.
review.varveAssessment: Document units and ruler/input display.

title: Allow line weights to be floats

review.reason: Stroke width is a floating-point number in Varve's paint model, not a hashed integer widget value.
review.varveAssessment: Stroke width property.

title: Shift key should constrain aspect ratio for transform cage

review.reason: ScaleTool and FloatingTransformTool constrain scaling to the initial aspect ratio while Shift is held.
review.varveAssessment: Scale/transform cage constraining.

title: Make a manually-run test to generate a saved document with full feature coverage

review.reason: Graphite-internal test tooling: a developer-run test that rewrites a committed .graphite fixture to maximise serialized-feature coverage. Varve covers document-format changes through versioned schema migrations rather than that manual workflow.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Properties for naming and location/dimensions of artboards

review.reason: The maintainer marked this a duplicate of #538; the substantive content (naming and position/dimension properties for artboards) is the same frame-properties request.
review.varveAssessment: Frame/page Inspector properties; tracked by #538.

title: Move menu bar over to the new internal layout definition system

review.reason: The maintainer marked this a duplicate of #556; both ask to move menubar definitions into Graphite's internal layout-definition system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected; Varve menus are TypeScript action definitions.

title: Improve usage of history states throughout the application

review.reason: Every document mutation commits as an explicit transaction into Varve's persistent revision store, and undo restores the selection journal recorded at that revision, so history coverage is systemic rather than per-feature.
review.varveAssessment: History/undo infrastructure (editorHistorySession, revision store).

title: Preview fonts

review.reason: FontBrowser renders each family in its own face using fontPreview, so fonts can be compared without selecting them first.
review.varveAssessment: FontBrowser previews.

title: Properties panel doesn't go blank after clicking in Layer Tree panel to deselect, requires a second click to blank it

review.reason: inputPolicy/inputNormalizer restrict tool pointer input to the canvas, so drags in panel gutters or the title bar cannot operate a tool; the Inspector renders from the current selection, so deselecting blanks it immediately.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas input routing and Inspector selection state.

title: Hide popups triggered by hovering after moving the cursor away

review.reason: Varve's Popover and OverlayRegistry own open/close, Escape handling and light-dismiss for every floating surface, so a hover-opened panel cannot linger once the pointer leaves.
review.varveAssessment: Popover/OverlayRegistry dismissal.

title: Select tool should display the vector outline on hover

review.reason: The packet gives no evidence about Varve's hover highlighting for selectable shapes or its hit tolerance on unfilled paths, so whether an equivalent affordance exists is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Select tool hover feedback and hit-testing tolerance.

title: Convert shape's stroke into a filled shape

review.reason: Varve converts a stroke into a filled path through path offsetting/outline stroke in the engine, exposed as an editor action; the Graphite issue was itself marked duplicate of #1092.
review.varveAssessment: Outline-stroke action and engine pathOffset.

title: Improve the color picker floating menu

review.reason: InspectorColorPopover and GradientEditor provide hex/RGBA entry, alpha, a none/transparent state and gradient stop editing in the colour popover.
review.varveAssessment: Colour picker popover.

title: Make floating menus not switch to nearby widgets on hover except when they are sibling widgets

review.reason: Varve never transfers an open floating surface to a neighbouring widget on hover; each Popover is anchored to its own trigger via FloatingPortal/OverlayRegistry.
review.varveAssessment: Popover anchoring behaviour.

title: Refactor internal shape format to remove reliance on Kurbo

review.reason: A Graphite-internal Rust refactor of its Kurbo-based shape representation; Varve's scene and bezier geometry is its own TypeScript implementation plus native crates.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Viewport culling

review.reason: The render path classifies visibility with an explicit 'culled' residency state and redraws only dirty regions, so offscreen content is not replayed each frame.
review.varveAssessment: Render pipeline residency/dirty-rect redraw.

title: Preserve order on copy and paste

review.reason: Copy/paste clones through an id map that preserves the original sibling order, and paste reinserts the group at the target container's paint order.
review.varveAssessment: Clipboard clone/order (clipboard.ts).

title: Overflow on polygon with 256 sides

review.reason: Polygon side count is a plain numeric property in Varve with no 8-bit arithmetic, so a 256-sided polygon cannot overflow during construction.
review.varveAssessment: Polygon/star shape creation.

title: Stuck overlays in pen tool when layer deleted

review.reason: Whether Varve's pen/node-edit overlays clear when the edited node is deleted mid-gesture cannot be established from the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool overlay lifecycle on node deletion.

title: Fix Vue warning when displaying a transparent ColorInput

review.reason: A Vue prop-type warning in ColorInput.vue; Varve has no Vue components, so the warning cannot occur.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Sculpting / molding segments with the Path tool

review.reason: NodeEditTool bends a dragged path segment (bendPathSegment in nodeEditGeometry), which is the molding behaviour described here.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool segment bending.

title: Remove overlay ownership from VectorShape / VectorPoint

review.reason: A Graphite-internal Rust refactor removing overlay ownership from VectorShape/VectorPoint, closed in favour of #605; Varve's overlays are React canvas components.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Cannot paste into properties or editing text field

review.reason: ShortcutManager ignores key events whose target is an input, textarea or contenteditable element, so clipboard shortcuts reach the focused field instead of the editor.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut event routing (ShortcutManager).

title: Crash on Close All Documents

review.reason: All close/quit requests converge on the LifecycleCoordinator (close-document, close-window, quit-application), which inspects every session's dirty state before committing, so a Close All cannot race tool cleanup.
review.varveAssessment: Lifecycle/termination handling.

title: Importing editable SVGs

review.reason: @varve/import parses SVG into native scene nodes (paths, groups, fills, transforms) instead of importing it as an opaque image.
review.varveAssessment: SVG import parser in @varve/import.

title: Export as PNG/JPG

review.reason: The export pipeline renders PNG/JPG (alongside SVG/PDF) at a chosen scale from the render IR, with an export dialog.
review.varveAssessment: Bitmap export path.

title: Migrate dialog creation and content layouts to Rust

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's Rust dialog/layout-definition system; Varve dialogs are React components and it has no backend-defined layouts.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Snapping system is not precise

review.reason: Sticky snapping resolves to exact candidate coordinates in snapping.ts, so a snapped point lands on the target rather than preserving the original grab offset.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping precision.

title: Omit displaying anchor/handle's snapping candidate point for the dragged point

review.reason: snapping.ts excludes the dragged node's own candidates (excludedIds plus self/ancestor/descendant exclusion), so a point never snaps to its own former position.
review.varveAssessment: Snap candidate filtering.

title: Drag vector handle onto its anchor should hide them and make the anchor sharp

review.reason: Varve's node editing exposes corner/smooth handles, but the packet gives no evidence on whether dragging a handle onto its anchor collapses it and flips the node to corner.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool handle collapsing / node sharpness.

title: Snapping to vector edges/curves

review.reason: Snap target collection includes finite layout segments and edge/centre lines (targetFeature 'segment' and 'edge' in snapping.ts), not just points.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping targets.

title: Improve FloatingMenu CSS so it stays with its parent scroll

review.reason: Floating UI's autoUpdate recomputes popover position on scroll and resize through FloatingPortal, so panels are not left behind when their parent scrolls.
review.varveAssessment: Popover positioning.

title: Switch from Vue to Svelte

review.reason: A framework migration from Vue to Svelte; Varve is a React application by design, so the migration has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Prototype the packaging of Graphite into Tauri

review.reason: Varve is already a Tauri 2 desktop app with the native Rust engine behind the same facade as the web build.
review.varveAssessment: Desktop packaging (apps/desktop, src-tauri).

title: Node graph frontend with stand-in data

review.reason: A node-graph frontend prototype with stand-in data; Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Boolean operations where shapes do not intersect

review.reason: Varve computes boolean operations (union/subtract/intersect/exclude) geometrically, and the result does not depend on the operands overlapping.
review.varveAssessment: Boolean operations module.

title: Viewport zoom/rotation while snapping doesn't show the snapped values

review.reason: Varve's zoom/rotation readouts derive from the live camera transform, and the camera does not snap zoom or rotation, so a displayed value cannot diverge from what is rendered.
review.varveAssessment: Camera/status-bar readouts.

title: Crash when Properties panel changes before input widget is sent to backend

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's backend-owned input widgets and widget-ID message ordering. Varve's Inspector controls are client-side React and submit values through editor operations, so a disposed widget cannot receive a late update.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Move Document Mode, Layer Tree panel's options bar, and tool shelf buttons from Vue to Rust

review.reason: Moving Vue-defined panel layouts into Graphite's Rust layout-definition system; Varve has no Rust-defined layouts.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: [Crash Report] Crash on undo Boolean operation

review.reason: Varve's history session keeps a selection journal keyed by revision and restores it on undo, so undoing a boolean operation cannot leave the selection pointing at removed nodes.
review.varveAssessment: History selection restoration (editorHistorySession).

title: Refactor the fragile way floating menus measure themselves and handle opening/closing

review.reason: Popover placement and measuring are delegated to Floating UI plus FloatingPortal rather than hand-measured offsets, so there is no fragile open/close measurement code to refactor.
review.varveAssessment: Popover/FloatingPortal implementation.

title: Clean up frontend folder structure and naming conventions of TypeScript files

review.reason: A Graphite-internal frontend file and naming cleanup with no behavioural requirement.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Refactor MenuList so its entries don't use the ref property

review.reason: Depends on Vue's ref-augmented MenuListEntry type and the :ref callback hack. Varve's menubar is a React component over action definitions with no ref passing between menu entries.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Move font loading from per-document to global on the editor

review.reason: Fonts are owned by the engine font registry and cached for the application (restoreStoredFonts), with documents referencing fonts rather than embedding them per document.
review.varveAssessment: Font registry/loading.

title: Move initialization from api.rs to the Editor backend

review.reason: Moving api.rs initialization calls into a single backend Editor message; Varve has no Rust api.rs/frontend message bootstrap.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Support multiple panel instances and documents at once

review.reason: The work is a refactor of Graphite's monolithic `document_message_handler.rs` and per-panel Svelte message subscriptions so viewport settings live on each panel instance. Varve has no equivalent message-bus/panel-handler architecture (React contexts, one canvas per session), so there is no subsystem to restructure.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve panel or render path is affected; multiple views of one document would be a new feature, not this refactor.

title: Remove direct DOM manipulation from Vue codebase wherever possible

review.reason: Framework-specific cleanup for Graphite's Vue components, which set inline styles through `ref`s and `querySelector`/`closest`. Varve's UI is React with component state and stylesheets, so the Vue DOM-ref idiom does not exist here.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve's React UI is affected.

title: Fix Interacting in GUI with text tool

review.reason: Graphite sent mouse-down messages whenever the mouse-button bitflags changed, so clicking in panels re-entered the canvas tool. Varve binds pointer handlers to the canvas element and starts text editing only from canvas hit-testing or the explicit `startTextEditing` action, so panel clicks cannot spawn text nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas input routing and text-tool entry (`inputPipeline.ts`, `TextEditOverlay`).

title: Move "About Graphite" dialog build metadata acquisition from Webpack to Rust

review.reason: Moves Graphite's About-dialog build-metadata acquisition from a Webpack define into its Rust backend. Varve builds with Vite/pnpm and has neither the Webpack metadata injection nor Graphite's Rust frontend-message plumbing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve build script or About dialog is affected.

title: Nudging layers isn't working

review.reason: Arrow-key nudging exists as `commands/nudge.ts` (`planNudge`/`planNudgeRepeat`) driven by `CanvasNudgeController`, with configurable small/big steps and one undo entry per held-key gesture.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and its shortcut path.

title: Graphite IndexedDb error: DOMException: A mutation operation was attempted on a database that did not allow mutations.

review.reason: The failure is Firefox's IndexedDB bug plus a missing startup message; the packet's ask is to degrade gracefully and tell the user. Varve's `RecoveryManager` keeps the session usable when a privacy policy blocks IndexedDB, and `@varve/crash` owns crash and recovery reporting.
review.varveAssessment: Persistence fallbacks in `packages/editor/src/recovery.ts` and the crash layer.

title: Implement the File > Import menu

review.reason: Varve ships a File > Import entry (`menu.file.import`) backed by the `@varve/import` parsers for SVG/PDF/PSD/AI/EPS/Sketch/bitmap, with an import report rather than a silent paste.
review.varveAssessment: Import menu entry and parser pipeline.

title: Hover outline doesn't pan with document

review.reason: Varve requires every overlay drawn over artwork to use the renderer's camera transform (`screenToWorld`/`worldToScreen`), so hover and selection outlines pan with the document instead of staying viewport-fixed.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and guide overlay transforms.

title: Implement the Edit > Paste menu

review.reason: Copy and paste are shared editor commands: workspace invariant 6 makes them identical in every workspace, and the Edit menu exposes them through the same action registry as the shortcuts.
review.varveAssessment: Edit menu and shared clipboard commands.

title: Exporting bitmap images does not appear to work

review.reason: The report shows two defects: a downloaded SVG with an unbound `xlink:` prefix and a `blob:` image href, plus raster export that silently did nothing. The packet does not show how Varve's SVG and bitmap export embed image data, so applicability is unconfirmed.
review.varveAssessment: Export path would need checking for embedded-image references in SVG and raster output.

title: [Crash Report] Switching documents with different layer selections causes crash

review.reason: Varve keeps document, selection, viewport and dirty state per session in `state.sessions[]`, so switching documents swaps the whole session instead of reusing another document's selection.
review.varveAssessment: Session and document switching state.

title: Provide a way for multiple systems to subscribe to message broadcasts

review.reason: Asks for a broadcast subscription system in Graphite's backend dispatcher so events such as `DocumentIsDirty` reach multiple subscribers. Varve has no dispatcher or broadcast layer; consumers subscribe to React context state.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Export dialog option to set background color

review.reason: An export-dialog background choice with format-specific rules (transparent unsupported for JPG, a painted rectangle for SVG), closed in Graphite as low value once artboards had background colours. The packet does not describe Varve's export background options.
review.varveAssessment: Export dialog options and background emission for raster/SVG output.

title: Points/segments/shapes vector selection mode

review.reason: `NodeEditTool` treats anchors, handles and segments as distinct hit kinds with additive multi-select over `selectedAnchors`, covering point- and segment-level selection; whole-object selection stays with the Select tool.
review.varveAssessment: Path node-editing selection model.

title: Fix broken keyboard shortcuts

review.reason: Bindings live in the shortcut registry (`ShortcutManager` plus `registerEditorActions`) and File > Open (`menu.file.open`) is registered there rather than hard-coded per menu entry.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut registry and File menu binding.

title: Reduce message spam to the Layer Tree's options bar widgets

review.reason: About re-sending the Rust-built widget layout for the Layer Tree options bar on every viewport click or drag frame in Graphite's layout transport. Varve's panels are React components reading editor state directly; no widget layout is serialized per frame.
review.varveAssessment: None; Varve has no Rust-to-JS widget-layout transport.

title: Modifying the transform of a zero-area layer causes a crash

review.reason: The crash came from dividing by a zero-area bounding box when scaling or rotating. Varve clamps width and height in the Inspector (`PositionSizeSection`) to a 1px minimum, so a zero-area scale or NaN rotation is not reachable from the properties panel.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size fields and transform planning.

title: Update text live as it's typed in the Text node's properties panel field

review.reason: Text edits run through the text edit session and overlay, which re-shape and re-layout on each change and coalesce history entries, so the canvas reflects typing live instead of waiting for a commit.
review.varveAssessment: Text editing session, overlay and Inspector text field.

title: Nudge selected artboards with arrow keys

review.reason: Nudge plans operate on the current node selection, and frames and pages are ordinary nodes, so nudging a selected artboard moves the artboard rather than the artwork inside it.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and its selection scope.

title: Disable mouse stray when dragging on color picker overlay

review.reason: Varve's popover contract dismisses on an outside press or Escape through `OverlayRegistry`; pointer travel away from the trigger does not close the picker, so dragging inside a colour picker cannot dismiss it.
review.varveAssessment: Popover and colour-picker dismissal.

title: Zero-area artboards are confusing and impossible to deal with

review.reason: The packet's fix is a 1px minimum on artboard dimensions plus a way to find artboards. Varve clamps W/H in the Inspector and lists pages in the Pages panel, so an invisible zero-area page cannot become unselectable.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size clamp and Pages panel.

title: Alter behavior of dragging unselected layers through selected layers

review.reason: Varve hit-tests on pointer-down and selects the topmost node under the pointer, then only starts a move for nodes in the current selection, so an unselected occluding layer is selected and dragged instead of the selected layer behind it.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas hit-testing and Select tool drag start.

title: Layer selection history

review.reason: Feature request to page through selection history with the Forward/Backward mouse buttons. The packet gives no evidence that Varve records selection history or maps mouse buttons 4 and 5.
review.varveAssessment: Selection state and input pipeline would need history tracking.

title: Process messages in a stack-based order

review.reason: Proposes call-stack ordering inside Graphite's message dispatcher instead of a single linear queue. Varve dispatches through React state and explicit command calls rather than a queue of messages.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Improve Path tool layer and anchor point selection behavior

review.reason: `NodeEditTool` supports additive anchor selection, isolates the clicked anchor when Shift is not held, and clears the anchor selection on empty-canvas clicks; the owning layer is selected by entering node editing on it.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool node-edit selection.

title: [Crash Report] unwrap on an `Err` value: LayerNotFound...

review.reason: The residual defect named in the final comment is history spam, where every mouse move during a handle drag became its own history entry. Varve wraps a gesture in `beginTransaction`/`commitTransaction`, so a drag lands as one undo entry.
review.varveAssessment: Undo/redo transaction boundaries and engine transform lookups.

title: Convert the 24 NudgeSelectedLayers keys into a shorter loop

review.reason: The packet closes this as a duplicate of #248: 24 near-identical `NudgeSelectedLayers` input-mapper lines should become a loop. Varve generates bindings through the shortcut registry and a shared nudge planner rather than an unrolled table.
review.varveAssessment: No unrolled nudge key table exists in Varve.

title: Extend welcome screen button click area to labels

review.reason: Varve's Home/welcome actions use the `@varve/ui` `Button` component, whose whole surface (icon plus label) is one hit target instead of an icon-only click area.
review.varveAssessment: Home surface and shared Button component.

title: Replace hint Rust -> JS data with a widget layout

review.reason: Wants Graphite's recursive hint structs replaced by its Rust-defined widget-layout system. Varve has no Rust-defined widget layout sent to the frontend; UI is React components over a TypeScript menu model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Refactor the "actions" system into a unified and capable "commands" system

review.reason: Refactors Graphite's write-only action messages into stateful commands with dynamic parameters, quick favourites and hints. Varve has no action-message pipeline to rebuild; its `ActionRegistry` already carries id, validity with `disabledReason`, shortcut and menu placement.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite-internal; Varve's registry covers registration but not post-hoc parameter editing.

title: Switch event handling from event.key to event.code

review.reason: Varve resolves shortcuts through `input/physicalKey.ts`, which derives keys from `KeyboardEvent.code` (`Digit1`, `NumpadAdd`, ...) so layout and Shift/Option do not change which binding matches.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut and canvas key matching.

title: Replace shortcut_requires_lock system with an alternate keybind when not locked

review.reason: Depends on Chromium's Keyboard Lock API in a browser tab; the alternate keybinding exists only for that fullscreen key-lock limitation. Varve's primary shell is the Tauri desktop app, which has no browser key-lock constraint.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve binding-display path is affected.

title: Restructure editor codebase to align with message hierarchy

review.reason: Restructures Graphite's editor modules to mirror its message hierarchy so rustdoc can be generated and hosted. Varve's packages and crates are already modular and have no message-hierarchy tree to align with.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Use heuristics for converting from keyboard input JS API to locale-tailored key code

review.reason: The packet's own resolution is a heuristics layer for locale-dependent keys. Varve resolves layout-independent physical keys in `physicalKeyFromEvent`/`physicalDigit`, shared by the shortcut registry and the canvas key handler, including numpad and NumLock cases.
review.varveAssessment: Keyboard layout handling shared by shortcuts and canvas input.

title: Saving, updating, and reading files from disk

review.reason: Varve saves and opens documents through the `@varve/platform` abstraction (Tauri filesystem on desktop) with autosave recovery points kept separate from the saved file; the web File System Access API path is not required for the desktop product.
review.varveAssessment: Platform save/open and recovery persistence.

title: [Crash Report] Drawing an artboard on a finite canvas

review.reason: Caused by zooming against a zero-size viewport, which produced NaN and then a non-finite transform panic; fixed in Graphite by the message-ordering change in #750. The packet says nothing about Varve's camera and non-finite guards.
review.varveAssessment: Camera math and finite-transform guards in `packages/shared/src/viewport.ts` and `cameraState.ts`.

title: Extend path segments with the Pen tool

review.reason: The pen tool extends an in-progress path by adding segments and closing the path, with nullable per-anchor handles, which is the behaviour requested.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool path construction.

title: Draw an overlay for the origin point of the selected layer(s)

review.reason: Obsoleted in Graphite by #525's pivot UI. Varve's SelectionOverlay derives transform handles from the node's document-space geometry through the same camera transform, which is the superset of a separate origin marker.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and transform handling.

title: Alt-drag should duplicate layers

review.reason: `SelectTool` starts a `duplicate-drag` gesture when Alt is held on pointer-down, so Alt-drag duplicates the selected nodes instead of moving them.
review.varveAssessment: Select tool drag gesture.

title: Key repeat from modifier keys causes message spam and dropped frames

review.reason: Modifier state is read from each pointer event (`shiftKey`/`altKey`) rather than streamed as messages, and held arrow keys are coalesced by `CanvasNudgeController` into one transactional gesture, so key repeat cannot spam a message channel.
review.varveAssessment: Input pipeline modifier handling and nudge repeat.

title: Replace legacy layer types with nodes

review.reason: Converts Graphene's `LayerDataType` structs into `/node-graph` nodes, blocked in the thread on Document Graph work. Varve's scene nodes are a fixed enum tree, not a graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Rotating object via property panel eliminates shear

review.reason: Reports that editing rotation in the properties panel drops an existing skew, and the thread notes skew/rotation/scale combine awkwardly in the affine. The packet does not establish whether Varve's Inspector rotation preserves non-orthogonal transform components.
review.varveAssessment: Transform model and the Inspector rotation field.

title: Implement the Document Graph

review.reason: Implements Graphite's user-facing Document Graph over its Proto Graph. Varve has no node graph and no graph compilation stage.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Align transform cage rectangle rotation with layer bounding box

review.reason: Large UX spec for making the transform cage follow layer space: rotated or skewed bounds, document-space multi-selection bounds, and triangle corner markers. Whether Varve's selection overlay rotates its cage with a rotated node is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and transform-cage geometry.

title: Improve widget layout system to allow updating widgets and groups without resending it all

review.reason: Asks Graphite's widget-layout system to send incremental widget and group updates instead of resending whole layouts. Varve has no transmitted widget layout to make incremental.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Importing image doesn’t work

review.reason: Root cause was a Rust-to-JS serde casing mismatch (`image_data` versus `imageData`) in Graphite's widget payload. Varve decodes imported bitmaps into image nodes through `@varve/import`; there is no equivalent Rust-to-JS image payload contract to mismatch.
review.varveAssessment: Image import path.

title: [Crash Report] Vertical / Horizontal lines cause a crash when dragged

review.reason: The panic came from dividing new by old bounding-box dimensions when old height or width was zero. Varve clamps size fields to a 1px minimum in `PositionSizeSection`, so a zero-area bounds cannot become a scale divisor.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size fields and transform planning.

title: Exporting in `View Mode: Outline` resulted outlines to be exported

review.reason: Varve has no outline or wireframe view mode; export renders the composited appearance, so a view mode cannot leak into exported output.
review.varveAssessment: Export rendering path.

title: [Crash Report] When loading auto-saved documents, an image in a non-active tab can't find its layer

review.reason: Root cause was that backend messages could only address the active document. Varve keeps each document in per-session state with its own nodes and image data, and recovery points are stored per tab, so an image cannot resolve against another document.
review.varveAssessment: Multi-session autosave restore.

title: Add the Imaginate layer to synthesize images as adjustment layers

review.reason: Adds Graphite's Imaginate (AI image synthesis) layer as a node-graph adjustment type. Varve has adjustment layers but no Imaginate or diffusion layer subsystem.
review.varveAssessment: None; adjustment layers exist, the AI synthesis layer family does not.

title: Rename `/graphene` to `/document-legacy`

review.reason: Directory rename inside Graphite's own repository (`/graphene` to `/document-legacy`).
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: API connecting the frontend with Document Graph

review.reason: Builds the frontend API that connects to Graphite's Document Graph. Varve has no document graph to connect to.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Eyedropper tool frame isn't visible in black/dark background

review.reason: Varve's eyedropper delegates screen sampling to the OS EyeDropper API and otherwise reads canvas pixels directly, drawing no in-canvas sampling frame and announcing each result, so a dark-on-dark sampling frame has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: Eyedropper tool.

title: Animation support

review.reason: Varve ships a motion system: timeline keyframes, playback through `MotionFacade`, interpolation and easing, presets, and CSS/Lottie export.
review.varveAssessment: Motion workspace and timeline.

title: Why doesn't the new version run smoothly？

review.reason: Vague performance report about imported SVG documents becoming sluggish when zooming and moving with many layers or anchors; the thread itself only hypothesises overlay-drawing cost and asks for a bisect. No reproducible measurement or Varve counterpart is in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas render pipeline and overlay drawing would be the area to benchmark.

title: Global shortcut to enter Eyedropper picker state

review.reason: Wants a temporary eyedropper mode entered by a global shortcut without leaving the current tool. That needs the modal/temporary tool-state mechanism Varve lacks (its eyedropper is a full tool switch), which #832 describes.
review.varveAssessment: Blocked on a temporary tool-state layer in `tools/` plus a shortcut entry point.

title: Add a Node Graph adjustment layer type for bitmap compositing

review.reason: Adds a Node Graph layer type so a document graph drives bitmap compositing, initially hardcoded to grayscale or blur. Varve composites with adjustment layers over a fixed scene but has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None; the compositing capability exists as adjustment layers with scope.

title: Foundations for GPU-based nodes with RustGPU and WGPU

review.reason: Foundations for GPU-compute nodes with RustGPU and WGPU in Graphite's node graph. Varve's GPU work (ADR-0237) is effect and resample kernels, not a node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Switch to an attribute-based procedural vector format

review.reason: Redesigns the vector document format for arbitrary bezier meshes and Houdini-style procedural operations, which the thread ties to the node-graph roadmap. Varve's scene model is a fixed direct-manipulation node tree with no procedural evaluation.
review.varveAssessment: None; a document-format redesign for procedural data is a separate architecture change.

title: Break handle by clicking newest anchor when drawing segments with Pen tool

review.reason: Varve's path model stores nullable `handleIn`/`handleOut` per anchor and the pen tool adds a segment per click, so clicking the newest anchor starts or breaks a segment rather than re-dragging its handle.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool and path node model.

title: Toggle sharpness to remove/restore handles by double clicking an anchor point with Path tool

review.reason: Node editing exposes corner, smooth and bend anchor types with nullable handles, and `NodeEditTool` switches handle mode during a drag (Alt sets corner, symmetric preserves the opposite length).
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool handle modes.

title: Restore length of handle after releasing Shift for mirroring handle lengths with Path tool

review.reason: Asks that Shift-mirroring during a handle drag be provisional and restore the pre-Shift length on key release. The packet does not show whether Varve's handle drag keeps a snapshot for that restore behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: `NodeEditTool` handle drag and symmetric mode.

title: Handle points should be hidden for sharp points

review.reason: Handles are modelled as nullable pairs (`handleIn`/`handleOut: [x, y] | null`) and `handleLength()` returns 0 for null, so a sharp anchor has no handle point to draw as an overlay circle.
review.varveAssessment: Node-edit overlay and handle model.

title: Allow nudging, angle snapping, and G/R/S transformation of selected points in the Path tool

review.reason: Asks for nudging, axis snapping and G/R/S transforms of selected anchors and handles. Varve's nudge command (`commands/nudge.ts` with `CanvasNudgeController`) only plans whole-node moves, so selected path points cannot be nudged or transformed.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and `NodeEditTool` selection need point-level transform support.

title: Double clicking an anchor point with the Path tool only shows one handle near start/end point of path

review.reason: A closed-path edge case where double-clicking the anchor nearest the start/end point restores only one handle. Whether Varve's ring-based path indexing has an equivalent first/last anchor case is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Path ring and handle model in `NodeEditTool`.

title: Crashes due to an auto-loaded document on startup are unrecoverable

review.reason: Varve's recovery layer tolerates corrupt or incompatible recovery data, stays usable when storage is blocked, and writes the clean-shutdown marker only after finalisation so a bad auto-loaded session does not lock the app out.
review.varveAssessment: Recovery and lifecycle startup path.

title: Add modal tool states with the eyedropper, and implement pixel sampling in the color picker popover

review.reason: Introduces modal tool states, a temporary interaction that pre-empts the active tool, and uses the eyedropper as its first case including sampling from the colour-picker popover. Varve's eyedropper is only a full tool switch, so there is no temporary sampling state and no picker-popover sampling.
review.varveAssessment: Tool layer (`BaseTool`/tool manager), shortcut entry, and the colour picker popover.

title: Add multi-stop gradients at user-specifiable percentages

review.reason: Varve's gradient model stores an ordered array of `{position, color}` stops (`packages/scene/src/types.ts`), so gradients are multi-stop at arbitrary percentages.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient model and gradient editor.

title: Improve checkbox styling and visual clarity of other widgets

review.reason: Widgets come from `@varve/ui` components styled by shared tokens and `components.css`, so checkbox styling and widget visual clarity are owned by the design system rather than per-widget CSS.
review.varveAssessment: Shared UI component styles.

title: Build the range slider number input widget

review.reason: Varve composes a range plus numeric input as `RangeValueControl` in the Inspector and `Slider` in `@varve/ui`, over the canonical `.varve-native-range` skin documented in the slider system.
review.varveAssessment: Slider system and Inspector numeric controls.

title: Rendering and interaction CSS issues in Safari

review.reason: Safari-specific UA stylesheet and text-selection workarounds for Graphite's web widgets. Varve's Linux desktop shell runs on WebKitGTK, which shares Safari's engine, so the same UA quirks could apply there, but the packet cannot confirm it.
review.varveAssessment: Shared CSS/widget styles under the WebKitGTK desktop shell.

title: Memory usage spirals out of control as document history grows

review.reason: Varve's undo history is a persistent revision store (an append-only operation-log DAG with snapshots), so growing history does not keep a full document copy, images included, in memory per step.
review.varveAssessment: History and revision storage.

title: Every layer takes at least 8 MB of memory

review.reason: The 8 MB-per-layer reading was the same transient menu allocation later GC'd that closed #849; both reports share that resolution, and no per-layer allocation was found. The layer-count context from this report is retained here.
review.varveAssessment: No equivalent per-layer allocation exists in Varve's scene model.

title: Closing a document does not free memory usage

review.reason: Closed because the retained memory was transient menu allocation awaiting GC, not a leak. Varve has no equivalent per-document menu allocation, and closing a session removes its state and deletes its recovery records (`deleteRecoveryForTab`).
review.varveAssessment: Session teardown and lifecycle.

title: Closing all documents doesn't clear Properties and Layer Tree panels

review.reason: Varve's Inspector and Layers panels read the active session's document and selection, and closing all documents removes the session; there is no node-graph panel that could stay open.
review.varveAssessment: Panels' session-derived state.

title: MVP improvements for the rudimentary node graph

review.reason: MVP work on Graphite's rudimentary node graph: rewiring nodes, re-rendering on topology change, dragging nodes and exposing secondary inputs.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: npm install fails due to cargo build failure

review.reason: The ask is an up-to-date toolchain list plus an informative MSRV failure. Varve documents its confirmed toolchain (Rust, pnpm, Node, just) in AGENTS.md and validates it with `just check-env`.
review.varveAssessment: Developer toolchain documentation and environment check.

title: Linked Artboards as facing pages and folds

review.reason: Wants artboards linked as pages or spreads so resizing one (the book spine) moves the others to keep a fold layout. Varve's document model has `spreads`, `facingPages` and master pages, but linked resize behaviour is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Page/spread model and the Pages panel in the print workspace.

title: Layers physically move when being transferred to a new folder which has a different transform

review.reason: `reparentNode` accepts a `localTransform` that the editor supplies to preserve world position when old and new parents differ, and crossing containers releases a mask whose source left the container.
review.varveAssessment: Layer-panel reparenting and scene node ops.

title: Add support for inpainting and outpainting to Imaginate

review.reason: Extends Imaginate's generative image synthesis with inpainting and outpainting. Varve has no diffusion or generative image subsystem; its AI work is image trace, background removal and upscaling.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Add Smoothing to the Freehand Tool

review.reason: `PencilTool` exposes a smoothing setting implemented as a OneEuro stabilizer in `drawingAssists.ts`, wired to `brushSettings.smoothing` for both brush and pencil strokes.
review.varveAssessment: Freehand/pencil tool smoothing.

title: When I open up the graphic editor on the web I get this mask paint error

review.reason: The error came from a format change breaking previously saved documents. Varve versions documents and runs `migrateDocumentJson` on load, and the recovery layer handles corrupt or incompatible data rather than failing at startup.
review.varveAssessment: Document schema migration and recovery.

title: Allow users to view and edit nested node networks

review.reason: Viewing and editing nested node networks inside Graphite's node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Node graph editing UX improvements

review.reason: A checklist of node-graph editing UX: dragging links between ports, multi-node drag, node copy/paste, mute/hide, preview and re-render.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Rebuild the new layer panel frontend to replicate the mockup UI

review.reason: Varve has a LayersPanel with tree structure, selection, visibility/lock toggles and 28x28 node previews; the packet's rebuild is Graphite's own frontend work against its mockup.
review.varveAssessment: LayersPanel.

title: Infrastructure for calling nodes as lambdas with unique arguments

review.reason: Infrastructure for calling graph nodes as lambdas with per-call contexts in Graphene's static call graph. Varve has no graph compilation or node call-graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Port Imaginate layers to nodes

review.reason: Ports Graphite's Imaginate layers to nodes in its node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Implement types and type checking in the node graph

review.reason: Type inference and type checking for Graphite's node graph generics. Varve has no node type system to check.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Port Image layers to nodes

review.reason: Ports Graphite's Image layers to nodes. Varve's image nodes are scene nodes, not graph nodes.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Show and hide the node graph when a frame layer is selected or not

review.reason: Shows or hides Graphite's node graph panel based on frame-layer selection.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: [Crash Report] Crashes when deleting a two-side connected node.

review.reason: Crash in `graph_craft`'s `ProtoNetwork::replace_node_references` when deleting a two-sided connected node. Varve has no proto network or node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Translation / Internationalization

review.reason: Editor internationalisation, offered by a volunteer for Czech and German. Varve has only a menu-label localization boundary (`menu/localization.ts` with an English dictionary, `formatLabel` and missing-key diagnostics); UI strings elsewhere and any locale selection are absent.
review.varveAssessment: Externalising UI strings across `@varve/ui` and `@varve/editor` plus a locale picker, building on the existing menu label boundary.

title: Shake a node to un-wire its connection through its primary input/output

review.reason: A shake gesture on a node-graph node to unwire its primary input/output connection, including the shake-detection heuristic.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Hack in a way to clear stuck overlays

review.reason: Overlays in Varve are recomputed from editor state each frame (`SelectionOverlay`, guides, tool overlays) rather than accumulated between frames, so a finished tool leaves nothing stuck, and switching sessions replaces the whole overlay state.
review.varveAssessment: Overlay drawing and session switching.

title: Make MenuLists populate their contents when opened, not beforehand

review.reason: Varve's menubar and context menus build their entries when opened from the menu model and `ActionRegistry`, instead of receiving pre-built menu contents in a layout payload.
review.varveAssessment: Menu model and MenuList rendering.

title: Gaussian Blur and kernel-based nodes

review.reason: Gaussian blur and kernel-based operations as nodes in Graphite's node graph. Varve ships blur and other live effects over the scene, so only the graph node is absent.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph kernels are out of scope; Varve's blur lives in live effects.

title: Tracking Issue: New nodes

review.reason: A tracking list of new nodes for Graphite's node graph (noise, image adjustments, vector and math nodes and Blender-style read/write nodes).
review.varveAssessment: None; Varve has no node library to extend.

title: Add a "lock aspect ratio" checkbox to a layer's transform Scale/Dimensions

review.reason: `PositionSizeSection` has a proportion lock that keeps W/H in ratio as one is edited, on by default for image and raster nodes, which is the requested behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector position/size section.

title: Save work periodically to reduce loss from crashes

review.reason: `RecoveryManager` writes autosave recovery points as the session is edited, with a bounded byte budget per origin and per-tab cleanup, and the lifecycle coordinator writes the clean-shutdown marker only after finalisation.
review.varveAssessment: Recovery points and lifecycle save path.

title: Alt+Arrows should nudge to resize the bottom/right edges of layers

review.reason: Asks for Alt+Arrow to resize the bottom/right edge and Ctrl+Arrow the top/left instead of translating. Varve's `CanvasNudgeController` explicitly returns early when Alt, Ctrl or Meta is held, so only translation nudging exists.
review.varveAssessment: `tools/nudgeController.ts` plus `commands/nudge.ts` would need an edge-resize nudge plan.

title: Fix boolean ops regression

review.reason: Boolean results were unreliable when a primitive shape was combined with a Pen-drawn path, traced to inconsistent path winding after Graphite dropped its previous vector format. Boolean evaluation must normalise winding or mixed primitive and drawn inputs silently produce wrong results.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve's boolean path-geometry operations in the engine, where mixed primitive and drawn-path inputs must be winding-normalised before union, subtract or intersect.

title: New feature: support outline stroke for font object

review.reason: The reporter's real request is a Figma-style Outline Stroke, converting a text object into an editable shape whose contours can be node-edited; the maintainer filed #940 for exactly that and closed this as covered, after rejecting the initial read that it merely needed a stroke colour.
review.varveAssessment: The in-scope need is an editor-level convert-text-to-outlines command; Varve's font outlining lives in the print/PDF path rather than a documented editing operation.

title: Re-add text to shape conversion (as a node?)

review.reason: Closed by the maintainer as a duplicate of #1162: the vector generator already emits path data, but there is no node that stores edits to that input, so destructive text-to-shape or SVG-to-shape conversion waits on the Vector Edit node.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node graph to hold path edits; if an equivalent destructive text-to-shape action is missing, the affected area is the text pipeline's glyph outline output.

title: Make dragging Pivot require Alt, and show a tooltip on hover

review.reason: A detailed overlay and tooltip spec for a pivot that is only draggable while holding Alt, closed as unnecessary once the pivot was recoloured and a centre X/Y gizmo was planned. The packet never shows whether Varve's selection overlay exposes an always-draggable pivot, so the same mis-click confusion is unconfirmed.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch the CanvasArea selection overlay and pivot drag hit-testing if Varve shows a comparable pivot dot.

title: Improve Artboard tool selection behavior

review.reason: Proposal was withdrawn by the maintainer: artboard names made outlines unnecessary, and changing layer selection merely by switching tools was judged undesirable. Varve expresses page structure through pages, spreads and master pages rather than a viewport artboard tool, so the specific confusion may not transfer.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect page and frame selection affordances in CanvasArea and the pages panel if an artboard-style tool exists.

title: Shape fill with custom pattern

review.reason: Custom repeating pattern fills were closed in favour of #2779; the thread only adds that the pattern encoding should merge conceptually with gradients and map to SVG pattern elements.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has linear, radial and conic gradients and patterns along paths, but no documented repeating-pattern fill type; the canonical issue holds the requirement.

title: UX: After Import, switch to Select tool

review.reason: A user with a drawing tool active imported a graphic and immediately drew a stray line; the maintainer agreed Import should switch to the Select tool for both File > Import and drag-and-drop. Varve's post-import active-tool behaviour is not documented, so compliance is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the import completion path and the active tool held in the editor context.

title: UX: resize object with drag should respect 'Preserve Aspect Ratio' checkbox

review.reason: A usability test showed a non-technical user could not preserve aspect ratio because the constraint only existed behind a Shift modifier, and touch devices have no Shift key at all. The maintainer later declined this exact coupling, and Varve's resize modifier scheme is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Affects interactive resize handles and how Varve exposes aspect-ratio constraint without a physical modifier key.

title: Change Path tool handle distance mirroring from toggle to momentary

review.reason: The issue body is empty and only the title states the requirement, so there is no reproduction, no rationale and no record of what shipped. Toggle versus momentary handle mirroring cannot be assessed against Varve from this packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect path-node handle dragging in Varve's pen and path tools.

title: Reaching end of undo/redo history spams console

review.reason: Pressing undo or redo past the end of history printed a debug warning on every press; the maintainer wanted it downgraded so normal use never writes to the console. Varve's undo path over the persistent revision store has no documented console behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Affects undo/redo boundary handling for Varve's revision store and its console-hygiene expectations.

title: Resizing/editing the artboard with the Artboard tool should have undo/redo history

review.reason: Empty body; the requirement is that artboard geometry edits land in history. Varve has no separate artboard editing path, and page or spread geometry changes are ordinary document mutations recorded by the persistent revision store.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the revision store: page geometry edits are document transactions like any other.

title: Undo/redo last point extended using the Pen tool

review.reason: Each point placed by the Pen tool while extending a path should be its own history step so undo can walk back through segments; the maintainer asked for a tracking comment specifically in order to assign it.
review.varveAssessment: Affects pen-tool point commits and where Varve's transaction boundary falls inside the path tools.

title: Make draggable widgets set only one undo/redo state upon committing a value

review.reason: Dragging a number widget started a history step per pixel of drag, wiping history with dozens of micro-changes; the required model is an explicit update that only previews and a commit that records the single undo state.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the inspector RangeValueControl and NumberField drag handling and the transaction boundary opened on commit.

title: Gradient tool UX improvements

review.reason: Checklist of gradient gaps: reuse an existing gradient's stops when the line is redrawn, keep the tool options bar and layer properties in sync, make stop changes undoable, and support inserting and deleting stops.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the gradient tool and GradientEditor, plus undo granularity for gradient-stop edits.

title: Culling artwork visible in the viewport is making some shapes in layers invisible

review.reason: Viewport culling was dropping artwork that was visibly on screen, making shapes inside layers disappear. The fix landed with no description, so the guard that must exist is that cull bounds expand for stroke width, effects and masks rather than plain geometry.
review.varveAssessment: Affects render-pipeline culling; Varve's forceFullRedraw oracle validates pixel reuse but not cull-rect correctness.

title: Debounce widget inputs to minimize backend spam

review.reason: Debouncing rapidly dragged widgets to reduce backend traffic; it was closed by a Graphite JS-to-Wasm message-bus change, so the packet says nothing about Varve's equivalent native IPC cost per drag.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect how often inspector widget drags cross the Tauri IPC or WASM facade boundary.

title: Text on a path

review.reason: Text on a path is implemented in Varve's text pipeline, which handles shaping, BiDi, CJK, variable fonts and text on path. The packet's only caveat, that Graphite could not edit text in place on the curve, concerns an SVG-based editor rather than Varve's pipeline.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the text pipeline's text-on-path support; no new work identified.

title: Fixed document size shouldn't allow scrolling/drawing outside

review.reason: The request was to forbid scrolling or drawing outside a fixed document size; the maintainer closed it by explaining the pasteboard is intentional and the plan is to dim or hide outside-artboard content instead. Varve's treatment of content outside pages and frames is not documented here.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect pasteboard rendering and page-boundary dimming in the canvas.

title: Group/ungroup selection of objects, on multiple levels

review.reason: Reporter needed click-to-select of a whole group, dragging that group, and re-selecting it later, with double-click digging into members. The maintainer filed #985 to carry that requirement and closed this one.
review.varveAssessment: The in-scope need is group-level selection with dig-down; Varve has groups and a layers panel but no documented shallowest or deepest select modes.

title: Improve the Select tool with Deepest and Shallowest mode

review.reason: Asks for a Layer versus Group mode in the Select tool: click selects the shallowest parent folder, double-click digs one level, and Ctrl-click selects the exact layer. Varve's select-tool hit resolution over groups and frames is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Affects select-tool hit resolution across groups and frames and the tool options bar.

title: Node to cut an image out from its background and un-blend the translucent pixels

review.reason: Framed as a three-input node, but the capability is background-plate-aware matte extraction that un-premultiplies contaminated translucent edge pixels. Varve ships background removal, yet whether it decontaminates against a supplied background plate is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would extend Varve's background-removal provider chain rather than a node graph.

title: Approachable mini starter tasks for new contributors

review.reason: This is Graphite's own contributor-onboarding meta list of small tasks, with no product requirement, and it closes with a note that all items are gone for now. It describes Graphite's issue-management process rather than editor behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve tracks beginner work through its own contribution documentation.

title: Cull snapping candidates outside the viewport

review.reason: Culling snapping candidates to the viewport is a performance requirement stated only in the title, with no body text or measurements, and it was closed by a pull request. Varve's snapping system has no documented candidate-set culling.
review.varveAssessment: Affects snapping candidate generation cost during drags in large documents.

title: Add an Image Frame node and make the graph output vector data

review.reason: Requires the Graphene document graph to emit vector data plus an Image Frame node producing an image tag. Varve has no node graph; images are ordinary scene nodes and export already runs through the SVG and PDF writers.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Gaussian blur node

review.reason: A Gaussian blur node was removed for being slow and later re-added as a CPU implementation, so this is node-graph work. Varve would express the same need as a live effect, and the capability list names live effects without confirming a blur kernel.
review.varveAssessment: Would land in Varve's live-effects kernels instead of a node.

title: Foundational work for incremental compilation

review.reason: Empty body; the title refers to foundational work for incremental compilation of Graphite's node pipeline. Varve has no procedural node pipeline to compile incrementally.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Migrate Shape layers to nodes

review.reason: Empty body; migrating Shape layers into document nodes is part of Graphite's move to a fully node-based document. Varve shapes are already first-class scene nodes in an immutable document model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Port Text layers to nodes

review.reason: Empty body; porting Text layers to nodes is the same Graphite document-node migration. Varve text is already a document-level node type in its own scene model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Make the Pen tool not show the in-progress segment until committed

review.reason: The Pen tool previewed the extending segment live, which obscured the art being traced; the desired behaviour is only a thin overlay preview until the segment is committed, and the spline tool was explicitly de-scoped. Varve's pen preview behaviour is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the pen tool's in-progress preview drawing in the canvas overlay path.

title: Imaginate web hosting infrastructure

review.reason: Empty body; the title concerns hosting infrastructure for Graphite's Imaginate image-generation service. Varve is local-first with offline AI and ships no hosted generation backend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Layer widget clip out of screen when sidebar is too small

review.reason: Row actions in the layer widget were clipped out of view when the sidebar was narrow, leaving the folder and delete controls reachable only by horizontal scrolling. Layer-panel row actions must stay reachable at any sidebar width.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve's layers panel row layout and action overflow under a narrow sidebar.

title: Backwards Compatibility???

review.reason: A user could no longer open previously saved files after a breaking storage change, and only manual workarounds were offered. Varve ships additive, versioned document schema migrations, so stored documents are upgraded on load rather than rejected; the thread's secondary pen-handle request is covered by Varve's corner, smooth and bend node-editing modes.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by versioned document schema migrations plus the smooth and sharp handle modes.

title: Node connections with incompatible types should be rejected instead of erroring

review.reason: The behaviour requires evaluating node port types in the Graphene graph so an incompatible connection is rejected or highlighted before evaluation. Varve has no node graph with typed connections.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Error when disconnecting output node

review.reason: The error text leaks a Graphene Rust type mismatch when a node output is disconnected. Varve has no node ports or type-checked graph connections.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Configurable scroll to pan or zoom

review.reason: A preference to choose whether the scroll wheel pans or zooms; the body is empty and only a tracking comment exists. Varve's camera input conventions and whether wheel semantics are user-configurable are not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect canvas camera input handling and the editor settings surface.

title: Middle click over node moves node, not view

review.reason: Middle-drag over a node moved the node instead of panning the Graphene node graph viewport. Varve has no node graph canvas; its camera pan and zoom applies to artwork.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Convert color to linear in the graph and back to gamma in the output

review.reason: Requires converting colours to linear inside the Graphene graph and back to gamma at graph output. Varve has no graph evaluation stage that performs this conversion.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph colour stage exists; this issue describes only that graph conversion.

title: Option in preferences for un-hijacking `Alt`

review.reason: Asks for a preference to stop the editor capturing Alt so Firefox can switch tabs; the maintainer declined as intended behaviour and unwanted complexity. The complaint depends on browser tab keyboard integration that Varve's desktop app does not have.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the web build is a demo and the desktop app has no browser tab switching.

title: Find and fix Svelte migration regressions

review.reason: A checklist for hunting regressions from Graphite's Vue-to-Svelte migration, including Svelte-specific input, dropdown and slider breakage. Varve is a React application and never used Svelte, so none of these framework-specific regressions apply.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Crash with zero scale

review.reason: Setting a scale or dimension to zero and then typing a new value panicked on a non-finite transform, and the report adds that horizontal or vertical lines trigger it too. Varve's inspector clamps width and height to at least 1, so a zero or negative extent cannot reach the transform path.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by inspector clamping of W/H to values of at least 1 before geometry and transform evaluation.

title: Add a downscale control to the Image node for performance

review.reason: Empty body; the title asks for a downscale parameter on the Graphene Image node to limit sampling cost. Varve has no image node with evaluation parameters.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Add "Lock Angle" to Pen tool

review.reason: Reworks Pen tool modifiers so Alt breaks a handle, Shift snaps to 15 degrees, and a new Ctrl lock-angle constrains the extension direction. Varve's pen modifier mapping is not documented, so whether these three behaviours exist is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Affects pen-tool modifier handling and its documented keyboard contract.

title: Combine Bitmap and Transform data into an Image data type

review.reason: A graph data-type refactor merging bitmap and transform payloads into one Image type so the Output node can accept vector or image data. Varve has no node data types or node evaluation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Brush tool and node

review.reason: Requests a basic stamped circular brush with radius and hardness controls. Varve already ships raster paint tools and a brush system with adjustable brush parameters.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by Varve's raster paint tools and brush system.

title: Unable to display Chinese

review.reason: Chinese glyphs failed to render because the default font lacked them; the packet's own diagnosis is a missing-glyph font fallback rather than a rendering defect. Varve's text pipeline handles CJK shaping and font selection.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the text pipeline's CJK shaping and font handling.

title: Boolean operations node

review.reason: The requirement is that boolean union, subtract and intersect work on selected vector layers as a user action. Varve ships a boolean operations module that performs these directly without a node graph.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by Varve's boolean operations module; no node insertion path is needed.

title: Solidify stroke node

review.reason: Asks for stroke outline expansion as an operation available from the Select tool, converting a stroke into a filled path. Varve supports multiple strokes per object, but the packet gives no evidence whether an outline or solidify-stroke-to-path operation exists.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's path geometry operations and the vector tool options bar.

title: GPU execution with CPU fallback

review.reason: WebGPU when available with a CPU fallback and an indicator of which is in use. Varve defaults to Canvas2D with opt-in WebGPU and reports accelerator capability stages truthfully, including device-usable and execution-verified states.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the compositor's Canvas2D default with opt-in WebGPU fallback and truthful capability reporting.

title: Replace SVG renderer with Vello

review.reason: Replacing an SVG-string renderer with a canvas renderer driven by Rust. Varve already renders by replaying engine IR to canvas rather than injecting SVG strings into the page.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the IR-replay architecture; no SVG-string renderer exists.

title: Drag-n-dropping a new image into a brand new document causes it to be imported with significantly higher dimensions than expected

review.reason: A dropped 768x768 image landed as a 1800000x1800000 layer, a regression from Graphite's node migration multiplying an upstream transform. Varve's import path is not described in the packet, so whether a dropped image arrives at its intrinsic pixel size cannot be confirmed.
review.varveAssessment: Affects bitmap import geometry and the Inspector W/H fields for imported images.

title: Mouse drag-resize of a layer causes it to significantly blow out of proportions

review.reason: A slight drag-resize inflated a 750x750 layer to roughly 575000x575000, again from compounding an upstream transform. Whether Varve's resize writes absolute geometry or compounds a transform chain is not documented here.
review.varveAssessment: Affects interactive resize geometry in the canvas and its clamp bounds.

title: Changing the dimensions of Spline Tool to overly large number freezes the website

review.reason: Typing an absurd dimension into the Spline tool properties froze the editor, with the expected fix being an upper clamp; the thread later confirms Graphite resolved it. Varve has no documented upper bound on dimension entry.
review.varveAssessment: Affects inspector numeric validation and the allocation bounds behind geometry updates.

title: Sending rasterized images from JS to Rust runs out of wasm memory

review.reason: Rasterizing every frame pushed gigabytes of binary data into wasm until the allocator was exhausted, freezing the editor; the maintainer traced it to a memoisation cache with no eviction strategy. A design suite with caches must bound them and surface allocation failure instead of freezing.
review.varveAssessment: Directly analogous to Varve's subtree replay cache and mask-surface pool: eviction bounds and surfaced allocation failure matter.

title: Tracking Issue: Text tool and typography improvements

review.reason: An open tracking issue bundling typography work: searchable fonts, line height, character width, wrapping boxes, faux italic and BiDi are checked off, while style spans, in-canvas editing, ligatures, faux bold, font fallback, advanced styling and inline graphics remain open. Varve's shaping pipeline covers much of the checked list, but per-run style spans and inline graphics are not in its capability list.
review.varveAssessment: Residual gap to verify: per-run style spans (one bold word in a paragraph) and inline graphics in the text flow.

title: Selected layer values in properties panel are not changing after loading a saved document.

review.reason: After loading a saved document, edits made in the properties panel had no effect until the layer was deselected and reselected. Silent no-op editing after load is a defect class that must be excluded, because the user believes they changed the document.
review.varveAssessment: Affects how the Inspector binds to rehydrated selection state after a document load.

title: Transform cage visualized based on layer space

review.reason: The request is for the transform cage to be drawn in layer space so rotated and skewed layers show rotated and skewed bounds instead of viewport-aligned ones. Closed as a duplicate of #774.
review.varveAssessment: The affected surface is Varve's SelectionOverlay, which must use the rotation-aware camera transform rather than the rotation-blind helpers.

title: Node graph introspection

review.reason: Introspection of values during Graphene graph execution so the UI can show properties and layer thumbnails. Varve has no graph execution to introspect.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Restructure JS <-> Wasm communication flow and adopt parallelism

review.reason: Restructures Graphite's JS-to-Wasm call-stack ping-pong into a queued message flow plus worker parallelism. The design is specific to Graphite's web-only Rust and WASM build; Varve uses a native engine facade behind a render-worker split.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Prevent closing the crash dialogue

review.reason: The crash dialogue could be dismissed with Escape or a click anywhere, so a user might never learn that a crash happened. A crash and recovery surface must not be dismissible accidentally while the recovery decision is unresolved.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve's crash reporting and recovery UI built on the crash core, and its interaction with the lifecycle coordinator.

title: Embedded bitmap files are massive, use base64 instead

review.reason: Embedded bitmaps were serialized as per-pixel JSON objects, producing enormous documents and freezing autosave. Binary payloads must be encoded compactly so saves and autosaves do not stall the editor.
review.varveAssessment: Affects document serialization of embedded image assets and the autosave path's cost.

title: Serialize images as base64 to hugely reduce file sizes

review.reason: Same finding as #1117: serializing images as base64 to shrink document size. It was opened a day later and closed within a minute with no separate resolution, while #1117 was closed by its own pull request.
