review.varveAssessment: Covered by the same document serialization concern as #1117.

title: Make the Spline tool non-destructive

review.reason: Making the Spline tool non-destructive by moving spline-to-Bezier conversion into a node and feeding a polyline into it. It was closed as part of Graphite's node-based document migration, and Varve has no procedural evaluation to keep a spline live.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve tool output is direct-manipulation geometry.

title: Pen/Freehand/Spline shapes shrink to 0 when using G/R/S

review.reason: Pen, freehand and spline shapes collapsed to zero size when transformed with grab, rotate or scale keys, and the closure note only says it was solved in an unrelated local branch. Transform operations must not annihilate geometry whose bounding box has zero extent on one axis.
review.varveAssessment: Affects transform math for paths with degenerate bounding boxes in the canvas transform tools.

title: Add layer locking

review.reason: Asks for layer locking that blocks viewport selection and interaction while still allowing layer-tree selection and properties edits. Varve's scene model supports locked and hidden nodes with exactly that interaction split.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by locked and hidden node flags and the selection path that honours them.

title: G/R/S visualization overlays

review.reason: Requests axis lines, a pivot dot and numeric readouts while transforming with grab, rotate or scale keys, plus a shift-constrained axis line for Select-tool drags. Varve has snapping overlays, but its own keyboard transform conventions and on-canvas numeric feedback are not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect canvas overlays and numeric feedback during transforms.

title: Implement the correct Brightness/Contrast node

review.reason: Empty body; the title asks for a corrected Brightness/Contrast node in Graphene. Varve exposes brightness and contrast through its own adjustment and effects path rather than a node.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph path; the equivalent adjustment surface is independent of this issue.

title: The Blend node's primary input is drawn with line artifacts on certain pixel rows

review.reason: Artifacts appear on some pixel rows when a Blend node samples an identical input at a fractional transform. Varve has no Blend node, but image layers resampled at fractional transforms could exhibit the same row-sampling artifact, which the packet cannot confirm.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect image resampling in Varve's compositor and render pipeline at fractional camera or layer transforms.

title: Make the editor and graph more resilient to crashes

review.reason: Asks for sandboxing components such as the node graph in panic handlers so a crash reloads the component instead of the page and does not lose the document. Closed as a duplicate of #1552.
review.varveAssessment: The in-scope part is document survival across a renderer crash, which Varve's crash core and revision store cover; the graph-sandboxing part has no analogue.

title: Refactor Input Frame node and rename it to the Screenshot Below node

review.reason: Refactors the Graphene Input Frame node into a Screenshot Below node with no magic transform-bounds guessing. It was closed as becoming deprecated once the document graph migration finished.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Path tool point nudging UX improvements

review.reason: A long specification for path point nudging: Ctrl for handle distance mirroring, automatic smooth-to-split when moving both handles, Shift-click to deselect a single handle, and rotation and scaling about the anchor. Varve's node editing has corner, smooth and bend handle modes, but these nudge and selection semantics are not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Affects path-node selection and Arrow-key nudging in the vector editing tools.

title: Dragging images into a fresh editor

review.reason: Dropping an image or a project file onto the welcome screen or tab bar should open it, creating a document sized to the image. Varve has a Home surface with recent files and projects, but whether it accepts file drops is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the Home surface file handling and the session tab bar's drop targets.

title: npm start showing errors

review.reason: A developer-environment support thread where missing wasm-bindgen TypeScript declarations made npm start fail, resolved by reinstalling the Rust toolchain. There is no product requirement and it concerns Graphite's own build setup.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Switch from nearest neighboring to use texture filtering

review.reason: Sampling should use texture filtering instead of nearest neighbour. Varve renders bitmaps through Canvas2D, which applies smoothing by default, and its native upscale path uses bicubic resampling rather than nearest-neighbour.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the Canvas2D compositor's smoothing and the bicubic upscale kernel.

title: Listing the previously created designs in the Welcome Screen

review.reason: The request was to list and reopen previously created documents from the welcome screen; the maintainer declined because a browser build cannot reach the filesystem. Varve is local-first and its Home surface lists recent files and projects.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the Home surface's recent files and projects.

title: Auto-generate type-safe TypeScript definitions for Rust data types

review.reason: Auto-generating type-safe TypeScript definitions from Rust types instead of hand-maintaining a message module. Varve's bridge and WASM bindings carry hand-written wire-format types, and whether generation is used is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the Rust-to-TypeScript wire contract shared by the bridge crate and the engine facade.

title: Backend support for layers and vertical compositing stacks

review.reason: Adds Layer nodes with a vertical compositing monadic input to the Graphene graph so layers become syntax sugar over nodes. Varve layers are direct scene-model constructs with no graph compositing chain.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Clicking in number input and dragging selects from start to mouse in Firefox

review.reason: A click-drag inside a number field selected a partial range starting at the beginning of the number, which then replaced the value with a huge number and threw the shape off canvas. Closed as a duplicate or insubstantial subset of #313.
review.varveAssessment: The affected surface is Varve's NumberField and RangeValueControl text-selection behaviour on click and drag.

title: Resolve error when using fill and gradient tool with node graph frame

review.reason: A type error when the fill or gradient tool is used on a node graph frame layer, where the frame is a bitmap graph output. Varve has no node graph frames.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Vector Edit node

review.reason: Adjusts the Shape node so it can take an existing path as input and modify it, which is the mechanism required for non-destructive text-to-path editing. Varve has no Shape node or graph input plumbing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve path editing writes directly to node geometry.

title: Stop vector layers disappearing whilst dragging

review.reason: Vector layers vanished while being dragged or transformed, which confuses the user about what is selected. Varve's render contract requires a synchronous decision about whether a fresh frame is coming and falls back to a main-thread replay, so an in-flight drag is redrawn rather than left blank.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the rule that no pixels may remain on screen unless a fresh frame will replace them, plus the replay fallback.

title: Replace the overlays system with a simple immediate-mode system

review.reason: Replacing a separate overlay document with immediate-mode per-frame overlay drawing. Varve draws overlays into the same canvas frame as the artwork, so there is no secondary overlay document to keep in sync.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by per-frame overlay drawing in the canvas rather than a separate overlay document.

title: Right click in editing text for autocorrect

review.reason: Prevent-default on pointer events blocked the browser context menu inside editable text, removing autocorrect and spell suggestions. Varve's text editing surface and whether it suppresses native context menus or spellcheck in text fields is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the text editing input path and pointer event handling in the canvas.

title: Separate RGBA / Combine RGBA nodes

review.reason: Adds separate and combine RGBA channel nodes to Graphene. Varve has no per-channel node operators and no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Code editor for proto nodes

review.reason: A Monaco-based code editor for writing Rust implementations of proto nodes, which is the code-editor-for-node-definitions case. Varve has no node definitions and no in-app code editor for them.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Replace legacy artboards with artboard nodes

review.reason: Replaces legacy artboards with Artboard nodes feeding a document-level node graph, including SVG clipping and checkerboard background handling. Varve has no document graph; pages, spreads and master pages are first-class scene structures.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Creating user-defined subgraphs

review.reason: Creates user-defined subgraphs with double-click navigation, breadcrumbs, and generalised input and output nodes. Varve has no node graph or subgraph concept.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Dynamic attributes on Table<T>

review.reason: Dynamic attributes appended to Graphene Table types so data can ride along the node graph. Varve has no graph data flow or Table type.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Spline does not have mirror handles enabled

review.reason: Splines created by the spline tool lacked mirrored handles, so dragging one handle in the path tool did not move the opposite one. Varve's node editing distinguishes corner, smooth and bend anchors, and smooth anchors mirror their handles.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the smooth and bend handle modes in Varve's node editing.

title: Frontend layer panel UI for node-based layer compositing stacks

review.reason: Empty body; frontend layer panel UI for node-based layer compositing stacks in Graphene. Varve's layers panel renders its own scene model rather than compositing nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Fix layer grouping and nesting via document nodes

review.reason: Ports grouping, nesting, ordering, visibility and deletion from the legacy folder system to Graphite's nested document-node structure. Varve grouping and layer ordering already operate on its scene model, not on document nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Restore linting to the web codebase

review.reason: Restoring ESLint after Graphite's Svelte and Webpack migration disabled it in CI. Varve is a React workspace that lints with Biome inside its validation gate, so there is nothing to restore.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: When text is modified in the Properties panel, it shifts around

review.reason: Editing text in the properties panel shifted the text on canvas because position was stored relative to the text centre and was not recomputed after the string changed. Text edits must preserve the layer's anchor so typing does not move the object.
review.varveAssessment: Affects text geometry and anchor resolution in the text pipeline when the string changes.

title: Fix Brush node becoming way too big when resized by the user

review.reason: A Brush node resized to many times its size because the tool multiplied the upstream transform, and the fix required reading the most downstream Transform node through graph introspection. Varve has no node chain of Transform nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Pen tool needs fill and stroke color choices

review.reason: The Pen tool options bar should offer fill and stroke choice between primary, secondary, none and a custom colour. Varve's palette carries tool options while the context bar carries selection properties, but whether new-shape fill and stroke defaults are exposed per tool is not documented.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the toolbar composition's tool-option slots and the paint defaults used for newly created shapes.

title: Stroke and fill color choices should be on all vector tools

review.reason: Extends the Pen tool's fill and stroke choices to all vector tools, with the Line tool offering stroke only and the Text tool fill only. Varve's per-tool paint defaults and options-bar composition are not documented at this granularity.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the tool registry's per-tool option schema and the shared paint default state.

title: Buttons to download/copy an ImageFrame from a layer

review.reason: Empty body; the title asks for buttons to download or copy an image frame produced by a Graphene layer. Varve has no image node output to download from a layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; image export runs through the standard export pipeline.

title: Incorrect pivot when rotating brush in properties

review.reason: Rotating a brush stroke from the properties panel rotated about the wrong centre once a transform node had been created by dragging. Varve's rotation pivot semantics in the Inspector are not documented, so whether the same off-centre rotation is possible is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the Inspector rotation control and the pivot used for parametric rotation.

title: Add a Layer node and restructure artwork data types to feed into a layer and out the graph

review.reason: Adds a Layer node taking a GraphicElement input and restructures artwork types so the document output receives one element. Varve layers are scene-model constructs, not graph nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Layer-to-layer snapping system

review.reason: Requests layer-to-layer snapping inspired by Inkscape. Varve ships a snapping system with sticky snapping and guide-based alignment on the canvas.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the canvas snapping system.

title: Display layer thumbnails in the node graph

review.reason: Empty body; the title asks to display layer thumbnails inside the node graph. Varve's layers panel already renders a 28x28 node preview per row through its thumbnail system.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the documented 28x28 layers-panel node preview profile.

title: Polygon tool, ngon -> star option

review.reason: Varve registers distinct polygon and star shape tools (toolRegistry ids 'polygon' and 'star') with their own sides/points options, so choosing between ngon and star is already a tool choice.
review.varveAssessment: Shape tool registry and tool options already cover the polygon/star choice.

title: Fix black BMPs by sending RGBA to a canvas

review.reason: Varve's viewport replays engine IR straight onto Canvas2D and paints bitmaps as RGBA on the canvas; it never encodes a frame as a BMP inside an SVG image element, so the fully-transparent-BMP-appears-black path does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas image rendering goes through the IR replay compositor, which has no BMP transport.

title: Replace Fill node's "Use Gradient"/"Use Solid Color" button with a radio button

review.reason: The request is a radio widget inside Graphite's node-graph Fill node; Varve has no node graph and edits fills directly in the Inspector as solid or gradient.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph parameter panel exists in Varve; fill type is an Inspector property.

title: Render node-based artboards

review.reason: This renders artboards from a special node-graph output type in the #1171 migration; Varve models artboards as pages and frames in the scene tree, not as graph output.
review.varveAssessment: Artboard rendering in Varve is page/frame scene rendering, so no node-graph output path is affected.

title: Fix Artboard tool and editor manipulation of node-based artboards

review.reason: Graphite's Artboard tool and document commands were being updated for node-based artboards in the #1171 migration; Varve's frame/page tools already manipulate scene nodes directly.
review.varveAssessment: Frame and page tools are already direct-manipulation scene operations.

title: Remove legacy artboards in lieu of node-based artboards

review.reason: Removal of Graphite's legacy artboard implementation during its node-graph migration (#1171), which is internal code cleanup in Graphite.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve corresponds to Graphite's legacy artboard code.

title: Add a node graph to the document itself

review.reason: Adds a document-level node graph, which is an explicit Varve non-goal.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node graph and does not intend to add one.

title: Duplicating a folder should also duplicate the children

review.reason: Varve's duplicate action clones the selected node subtree in the immutable scene document, so duplicating a group or frame carries its children rather than copying the container alone.
review.varveAssessment: Layer/frame duplication through duplicateSelected is already subtree-complete.

title: Questionable float <-> int conversion in a variety of places

review.reason: The packet targets a specific Rust float-to-u8 conversion in Graphite's colour module; whether Varve's varve-colour conversions round with +0.5 or truncate is not established by the provided context.
review.varveAssessment: Varve colour conversion and 8-bit export paths would need checking for truncation.

title: Add point position inputs to Path tool options bar

review.reason: Varve's NodeEditTool has no numeric X/Y fields for the selected path anchor; the Inspector transform fields edit the node transform, not individual anchor coordinates, and this request is specifically for point-position inputs that disable when zero or multiple points are selected.
review.varveAssessment: Path/node-edit tool options would need numeric anchor position inputs wired to the selection.

title: Color palette from image

review.reason: It asks for a new image-analysis node whose output is a colour palette; Varve has no node graph to host such a node and no palette-extraction feature is described.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph evaluation or node catalogue exists in Varve.

title: Out of memory with large images

review.reason: Wasm out-of-memory from repeated large ImageFrame allocations while editing image-adjustment nodes; Graphite consolidated this finding into #1895, so this is the same defect.
review.varveAssessment: The comparable Varve area is image-effect buffer bounds in the engine, which the canonical issue would cover.

title: Tracking Issue: Enable WebGPU graph execution

review.reason: WebGPU execution of Graphite's node graph, moved to #144; Varve has an opt-in WebGPU compositor but no node graph or GPU node buffers.
review.varveAssessment: GPU node execution has no Varve counterpart.

title: Path tool should have a box selection on drag

review.reason: The packet asks the Path tool to drag a box that selects anchor points; whether Varve's NodeEditTool supports anchor marquee selection (separate from the scene-object MarqueeTool) is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Node-edit selection in the path tool would be the affected area.

title: Allow nodes to have no primary output

review.reason: Changes Graphite's node connector model so nodes can omit a primary output, needed by the Split Channels node.
review.varveAssessment: Node connectors do not exist in Varve.

title: Drawing on rotated / scaled brush layers is incorrect

review.reason: Varve paints into a resolved raster paint target, but whether rotated or scaled paint layers map the pointer trace correctly is unverified; the packet also leaves brush-radius scaling as an open design question rather than a defined expectation.
review.varveAssessment: PaintTool pointer-to-layer coordinate mapping and brush radius semantics would be affected.

title: Decouple node graph execution with requestAnimationFrame

review.reason: Schedules Graphite's node-graph execution against requestAnimationFrame and was closed by #1209.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no graph executor to schedule.

title: Switch the node graph to an async execution model

review.reason: Converts Graphite's node-graph execution to an async model.
review.varveAssessment: No async node-graph execution exists in Varve.

title: Integrate WebGPU into the node graph execution model

review.reason: Integrates WebGPU into Graphite's node-graph execution model.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's WebGPU work is a compositor path, not node execution.

title: Graph rewriting step

review.reason: Graph rewriting and automatic Clone/Cache node insertion for Graphite's node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph rewriting stage exists in Varve.

title: Brush tool should be able to draw on image layers

review.reason: Varve's PaintTool resolves the selected raster layer as its paint target and paints into it instead of adding a new layer; only the node-insertion mechanism described here is Graphite-specific.
review.varveAssessment: Brush drawing on image layers is a direct paint-target path in Varve.

title: Move the Brush node's 'Background' parameter to be its primary input

review.reason: Moves the Brush node's Background parameter to a primary input in Graphite's node graph so the bounding box can be computed at compile time.
review.varveAssessment: Node parameters and primary inputs do not exist in Varve.

title: Use a texture sampler instead of looping over pixels in the Blend node (and others)

review.reason: Needs Graphene texture samplers inside GPU node kernels; Varve has no GPU node graph and its image sampling lives in the compositor and effects code.
review.varveAssessment: No Graphene kernel or texture sampler pipeline exists in Varve.

title: Add a sharp/smooth anchor toggle to the Path tool

review.reason: Varve's NodeEditTool converts selected points between corner and smooth modes, which covers the sharp/smooth conversion this issue requests.
review.varveAssessment: Point-type conversion already exists in node editing.

title: Brush tool should allow per-stroke brush options

review.reason: Varve brush strokes are rasterized into the layer as they are painted and brush settings are applied while painting, so there is no Brush node whose parameters could be re-edited nondestructively.
review.varveAssessment: The raster brush model already matches the per-stroke behaviour requested.

title: Make a GPU version of the Blend node

review.reason: GPU version of Graphite's Blend node, closed by #1243.
review.varveAssessment: No Blend node or GPU node kernels exist in Varve.

title: Migrate Imaginate code out of JS, into the node graph itself

review.reason: Moves Graphite's Imaginate generative-AI code into its node graph.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node graph and no Imaginate-style generative backend.

title: Set up infrastructure for integrating canvases into the rendered SVG

review.reason: Adds canvas elements to Graphite's SVG viewport renderer.
review.varveAssessment: Varve renders to a canvas directly and has no SVG viewport renderer.

title: Remove JS roundtrip for displaying images

review.reason: Removes the JS round-trip Graphite used to display images in its SVG renderer.
review.varveAssessment: No JS-to-SVG image round-trip exists in Varve.

title: Image Frame and Imaginate Frame don't work in release builds

review.reason: Graphite node-graph frames failing to rasterize in release builds; the diagnosis is in Graphite's wasm and frontend canvas code.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's release build has no node-graph frame rasterizer.

title: Revamp the Graphite website

review.reason: Revamp of Graphite's marketing website content and design, which is Graphite branding rather than an editor capability.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's website is separate and not affected by Graphite's redesign.

title: Tools lose updates when drawing quickly due to async graph

review.reason: Varve tools consume pointer input directly in the editor and mutate the document without an async graph evaluation, so fast drawing cannot drop updates waiting on a graph result.
review.varveAssessment: Pen/path input is handled synchronously in the tool layer.

title: Display node graph errors to the user

review.reason: Surfaces node-graph evaluation errors to the user via Graphite's footer bar.
review.varveAssessment: There are no node-graph errors to display in Varve.

title: Node to rasterize vector graphics

review.reason: Adds a node that rasterizes vector graphics using Graphite's arbitrary canvas render targets from #1256.
review.varveAssessment: Rasterization in Varve happens in the engine and compositor, not as a graph node.

title: Perspective skew on the transform cage

review.reason: Perspective skew on the transform cage needs projective (homogeneous) transforms and rational Bezier output; Varve's scene transform model is 2D affine, so this depends on a missing transform capability.
review.varveAssessment: The transform cage and affine transform model would have to gain projective transforms first.

title: Redo bug causes canvas output to break

review.reason: Varve undo/redo restores immutable document snapshots through the persistent revision store and the renderer derives its frame from the restored document, so stale canvas references cannot survive a redo.
review.varveAssessment: Undo/redo render integrity is snapshot-based in Varve.

title: Cannot export artwork with embedded canvas

review.reason: Varve export flattens the document through the engine and exportNodeToSvg rather than reading pixels back from an embedded DOM canvas, so a tainted-canvas export failure cannot occur.
review.varveAssessment: The export path is engine-based and does not depend on DOM canvas readback.

title: Fix the Image Frame node

review.reason: Fixes Graphite's Image Frame/Input Frame node and depends on the rasterize node tracked in #1270.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no image-frame node to repair.

title: Better node insertion dropdown

review.reason: Improves the node-insertion dropdown in Graphite's node-graph panel.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node palette or node-graph panel.

title: Prevent the document from getting zoomed out of view

review.reason: Varve bounds zoom with a fixed MIN_ZOOM of 0.001 (0.1%) in packages/shared/src/viewport.ts, which is not relative to the document bounds, so a small artwork can still be zoomed smaller than one viewport pixel as described here.
review.varveAssessment: The shared camera zoom clamp would need a document-bounds-relative floor.

title: Holding a key makes cursor drift from target being dragged

review.reason: Varve computes drags from live pointer positions in direct-manipulation tools with no async graph round-trip, so holding a modifier cannot desynchronise the dragged object; Graphite fixed its version via #1420.
review.varveAssessment: Tool drag handling is pointer-driven and already immune to this cause.

title: Issue Calculating Offsets/Normals for Linear Curves in `bezier-rs`

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's bezier-rs offset/normal behaviour and was withdrawn by the reporter as a plotting-axis scaling artefact rather than a library defect.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve defect is described and Varve does not use bezier-rs.

title: Experiment with rendering to a canvas directly to bypass the CPU

review.reason: Varve already replays engine IR directly to Canvas2D (with opt-in WebGPU) instead of building an SVG/DOM scene, which is the architectural direction of this experiment.
review.varveAssessment: The canvas-direct render path already exists.

title: Allow reuse of buffers between multiple nodes

review.reason: Reuses GPU buffers between Graphite node-graph evaluations in Graphene.
review.varveAssessment: No node-graph evaluation buffers exist in Varve.

title: Make storage of instances, compiled shaders, buffers, pipelines, compute passes cached to allow for reuse across evaluations

review.reason: Caches GPU instances, shaders, pipelines and compute passes across Graphite node-graph evaluations.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no GPU node-graph evaluator.

title: Use textures for image storage

review.reason: Stores images as GPU textures in the Graphene pipeline.
review.varveAssessment: Image storage in Varve is not a GPU graph concern.

title: Rewrite the Brush node to use the GPU and adaptive resolution system

review.reason: Rewrites Graphite's Brush node on the GPU and adaptive-resolution system.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's brush is a direct paint tool, not a Graphite-style Brush node.

title: Support document nodes with parameters as extract sources for GPU

review.reason: Supports document nodes with parameters as extract sources for GPU compute in Graphene.
review.varveAssessment: No extract or GPU node compilation exists in Varve.

title: Make textures usable in compute shaders

review.reason: Makes textures usable inside Graphene compute shaders.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no compute-shader node system.

title: Deploy the compilation server

review.reason: Deploys Graphite's Graphene shader compilation server.
review.varveAssessment: No shader compilation service is part of Varve.

title: Add nodes for updating existing buffers

review.reason: Adds nodes that update existing GPU buffers.
review.varveAssessment: No GPU buffer node system exists in Varve.

title: Investigate flickering issue when dragging images around when using the Render Texture node

review.reason: Flickering with Graphite's Render Texture node, which Graphite no longer maintains.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no Render Texture node.

title: Enable texture filtering

review.reason: Texture filtering in Graphite's Graphene/Vello rendering pipeline.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's compositor samples through Canvas2D/WebGPU and has no Graphene texture pipeline.

title: MVP adaptive resolution system

review.reason: MVP of Graphene's adaptive-resolution system.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's adaptive residency is a different subsystem and unaffected.

title: Extend Node macro to accept lamda nodes as input

review.reason: Extends Graphite's Node macro so lambda nodes can be passed as inputs.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node macro codegen.

title: Several menu elements should be not be enabled when no documents are opened

review.reason: Varve's menubar belongs to the per-document editor shell, so document-scoped commands are not presented when no document is open, and unavailable actions carry disabledReason.
review.varveAssessment: Menu availability is scoped to an open editor session.

title: Make arrow key nudge-resizing operate in document space

review.reason: Varve's nudge planner works in document space (commands/nudge.ts plans a document-space nudge), so viewport zoom cannot leak into nudge-resize geometry.
review.varveAssessment: Keyboard nudging and nudge-resizing are document-space in Varve.

title: Select all points in path tool

review.reason: Whether Ctrl+A while the node-edit tool is active selects all anchors in Varve without changing layer selection is not established; the packet describes a path-tool-specific select-all.
review.varveAssessment: Node-edit select-all behaviour would need checking.

title: Snapping options dropdown

review.reason: Varve exposes snapping preferences (snapToObjects, snapToPages, snapToGuides, snapTolerancePx) in the Document panel and persists them in viewport settings.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping options already have a settings surface.

title: Completely frozen after adding something in a big file

review.reason: Varve has a crash-reporting and recovery core (@varve/crash) plus a persistent revision store and lifecycle recovery, which is the crash dialog and work-loss protection this report asks for.
review.varveAssessment: Crash detection, reporting and recovery are already implemented.

title: Using Undo on a Pen path should undo the nodes individually

review.reason: Ctrl+Z on a partially drawn pen path removing the whole path is the same finding Graphite tracks in #971, and this issue was closed as its duplicate.
review.varveAssessment: Pen-tool undo granularity would be the comparable Varve area.

title: Fix recent Imaginate breakages

review.reason: A checklist of repairs to Graphite's Imaginate generative-AI layer, including its generation service, masks and polling.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no Imaginate-style generative layer.

title: Path points persist on screen after deleted

review.reason: Varve enforces that previously painted pixels are always replaced by a fresh frame (full-redraw fallback plus the __varvePerf.forceFullRedraw oracle), which is the stale-overlay class reported here.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas invalidation already falls back to a full redraw.

title: Chromium PWA white window frame does not respect system dark theme

review.reason: The Chromium PWA titlebar colour is browser/OS chrome outside the editor; Varve's desktop shell is Tauri and its browser build is not an installed PWA.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface controls a Chromium PWA window frame.

title: Add local font selection for supported browsers and desktop

review.reason: Varve's font loader implements the Local Font Access API (queryLocalFonts) with a capability check and fallback font list in the engine and platform layers.
review.varveAssessment: Local font selection and its unsupported-browser fallback already exist.

title: [Crash Report] changing the font size rapidly caused panic at 'FontInput update does not have a fontFamily'

review.reason: The crash requires layout to run with an unresolved font family; whether Varve's text pipeline can reach that state during rapid font-size edits is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Text layout/font resolution during font-size editing would be the affected area.

title: Add option to export SVG and PNG with transparent background

review.reason: Varve's export already supports a transparent background (exportNodeToSvg accepts background 'transparent' and rasterizeOptions defaults to transparent).
review.varveAssessment: Transparent PNG/SVG export is already available.

title: Can draw path point on top of vertical scroll bar

review.reason: Varve's canvas is a pan/zoom surface with no overlaid document scrollbar, and pointer handling is scoped to the canvas element, so a click cannot add a path point on a scrollbar.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas pointer targeting has no scrollbar overlap.

title: Holding space whilst dragging gets stuck transforming canvas

review.reason: In Varve a camera or tool gesture ends on pointerup/pointercancel in BaseTool, so releasing Space before the mouse cannot leave the camera stuck in pan mode.
review.varveAssessment: Pan gesture lifetime is bound to the pointer, not the Space key.

title: Dropdown button for rotating camera

review.reason: Varve exposes Rotate View Clockwise and Rotate View Counter-clockwise in the View menu with registered shortcuts, giving the requested discoverable rotation control.
review.varveAssessment: Camera rotation is already a menu action.

title: Feature: Eraser tool

review.reason: Varve has an eraser tool and paint/eraser brush settings in its paint toolset.
review.varveAssessment: Eraser functionality already exists.

title: Hints for changing brush tool size

review.reason: Whether Varve's hint/status bar advertises the brush-size shortcuts is not established; the shortcut registry and hint bar exist but the packet gives no Varve evidence.
review.varveAssessment: Hint bar content for the brush tool would need checking.

title: Add new node by dragging link into blank space

review.reason: Creates a node by dragging a link into empty node-graph space.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node graph wires.

title: Rearrange Pan/Tilt/Zoom features for better discoverability

review.reason: Varve's navigation is pan/zoom/rotate with its own bindings and no tilt camera, so the specific Pan/Tilt/Zoom reorganisation does not map directly; discoverability would need a UI review.
review.varveAssessment: View menu and navigation bindings would be the affected area.

title: Duplicated nodes do not inherit exposed values

review.reason: Duplicated nodes losing exposed values when an exposed input is connected, in Graphite's node graph.
review.varveAssessment: Varve nodes are scene layers without graph-exposed inputs.

title: problem with avast antivirus

review.reason: An antivirus vendor blacklisting Graphite's editor URL is an external reputation listing, not a software capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path is involved.

title: [Crash Report] Fresh repository clone crashes

review.reason: A fresh Graphite development clone crashing through wasm/JS interop, fixed in Graphite's own repository via #1382.

review.varveAssessment: Node-graph cycles do not exist in Varve.

title: The Path tool's box selection crashes after a layer was deleted

review.reason: The Graphite crash was an unwrap on a layer deleted before the path-tool marquee rendered; whether Varve's selection overlay can dereference a stale node id after a delete is unverified.

title: Tracking Issue: Document graph migration MVP

review.reason: Tracking issue for Graphite's document-graph migration MVP, listing node-graph migration tasks.

title: Pressure-sensitive drawing with pen tablets

review.reason: Varve's PaintTool consumes PointerEvent pressure and tilt through pressureForDrawingInput with a configurable pressure curve and pressure-enabled setting.
review.varveAssessment: Pressure and tilt tablet input is already wired into painting.

title: Only LMB double-click inputs can be bound to hotkeys

review.reason: Whether Varve's shortcut/binding model can bind RMB or MMB double-click (not just LMB) is not established by the provided context.
review.varveAssessment: Input mapping and shortcut bindings would be the affected area.

title: Redesign the dialogs

review.reason: Varve's dialogs are built on its own dialog/overlay system and design tokens, so Graphite's dialog redesign mockup has no direct counterpart to apply.

title: When deleting a node, the upstream/downstream links should be reconnected

review.reason: Reconnects upstream and downstream links when a node is deleted in Graphite's node graph.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no node links to reconnect.

title: [improvement] Addition of More Donation Options

review.reason: Expands project funding channels (cards, crypto, Patreon and so on), which is project operations rather than an editor capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve application surface is affected.

title: Add a View > Rulers toggle to disable rulers

review.reason: Varve has a View > Rulers & Grids menu entry and a per-workspace canvasOverlays.rulers visibility setting.

title: Dragging vector points with Path tool should use absolute positions

review.reason: Varve tools derive point positions from the current pointer position rather than accumulating deltas across asynchronous evaluations, so the drift and float-accumulation cause described does not apply; Graphite closed it as the same class as #1284.

title: Configure automations to request build links on PRs

title: 32bit floating. 16bit floating. support? and 16bit integers. 32bit integer. Is it really lossless? None of this is mentioned in the development roadmap.

title: support for modern color models OkLab and HCL/Lch. the ancient RGB color model is very outdated.

title: Unable to rotate document

title: Changing the sides for a polygon and then dragging broken

review.reason: The bug is that an uncommitted polygon Sides value is ignored by the next drag; whether Varve's polygon tool options commit numeric edits before a drag starts is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Polygon tool options and number-field commit semantics would be affected.

title: Improve landing page content

review.reason: Critique and rewrite of Graphite's landing-page claims, mockup labelling and roadmap copy.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite's marketing content is unrelated to Varve.

title: Graphite on Smaller Screens and Keyboard Shortcuts

review.reason: Varve's toolbar uses responsive retention and overflow (essential tools and the active tool never collapse, with a sticky More control) and shortcuts are configurable; the Ctrl+W conflict is a browser-tab issue that Tauri's lifecycle coordinator does not have.
review.varveAssessment: Narrow-screen tool access and window close are already handled.

title: SVG Export a bit iffy

review.reason: Whether Varve's SVG export includes raster paint and bitmap content faithfully is not established; the Graphite report came mid-refactor and was closed by #1495.
review.varveAssessment: SVG export fidelity for raster/paint content would need checking.

title: Add the Mirror node

review.reason: Requests a Mirror node that mirrors vector data around the pivot in the node graph; Varve has no node graph or mirror node.
review.varveAssessment: No node exists to add; Varve's mirror-duplicate commands are a separate direct-manipulation path.

title: Crash when deleting all anchor points in a shape

review.reason: Varve deletes path anchors through deleteSelectedAnchorsFromPath, which returns null and announces when the contour would be invalidated instead of dividing by a zero-length subpath. The NodeEdit controls route every delete through that guard, so the bezier-rs modulo-by-zero crash has no equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the NodeEditTool and NodeEditControls anchor-deletion guard.

title: Brush lines have gaps

review.reason: Varve paints brushes by walking each pointer segment at the brush spacing (appendStrokePoints and interpolateStrokeSegment keep even spacing and never drop the segment end), so fast strokes cannot leave unsampled gaps. Graphite's residual cause was line antialiasing, which does not apply to Varve's coverage painting.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the brush stroke sampling in tools/brushStroke.ts and PaintTool.

title: Set up Rust-GPU CI automation

review.reason: Depends on Graphene's Rust-GPU node shader pipeline and its CI automation; Varve has no node graph and no GPU node shaders to build or test.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because the subsystem (node-graph GPU shaders) does not exist.

title: Allow NumberInput value to be dragged and right-click/escape to abort the drag

review.reason: NumberInput implements drag-to-scrub with Escape, pointercancel, window blur and unmount restoring the gesture-start value. The only unimplemented variant is right-click as an abort, since the press filter accepts button 0 only.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the shared NumberInput scrub implementation used by every Inspector numeric field.

title: Math in the number input boxes

review.reason: Varve's NumberInput accepts plain decimals only and commits with Number(), so an entered expression such as 120/2 or 50+25 is rejected. There is no expression parser on the commit path of Inspector value fields.
review.varveAssessment: Affects every numeric Inspector field (X/Y/W/H, rotation, spacing, stroke width) through @varve/ui NumberInput.

title: Stretch and tilt ruler increments when canvas is tilted

review.reason: Varve rulers derive tick positions by projecting world coordinates through the rotation-aware camera (visibleWorldSpanOnRulerEdge, projectWorldXToTopEdge) and rotate labels by cameraRotation, so increments stay correct under canvas tilt. Only the cosmetic tick-tilt and the 45-degree axis swap are not implemented.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by packages/editor/src/components/Ruler/Ruler.tsx, which measures in world space.

title: Text appears in the wrong place

review.reason: The root cause is Graphene's TransformSet being applied in document space instead of viewport space inside the node graph, plus artboard parenting of graph nodes. Varve has no transform node graph, and text insertion parents into the active frame (text-node-parenting and frame-parenting tests).
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because the defect lives in node-graph transform plumbing.

title: Fix displaying and editing layer/folder/artboard names in the Layers panel

review.reason: Layer rename is an inline input in LayersRow with an unnamed-layer placeholder and explicit commit and Escape-cancel paths, so empty or missing names render as a placeholder instead of crashing. There is no separate legacy artboard layer path.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the LayersPanel row rename implementation.

title: Find and replace all magic number node parameter indexes with ::INDEX const

review.reason: Graphite-internal refactor replacing magic node parameter indexes with ::INDEX constants in Graphene's Rust node registry. Varve has no node parameter index system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code is affected; the task is Graphene-internal code hygiene.

title: Menu lists like font selection should be searchable

review.reason: Varve's long lists are searchable controls: FontBrowser and DocumentFontsPanel expose a searchbox over family, face and location, and @varve/ui Combobox, Select and SearchField provide filtering. Menu actions are covered by the command palette.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the font browser search field and the shared Combobox/Select primitives.

title: Document > Clear Artboards should not delete its children

review.reason: Varve has no Clear Artboards command; frames and pages are ordinary containers whose children are removed with them (removeNode cascades) while ungroupNode preserves children. Whether Varve wants a dump-artwork-without-frames command, and what its child semantics should be, is an open product decision.
review.varveAssessment: Touches frame/group container semantics in packages/scene/src/document-nodes.ts, but no equivalent command exists to fix.

title: Smarter placement of layers into the artboards that bound them

review.reason: New shapes parent to the frame under the pointer (frame-parenting tests), drag-release reparents into frames and pages in SelectTool, and paste resolves its destination from the selection or the paste centre via resolvePasteDestination. The remaining Graphite sub-items around the Layers panel new-folder button are UI placement details.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by frame parenting in tools/SelectTool.ts and context paste destination resolution.

title: Selected folders incorrectly have a zero-size bounding box

review.reason: Container bounds are unioned from descendant occurrence geometry, and occurrenceGeometry explicitly recomputes ancestor unions when a child moves. Selecting a group or frame therefore yields a real transform cage rather than a zero-size box.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by packages/editor/src/scene/occurrenceGeometry.ts and the SelectionOverlay cage.

title: Make all nodes stackable and generalize layers as stacked Merge nodes

review.reason: Requires Graphene node metadata and generalising layers into stackable Merge/Composite nodes. Varve composites through scene paint order plus adjustment layers and has no convertible node-layer concept.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the node-layer model does not exist.

title: Reimplement the Imaginate node and tool

review.reason: Rebuild of the Imaginate generative node against Graphite's unified node graph with a rasterisation frame. Varve has no such node and does not ship generative image nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; there is no node graph to host the tool.

title: Remove adaptive resolution system

review.reason: Removal of Graphene's Footprint adaptive-resolution system inside node evaluation. Varve has no footprint-driven node evaluation; resolution adaptation lives in the render pipeline and worker residency.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the Footprint system is Graphene-specific.

title: Remove remain dependancy

review.reason: Removal of the Rust remain crate and its enum-ordering checks from Graphite's workspace. This is a Graphite-internal dependency and lint decision.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code is affected; Varve does not depend on remain.

title: Add a coherent noise node (Perlin, Voronoi, etc.)

review.reason: Requests a coherent-noise node (Perlin, Voronoi) in the node graph. Varve is a direct-manipulation application with no procedural node system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; procedural nodes are an explicit non-goal.

title: Remove document-legacy

review.reason: Deletion of Graphite's document-legacy module. This is Graphite-internal code removal with no user-facing behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Remove legacy layers

review.reason: Porting and deleting Graphite's legacy layer code so document-legacy can be removed. Varve's layer model is the scene graph (pages, frames, groups) with no legacy layer format.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the legacy layer codebase does not exist.

title: Remove references to LayerId and Vec<u64> layer paths

review.reason: Removal of LayerId and Vec of u64 layer paths from Graphite's Rust document types. Graphite-internal identifier refactor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Autoscroll when mouse is outside viewport and dragging

review.reason: Canvas edge auto-pan is implemented in tools/autoPan.ts and driven from inputPipeline for any recorded pointer gesture, with velocity proportional to pointer proximity inside a 40 CSS px edge zone. Dragging past the viewport edge therefore scrolls the camera instead of stopping.
review.varveAssessment: Covered centrally by tools/autoPan.ts plus the canvas input pipeline, so every drag tool inherits it.

title: Crash when dragging stroke weight

review.reason: Graphite closed this as unreproducible and suspected it was the same crash as its node-graph race. Varve stroke-weight fields are NumberFields feeding stroke width with no Rust unreachable path, but the packet contains no Varve reproduction or regression evidence.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the Inspector stroke-width NumberField and engine stroke rendering, but no defect is demonstrated.

title: Dragging layers sharing a transform node applies multiple translations

review.reason: Requires Graphene layers that share a single transform node and a per-layer transform search during drag. Varve applies one delta per authored node, and instances share the node itself rather than a transform node, so the multiple-application defect cannot arise.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the shared-transform-node structure is node-graph specific.

title: Add origin to the Transform node (and visualize it with an overlay)

review.reason: Transform-node pivot and reference-point redesign inside Graphene, including node overlays. Varve's transform is a per-node affine manipulated by tools, not a node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; there is no Transform node.

title: Frontend types and error reporting from the node graph UI

review.reason: Frontend type reporting and generics display for the node graph UI. Varve has no node graph frontend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Tracking Issue: Adaptive resolution system improvements

review.reason: Tracking issue for Graphene's adaptive resolution system, moved to another Graphite issue. Varve has no equivalent subsystem.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Rework constant folding?

review.reason: Constant folding, graph compilation caching and shader compile-time evaluation in Graphene. Varve evaluates no user-authored node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Customizing shortcuts

review.reason: Shortcuts are data-driven: ShortcutManager persists per-action overrides (strata-shortcut-overrides) with getBinding and reset, and Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts plus ShortcutPalette surface them. Defaults come from the registry rather than hardcoded handlers.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by packages/editor/src/shortcuts/ShortcutManager.ts and the ShortcutPalette.

title: Tracking Issue: Tablet/stylus support

review.reason: Stylus input is normalised end-to-end in tools/inputNormalizer.ts (pressure, tiltX/Y, twist, tangential pressure, contact ellipse, altitude and azimuth, eraser end, predicted events, WebKitGTK workarounds) with pressure enable and curve in DrawingInputSettingsTab.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the input normaliser and pointer dynamics used by brush and vector freehand tools.

title: Graph UI links disappear

review.reason: Bug in Graphite's Svelte Graph.svelte connection rendering inside the node graph UI. Varve is React and has no node graph UI.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Allow the Freehand tool to append to an existing layer's path

review.reason: PenTool continues an existing path node (continuePathId plus continuationBasePointCount), so a stroke can extend an already-authored path from its endpoint. The pencil tool does not join, but the append workflow exists.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by path continuation in tools/PenTool.ts.

title: Add ability to break a closed curve to be open

review.reason: NodeEditControls can open or close a whole contour, but there is no break-at-anchor: deleting a selected anchor goes through deleteSelectedAnchorsFromPath, which either reconnects neighbours or refuses. A closed ring therefore cannot be cut open at a chosen point.
review.varveAssessment: Affects node editing in tools/NodeEditTool.ts and components/NodeEditControls.tsx.

title: Get CI to check if demo artwork renders successfully

review.reason: Varve has golden replay hash tests for render items and canvas Playwright specs, but the packet gives no evidence about whether bundled templates or demo documents are render-checked in CI. Whether an equivalent template smoke test exists was not verified.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch engine golden tests and CI selection rather than a user-facing workflow.

title: Node panics shouldn't bring down the editor

review.reason: Sandboxing Graphene node evaluation in panic handlers or a worker so one bad node cannot take down the editor. Varve's render worker and error boundaries do not evaluate a user-authored graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; there is no graph executor to sandbox.

title: Hide any nodes that are erroring so the remaining graph still renders

review.reason: Suppressing erroring nodes in the node graph so the remaining graph still renders. Varve has no per-node error state to propagate.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Selecting two handles with the Path tool creates oddity that may crash the software

review.reason: Varve node editing keeps a selectedAnchors set with index-remapped updates after inserts and deletes, so selecting two handles and dragging moves both anchors instead of indexing a single-element buffer.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by multi-anchor selection in NodeEditTool and the remap helpers.

title: Node to morph between shapes

review.reason: Shape morphing already exists as path-vertex interpolation in @varve/shared interpolation.ts, which pads the shorter path by duplicating its last vertex, and colours interpolate alongside. It is driven by motion keyframes rather than a node.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by motion keyframe interpolation; slider-driven procedural blendshapes are not a Varve concept.

title: Stuck layer in layer tree when aborting with tool

review.reason: Tool drafts are not layer-tree entries, and abortTransaction restores the pre-gesture document snapshot without recording history, so Escape-aborting a shape cannot leave a ghost row.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by context/useHistory.ts abortTransaction and draft-based tool rendering.

title: Random crashes at unexpected times when interacting with viewport

review.reason: The crash is inside Graphene's DynAnyNode type-erased evaluation (a Footprint value where EditorApi was expected). Varve has no interpreted node graph whose input types can be corrupted.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: Same DynAnyNode and node-registry panic class as the canonical crash issue, which Graphite triage called a duplicate. This report adds a first-time-user context of dragging a pentagon anchor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the crash is in node-graph evaluation.

title: [Crash Report] Using only Spline Tool

review.reason: Same DynAnyNode incorrect-type panic (VectorData versus DVec2) in the graph executor, reported from the Spline tool and fixed in the same build as the canonical crash. Its own reproduction detail is drawing a multi-point spline after choosing a colour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the crash is in node-graph evaluation.

title: Combine Channels connects to wrong input

review.reason: Input-port ordering and connection-line rendering bugs in the node graph UI. Varve has no node graph and no ports to mis-order.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Path tool sliding point insertion

review.reason: NodeEditTool inserts a point at the clicked position on the segment (insertPointOnPath with the hit ring, segment index and t), so there is no fixed midpoint insertion that would need a slide-to-position follow-up.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the path insertion path in tools/NodeEditTool.ts and NodeEditControls.

title: New node: Poisson-disk sampling of points on shapes

review.reason: Poisson-disk point sampling requested as a Graphene node. Varve has no point-sampling node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: [Crash Report] Poisson-disk sampling crashes when using a particular Pen tool shape

review.reason: Capacity overflow inside bezier-rs poisson_disk_sample when a node-graph shape is transformed to an enormous extent. Varve has no poisson sampler and no node graph feeding it.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Spelling typo : accessability --> accessibility

review.reason: Spelling fix in Graphite's website feature content. This is Graphite's marketing site, not Varve.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: On the Timeline and animation curves feature

review.reason: Varve's motion timeline exports CSS and Lottie from keyframes (motion P4 export pipeline), which covers the animation-export direction in this question. SMIL specifically is not offered.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the motion export path (ExportDialog plus CSS and Lottie exporters).

title: Overlays are drawn fuzzily from antialiasing

review.reason: Selection, handle and guide overlays render as SVG (SelectionOverlay.tsx, GuideOverlay.tsx), so the raster sampling that produced fuzzy antialiased overlays on Graphite's canvas has no equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by SVG-based overlay rendering rather than a raster overlay canvas.

title: Asset database

review.reason: Document-level content-addressed assets already exist: image bytes are stored once in Document.assets and fills reference them by assetId (packages/scene/src/assets.ts). That is the requested asset database accessed by id.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the document asset store and ImageFillData assetId references.

title: Design a user-facing textual grammar for Graphene nodes and networks

review.reason: Designing a textual grammar or DSL for Graphene node networks. Varve has no node network to serialise.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Incremental graph compilation

review.reason: Incremental compilation of Graphene node graphs. Varve evaluates no user-authored graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Spatial (resolution-aware and context-aware) caching

review.reason: Resolution-aware and context-aware caching for Graphene's Footprint-based node evaluation, including time and context flag propagation. No equivalent subsystem exists in Varve.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; render caching works on scene subtrees, not graph contexts.

title: Progress, aborting, and streamed results for long-running async nodes

review.reason: Progress reporting, abort and streamed intermediate results for async nodes in the graph executor. Varve's long-running native jobs (image trace, upscale, background removal) already report progress and support cancellation, but this issue targets node execution semantics.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected by the node-executor design; job progress and cancellation already exist for the equivalent native jobs.

title: Store references, not implementations, for document nodes

review.reason: Storing references to DocumentNodeDefinitions instead of copies of them inside Graphene documents. Varve has no node definitions.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Node versioning and package management system

review.reason: Node versioning and a node package manager for Graphene document nodes and subgraphs. Varve has no node packages or marketplace.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Hide the cull node from the user

review.reason: Hiding and integrating Graphene's Cull and Sample nodes. Varve has no cull or sample nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Improve docs and developer experience for working with the adaptive resolution system

review.reason: Developer documentation and macros for writing adaptive-resolution Graphene nodes. Graphite-internal developer experience.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Box selection in the node graph

review.reason: Box selection inside the node graph canvas. Varve has no node graph canvas.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Bidirectional type inference

review.reason: Hindley-Milner or bidirectional type inference for Graphene's typed node ports. Varve has no typed dataflow graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Crash when using mouse's forward/backward navigation keys

review.reason: The canvas input pipeline consumes mouse back and forward buttons (3 and 4) by preventing default and ending the contact before tool dispatch, so no invalid modifier state reaches a tool and the browser cannot navigate.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by canvas/inputPipeline.ts side-button interception.

title: Avoid layers being reordered when dealing with groups

review.reason: groupNodes sorts selected siblings by their existing index and inserts the group into the topmost selected layer's slot, and ungroupNode splices children back at the group's index while preserving world transforms. Grouping and ungrouping therefore cannot reshuffle the stack.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by packages/scene/src/document-nodes.ts groupNodes and ungroupNode.

title: Bezier-rs function to compute subpath centroid and area

review.reason: Requests a bezier-rs library function for subpath centroid and area. This is Graphite's own computational-geometry library API, not a Varve subsystem or user workflow.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve does not consume bezier-rs.

title: Transform node crashes app when scale == 0

review.reason: Varve clamps scale to at least 0.01 in ScaleTool, and the affine inverse helpers return identity or null on singular matrices (invertAffine, tryInvertAffine) instead of asserting. A zero scale therefore cannot panic the transform path.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by scale clamping and guarded matrix inversion in @varve/shared and ScaleTool.

title: Prod build appears stuck using latest release.

review.reason: Stuck wasm-pack and Vite production builds in Graphite's own toolchain, plus missing local prerequisites. This is Graphite build tooling, not a Varve product defect.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Document > Clear Artboards isn't given an undo history step

review.reason: Varve has no Clear Artboards equivalent, so the swallowed undo step cannot be reproduced as described. General undo integrity is covered by the transaction-aware history, but a frame-clearing command would need its own transaction review if added.
review.varveAssessment: Would concern context/useHistory.ts transaction boundaries if such a command existed.

title: Support rounded corners with the Rectangle node

review.reason: Corner radius and squircle smoothing are first-class shape properties with Inspector controls, and the render IR carries cornerRadius through roundRect. Rounded rectangles do not require manual bezier approximation.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by shape corner-radius and squircle properties in the scene model and Inspector.

title: Layers lose their names when grouped

review.reason: groupNodes reparents existing nodes into a new group and never recreates them, so names and every other node property survive grouping and ungrouping.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by reparent-based grouping in packages/scene/src/document-nodes.ts.

title: Disconnected layers get left behind when deleting/ungrouping their parents

review.reason: removeNode collects and removes every descendant of the target, and ungroupNode moves all children to the parent before deleting the group. Orphaned children cannot be left behind.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by descendant-cascading removeNode and child-preserving ungroupNode.

title: All drag actions should be cancellable with Esc/RMB

review.reason: Drag cancellation is central rather than per-tool: canvas key handling calls handlePointerCancel (which reaches onDragCancel) for the active gesture before clearing selection, and pointercancel follows the same path. Right-click is the canvas context menu instead of an abort.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the BaseTool drag contract plus Escape handling in canvas/inputPipeline.ts.

title: Aborted Transactions are saved in Redo history

review.reason: abortTransaction restores the transaction snapshot in place and touches neither the undo nor the redo stack, so an aborted gesture never becomes a redo entry and never evicts history.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by context/useHistory.ts begin/commit/abort transaction split.

title: Artboard tool doesn't have snapping implemented

review.reason: FrameTool draws from BaseTool.computeDragRect, which applies only Shift and Alt modifiers and never consults the snap pass, so frame edges cannot snap to objects, guides, grid or page bounds even though the select tool's snapping exists.
review.varveAssessment: Affects tools/FrameTool.ts frame drawing against the snapping engine in tools/snapping.ts.

title: Some tools send DocumentMessage::Undo instead of DocumentMessage::AbortTransaction when Aborting

review.reason: abortTransaction is a distinct context API from undo, and pointer tools (PaintTool, ScaleTool, ShapeBuilderTool, HealingBrushTool and others) call it on cancel, so aborting a gesture never records a history step.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the transaction API in context/useHistory.ts and tool cancel handlers.

title: Fix regressions with vector nodes needing to pre-apply their transforms

review.reason: Pre-applying transforms inside Graphene vector nodes (Repeat, Sample Points, Poisson-Disk Points) so they compose with the graph's transform flow. Varve has no vector nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Drop shadow effect

review.reason: Drop shadow is a first-class effect in the engine (RenderItem effects type dropShadow) with offset, blur, spread and blend-mode handling plus replay tests. A document-wide light source concept does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the live-effects drop-shadow implementation and its replay tests.

title: Ungrouping nested folders at once deletes some layers

review.reason: Ungrouping goes through ungroupNode, which moves every child into the parent before removing the group, and removal cascades through descendants. Nested ungroups therefore cannot drop layers.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by ungroupNode and recursive removeNode.

title: Convex Hull node

review.reason: Convex or concave hull requested as a Graphene node with a slider. Varve has boolean and path geometry but no node graph to host such a node, and no hull operation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the request is framed entirely as a node.

title: Performing an undo right before cancelling a tool's drag action results in a doubled undo

review.reason: Varve separates undo from abortTransaction, but isInTransaction is exported and never consulted, so an undo pressed during an open gesture followed by Escape-abort would restore the pre-gesture snapshot and could silently discard that undo. Unverified without an interaction test.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect tool drag transactions in context/useHistory.ts and the canvas Escape path.

title: Refresh node graph when changing tabs

review.reason: Refreshing Graphite's node graph panel when switching document tabs. Varve has no node graph panel.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Crash when Pen tool's in-progress point snaps along an angle with its previous anchor

review.reason: PenTool.constrainPoint rebuilds the point as anchor plus length times cos/sin of the snapped angle, and a zero delta yields angle 0 with length 0, so snapping onto the previous anchor produces a zero-length segment instead of a normalise assertion.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by angle-constraint math in tools/PenTool.ts.

title: Audit and polish the hints bar across all tools, states, and actions

review.reason: Varve documents tools and panels through contextual help entries (onboard/ContextualHelp/helpContent.ts) plus ContextControlBar hints and toolbar tool options, so guidance exists per tool rather than in one hints bar.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the contextual help catalog and ContextControlBar hint surface.

title: API for Embeddable Library and to be used by AI editors

review.reason: Factoring out an embeddable libGraphite API for third-party and AI-editor use. This is Graphite product strategy for its backend, with no Varve workflow attached.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Add gradients to color picker

review.reason: Fill type selection covers linear, radial and conic gradients plus gradient maps with a dedicated GradientEditor and gradient presets, so gradients are chosen from the fill controls rather than needing to live inside the colour popover.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the gradient fill types, GradientEditor and presets library.

title: Safari rendering bug causes upward offset of tool shelf color picker

review.reason: The offset came from a WebKit bug triggered by container-type: size on Graphite's tool shelf. Varve's shelves use container-type: inline-size and their popovers are positioned by Floating UI and the native Popover API, and the WebKit report is fixed in Safari 18 per this thread.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because the trigger condition (container-type: size on the tool shelf) is absent.

title: Fix DPI display scaling to make overlays render at the native resolution

review.reason: Selection and guide overlays are SVG, and the canvas overlays that do exist scale by devicePixelRatio (Ruler, Liquify, OnionSkin, ColorBlindness, PresentationStage), while the main render pipeline scales by dpr times zoom. DPI scaling therefore does not blur overlays.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by DPR-aware canvas sizing in canvasSurface and renderPipeline plus SVG overlays.

title: Path tools should filter out snapping to the procedurally generated contents of its own layer

review.reason: NodeEditTool anchor drags do not run the scene snap pass at all; snap targets come only from node bounds, pages and guides (selectionSnapTargets). A path therefore cannot snap to its own procedurally derived geometry.
review.varveAssessment: Covered because node editing has no snapping targets; adding node-edit snapping would be a separate feature.

title: Using the procedural art engine as a library?

review.reason: Using Graphite's procedural node engine as an embeddable library inside games and other apps. Varve is a direct-manipulation application with no node engine to embed.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: AI models for graphics editing

review.reason: This is a broad machine-learning research wishlist rather than a concrete workflow defect. Varve already ships upscaling, background removal and vectorisation through its offline ONNX provider chain, and the packet says nothing about segmentation, depth or relighting requirements.
review.varveAssessment: Overlaps the existing @varve/ai and engine provider chain, but no specific Varve requirement is established.

title: Subpath::new_rect() creates cubic segments instead of linear segments

review.reason: Segment-type detail in bezier-rs Subpath::new_rect (cubic instead of linear segments). Varve shapes are parametric scene nodes, not bezier-rs subpaths.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve does not use bezier-rs.

title: Customising grid colour

review.reason: Grid colour is part of the grid model (GridBase.color and opacity) and is exposed as a Grid color popover in the Document Grid inspector section, so grid contrast against the canvas is user-controlled.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by DocumentGrid colour in packages/scene/src/gridTypes.ts and the DocumentPanel colour control.

title: Grid as dots

review.reason: A dot grid exists as a canvas overlay (dotGridEnabled renders editor-canvas grid-layer radial-gradient dots, enabled by the design and draw workspace canvasOverlays.dotGrid). The document grid itself has no dots display mode.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the workspace-driven dot-grid overlay; a per-grid dots mode is not implemented.

title: Further customisation of snapping

review.reason: Varve configures snapping per target class - objects, guides, pages, document grid, pixel grid, baseline and layout grid - with a tolerance field in the Document panel. That is finer-grained than Graphite's two binary switches.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the viewport snap preferences and their Inspector controls.

title: Show artboard names in viewport

review.reason: CanvasNameLabels renders screen-space names for the surfaces in the resolved scene scope above their bounds, including hovered and being-edited states.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by packages/editor/src/canvas/CanvasNameLabels.tsx.

title: Don't outline hovered layers when box selecting

review.reason: There is no competing hover outline to suppress: hover only feeds the knife and shape-builder overlays and the name labels, while the object marquee draws selectionPreview rectangles for the layers that would be selected (SelectionOverlay previewRects).
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the selection preview in SelectionOverlay and the absence of a hover outline.

title: Color::from_rgb_str() and Color::rgb_hex() inconsistency

review.reason: hexToRgb and rgbToHex both operate on the same sRGB 0-255 representation with no implicit gamma step on one side, and colour-space conversion is explicit in colorManagement. A hex round-trip is therefore stable.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the symmetric hex helpers in @varve/shared colorConversion.

title: Shape tools should allow modifying their drawn shapes

review.reason: Drawn shapes stay parametric: FloatingTransformTool provides move, scale and rotate handles including corner drags, and the Inspector exposes shape parameters such as corner radius, squircle smoothing, polygon sides and radius, and ellipse extents.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the floating transform tool plus Inspector shape parameters.

title: Alignment button options (align to artboard)

review.reason: AlignDistributeBar has an explicit alignment reference - selection, container, or page/canvas resolved by alignmentSurfaceKindFor - which is the requested align-to-artboard behaviour, alongside distribution controls.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the alignment reference selector and alignSelectionInDocument.

title: Folder issues in example artwork

review.reason: Two malformed folders inside Graphite's demo artwork files, fixed by hand-editing and re-saving the JSON. This is Graphite demo content and its file format, not a Varve defect.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: "Flip" view navigation button

review.reason: Varve's mirror function is a session-only production proof that deliberately disables canvas pointer input, and symmetry assists mirror the strokes rather than the view. There is no navigation-level view flip to paint against a reflected canvas.
review.varveAssessment: Affects canvas camera/navigation state and the pointer pipeline in CanvasArea and inputPipeline.

title: Fix Deep/Shallow selection regression

review.reason: SelectTool has an explicit deep-select path (InteractionContext.armDeepSelect and consumeDeepSelect consumed at pointer-down) plus a deep-selection menu, so deep versus shallow targeting is a deliberate hit policy rather than a toggle that regresses.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the hit policy and deep-select arming in tools/SelectTool.ts and InteractionContext.

title: Can't drag selected layers.

review.reason: The reported failure is transform-cage hit testing whose tolerance follows one axis of the selection's own transform scale. Varve's SelectionOverlay places fixed 24px resize targets (HANDLE_TARGET_HALF) at screen-space handle positions and culls handles in screen pixels via visibleHandles, so the object's aspect ratio cannot distort or supersede the drag targets.
review.varveAssessment: Transform cage hit testing lives in packages/editor/src/SelectionOverlay.tsx, which works in screen pixels rather than layer-transform space.

title: Caching the WASM using service workers

review.reason: The request is a service worker to cache the wasm payload, and the packet itself was closed as invalid because browsers already cache it and only revalidate it. Varve ships its wasm artifacts as ordinary static files under apps/desktop/public/wasm, so the same HTTP caching semantics apply and a service-worker layer adds nothing.
review.varveAssessment: Web/wasm asset delivery is plain static hosting, already covered by browser caching.

title: Audit and reclassify node catalog

review.reason: This is an audit of Graphite's node catalog: standardising node and parameter names, reclassifying categories, and enforcing node input invariants. Varve has no node graph and therefore no node catalog, categories, or graph-fed input invariants to reclassify.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; there is no node catalog.

title: Filled but open shapes don't have click targets for their fill
