review.reason: An open path with a fill has no click target in its filled interior, so clicking inside it selects nothing and fill-style operations cannot target it. Varve has the same gap: Shape::Path::contains in varve-core stroke-tests (segment distance with tolerance) when closed is false and only runs the compound fill test for closed paths, with packages/engine geometry mirroring that rule.
review.varveAssessment: Path hit testing in crates/varve-core/src/shape.rs and the mirrored shapeContains in packages/engine/src/geometry.ts.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: The stack trace comes from draw.fusestudio.net, a third-party deployment running an older embedded build, and the maintainer closed it as not an issue in editor.graphite.rs. Nothing in the report identifies a Varve workflow or code path.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; a third-party deployment crash is not a Varve surface.

title: Contravariance for node inputs with automatic coercion

review.reason: This is a Graphene type-system change: contravariant node inputs plus inserted coercion nodes to make the subtyping work at graph link time. Varve has no node type system, no graph linking, and no dynamic node compilation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; there is no node graph compiler.

title: Stable document format MVP

review.reason: Varve's document model is versioned data carried forward by explicit migrations (for example the additive presentation migration 2.30 to 2.31), persisted through the append-only revision store rather than through runtime handler structs. The remaining graph-specific asks (built-in node definitions stored by name, user sub-networks) have no Varve equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: Document schema versioning, migrations, and persistence in packages/scene already provide the migration infrastructure requested.

title: (Question) What is the Cargo package of the desktop client?

review.reason: The question was answered by documenting which package is the desktop client. Varve's equivalent split is documented: the Tauri app is apps/desktop, the native engine is crates/, and shared TypeScript is packages/, with Node required only to build the React/Vite frontend. A Cargo-only desktop package is not possible while the UI is a React frontend, so the maintainer's answer matches Varve's structure.
review.varveAssessment: Repo layout is documented in AGENTS.md and docs/development/setup.md, which answers the same question for Varve.

title: (Design suggestion) Replace GTK by a Rust GUI toolkit

review.reason: Varve's desktop UI is React inside a Tauri 2 webview, so there are no GTK widgets to replace; GTK3 and WebKitGTK are only the Linux webview dependency, as the maintainer explains here. Replacing the toolkit with egui or Iced would replace the entire frontend stack, which Varve does not intend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve UI subsystem is affected; the toolkit choice is settled by the Tauri decision.

title: BorrowTree inconsistency when closing and opening document

review.reason: The inconsistency is inside Graphene's DynamicExecutor borrow tree and its inputs_source_map when documents are reopened. Varve has no dynamic node executor or borrow tree.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Crash when selecting node with Widget::NumberInput in properties panel

review.reason: The bug is a pending, uncommitted text value in one node's numeric widget being applied to another node's widget after the selection changes. Varve's NumberField takes a draftKey target identity and clears the draft, error state, and in-flight arrow/wheel/scrub transactions whenever that key changes, so a typed value cannot cross into a different node's field.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector NumberField draft handling in packages/editor/src/components/Inspector/controls/NumberField.tsx.

title: A network's import cannot be connected directly to its export

review.reason: Connecting a network import directly to its export requires reworking Graphene's flatten_with_fns network flattening and its pseudo import/export nodes. Varve has no graph flattening stage or import/export nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Visualize data type wire and connector colors based on actual data

review.reason: Wire and connector colours are node-graph viewport UI derived from resolved graph data types. Varve has no node graph viewport, wires, or connectors.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Connector input index skips hidden inputs

review.reason: The defect is Graphite's frontend graph port indexing, where the clicked connector's index ignores hidden inputs so hiding an input shifts every index below it. Varve has no graph ports and no hidden-input concept.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Hidden inputs not added to BorrowTree inputs_source_map

review.reason: Hidden inputs missing from the BorrowTree inputs_source_map is a Graphene type-resolution detail; hiding an input is a graph UI concept. Varve does not resolve input types or maintain a source map.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Clicking a selected anchor should deselect all other selected points

review.reason: Clicking an already-selected anchor without Shift should collapse the selection to that single point. Varve's NodeEditTool.onPointerDown only replaces the selection when the hit anchor is not already selected, so clicking one of several selected anchors keeps all of them selected and the user still needs a deselect-all first.
review.varveAssessment: Path/node editing selection in packages/editor/src/tools/NodeEditTool.ts.

title: Move node graph interaction logic to backend

review.reason: Moving node graph interaction into the backend generalises Graphite's Svelte viewport interaction code. Varve's editor is React and has no graph interaction layer to generalise.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Pen's pressure

review.reason: Stylus pressure support exists in Varve's input path: PaintTool consumes normalised pressure from inputNormalizer for stroke dynamics. The packet also records this as a duplicate of #1403.
review.varveAssessment: Stylus input handling in packages/editor/src/tools/PaintTool.ts and inputNormalizer.ts.

title: Creating empty, infinite canvas causes error

review.reason: The error is an ambiguous graph implementation resolution between two RenderOutput node variants, and the follow-up concerns an empty artboard group from a disconnected Exports node. Varve renders pages and frames directly with no render-output node or graph output type.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; artboards are pages and frames, not graph outputs.

title: Cannot rearrange layers in infinite canvas

review.reason: The root cause given is that inserting layers as children of the document root was disabled, so infinite-canvas documents could not reorder layers. Whether Varve's layers panel allows drag or keyboard reorder at document root level is not established by the packet or by Varve's documented contracts.
review.varveAssessment: If it applies, the LayersPanel reorder path for root-level nodes would be the area to check.

title: planning for better handling of text & complex script languages

review.reason: The reported gaps are missing BiDi ordering, paragraph alignment, and font fallback for complex scripts. Varve's text pipeline implements UAX#9 BiDi layout, complex-script shaping including CJK, vertical writing, and text on path, so the RTL and glyph-joining defects shown here do not apply.
review.varveAssessment: Text shaping and layout in docs/architecture/text-pipeline.md and the engine layoutText path.

title: Improve snapping with alignment and distribution targets

review.reason: Varve's snapping module already snap-aligns object anchors, path anchors, corners, and line endpoints, and it has an equal-spacing distribution snap with its own priority tier. Explicit alignment and distribution commands exist as well.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping in packages/editor/src/tools/snapping.ts plus the align/distribute actions.

title: CLI fails to build cause tokio needs `rt-multi-thread` feature

review.reason: This is a missing Cargo feature flag in Graphene's CLI testing utility, which the maintainer describes as unmaintained and not user-facing. Varve has no graphene-cli crate or equivalent headless graph utility.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Remove the pivot from transforms

review.reason: Removing the pivot is a simplification of Graphite's graph Transform node and its render process, keeping the select tool crosshair as the interactive origin. Varve transforms are scene-node properties with their own transform origin and there is no node render process to simplify.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; transform origin is a scene-model property.

title: Fix boolean operations with several subpaths

review.reason: The defect came from Paper.js treating multi-subpath input as a single path. Varve's boolean engine works on compound regions (outer contours plus holes with a fill rule) and has an explicit regression test that compound input holes are respected rather than clipping only the outer contour.
review.varveAssessment: Boolean geometry in packages/scene/src/boolean/engine.ts and its tests.

title: Multi-input boolean operations supporting groups

review.reason: Varve's live booleans are a group whose direct children are the operands, supporting union, subtract, intersect, and exclude with a bounded nesting depth, and images are treated as shapes. Multi-shape and group input is the normal form rather than a separate node signature.
review.varveAssessment: Non-destructive booleans in packages/scene/src/liveBoolean.ts and boolean/integration.ts.

title: Snapped-together layers get permanently stuck together and unmoveable while snapping is enabled

review.reason: The reported bug required snapped offsets to be written into layer positions so layers could latch together. Varve's snapping is a per-frame resolution returning adjusted coordinates with hysteresis locks (stickyX/stickyY) released when the pointer leaves the target, and the drag commits once on release, so a selection cannot become permanently stuck.
review.varveAssessment: Snap resolution in packages/editor/src/tools/snapping.ts and the SelectTool drag lifecycle.

title: Node list shelf on the left side of the graph

review.reason: This asks for a node-category shelf inside the node graph for inserting nodes. Varve has no node graph and no node insertion UI.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Hints in the node graph

review.reason: Graph-specific hint text for the node graph canvas. Varve has no node graph view, so there are no node-graph hints to substitute; the packet records it fixed by #2415.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Stable element IDs instead of indexes in the graph

review.reason: Stable element ids are a Graphene Table<Graphic> row-identity problem, solved there inside ConcatElement and vector_new_ids_from_hash. Varve's identities are scene node ids, not graph table row ids.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Path nodes should be able to edit multiple vector table rows

review.reason: The Path (vector modify) node storing modifications per vector table row is Graphene-specific bookkeeping. Varve's node editing edits path geometry directly on the scene node, with no table rows to key by index.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Include graphic group transform in the boolean operation node

review.reason: Varve's live boolean resolves each operand through nodeWorldTransform, so a group transform is part of the operand geometry rather than being dropped by the operation.
review.varveAssessment: packages/scene/src/boolean/integration.ts resolves world transforms before the operation.

title: The Path tool should work on graphic tables as well as vector tables

review.reason: Editing child vector data of a Table<Graphic> from the Path tool depends on Graphene element ids and table rows, and the maintainer confirms it is blocked on unique element references. Varve has no graphic tables; groups are ordinary scene children.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Transform node on group

review.reason: This is a search rule for where to insert a Transform node above a group in the node graph. Varve has no graph insertion and no Transform node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Remove Select tool's double click on path to switch to Path tool

review.reason: Varve does have this behaviour: SelectTool.onDoubleClick on a path sets the active tool to nodeEdit. The packet gives no rationale for Graphite removing it (it points at Discord), so whether Varve should keep or remove its double-click-to-node-edit convention is a design decision rather than an established defect.
review.varveAssessment: SelectTool double-click handling in packages/editor/src/tools/SelectTool.ts.

title: Deep Select mode of the Select tool currently doesn't do anything

review.reason: Deep select exists in Varve as a modifier: SelectTool resolves the deepest hit target when Ctrl/Meta is held (pointerDownCtrl and pointerDownMeta), which is exactly the interaction the report confirms still worked in Graphite. Varve exposes it as a held modifier rather than a sticky mode.
review.varveAssessment: Selection depth handling in packages/editor/src/tools/SelectTool.ts.

title: Tables and attributes for graphical data

review.reason: Tables and attributes for graphical data are Graphene's data model (Instances, domains, attributes). Varve edits a direct scene graph with typed nodes and has no table/attribute layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Make a shape's Segment table use handles from the Point table

review.reason: Replacing SegmentDomain handles with a Curvature enum is a change to Graphene's vector tables. Varve's path segments store their curve data on the scene node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Tracking Issue: Instances tables

review.reason: This is the tracking issue for the Instances tables migration inside Graphene, down to individual multi-row node conversions. Varve has no Instances tables or node data model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Build the spreadsheet panel for visualizing table data

review.reason: A spreadsheet panel for visualising Graphene table data has no Varve counterpart; Varve has no tables or attributes to visualise.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Move PathStyle from VectorData to an attribute of the Region domain

review.reason: Moving PathStyle from VectorData onto the Region domain is a Graphene data-model change, and the packet records it superseded by #2003. Varve stores fills and strokes as ordered arrays on the node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Clean up the GraphicElement enum

review.reason: Cleaning up Graphene's GraphicElement enum into domain-and-attribute types is internal to the node engine. Varve has no GraphicElement enum and no domain model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Dehaze photo processing filter node

review.reason: Varve already ships a dehaze filter: the engine filter pipeline implements a dehaze kind and the Photo inspector's smart-filter catalog exposes it. The requested -100% to 100% haze removal is therefore present without a graph node.
review.varveAssessment: Engine filters in packages/engine/src/filters.ts plus smartFilterCatalog.ts in the Inspector.

title: Demo panic

review.reason: The panic came from opening a stored demo document written by an older save format, and the maintainers closed it as expected best-effort compatibility. Varve versions its document schema with explicit migrations and has a crash-recovery core with a RecoveryDialog and RecoveryManager, so stale stored documents are upgraded or recovered rather than panicking.
review.varveAssessment: Document migration and recovery (packages/crash, RecoveryDialog, RecoveryManager).

title: Tracking Issue: Vello integration

review.reason: Vello is Graphite's GPU vector renderer, and this is its integration tracking issue. Varve replays engine IR through a Canvas2D compositor with an opt-in experimental WebGPU path, so a Vello integration has no Varve counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; rendering is IR replay, not Vello.

title: Update Layers panel after layer selection changed, including opacity and group expand/collapse

review.reason: Varve's LayersPanel is a React tree subscribed to editor state, so a selection change re-renders opacity, names, and expanded groups from the same state. There is no imperative panel that must be told to refresh.
review.varveAssessment: Layers panel state flow in packages/editor/src/components/LayersPanel.

title: Gray out Vello setting if WebGPU is not available

review.reason: The request is to disable the Vello option when WebGPU is unavailable. Varve models accelerator capability stages (discovered, runtime-loadable, device-usable, execution-verified) with a Canvas2D fallback, but whether the renderer setting is disabled rather than silently falling back is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Renderer settings and accelerator capability reporting in the compositor settings path.

title: In the graph, duplicating with Ctrl+D doesn't show the new node until you move another node around

review.reason: A duplicated graph node not appearing until another node moves is node-graph canvas invalidation. Varve has no graph canvas or node duplication.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Images dragged in the editor get washed out every time the document is reloaded (gamma issue)

review.reason: An image must look identical after a save and reload, so a gamma or premultiplication mismatch on the persistence round trip is a colour-fidelity defect. Varve stores images through platform storage and colour-manages them, so the reload path needs that guarantee, and the packet gives no reproduction detail beyond the title.
review.varveAssessment: Image persistence and colour handling on the document load path.

title: Bezier-rs interactive demos not deploying on website

review.reason: The failure is that Graphite's bezier-rs interactive demo pages stopped deploying to its website. That is Graphite's own crate demo hosting, not a design-suite workflow; Varve's website is a separate Astro site.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Allow renaming documents by clicking on the document tab

review.reason: Varve has a multi-document TabStrip with select, close, keyboard focus, and a roving tabindex, but no in-place rename; renaming a file is only offered from the Home file grid context menu. Renaming the open document from its tab is therefore still missing.
review.varveAssessment: Document TabStrip in packages/editor/src/TabStrip.tsx.

title: Drag to rearrange document tabs

review.reason: TabStrip supports clicking, closing, arrow-key focus, and scrolling, but tabs have no drag handle, drag state, or reorder operation, so open documents cannot be rearranged by dragging. The packet records Graphite closing this with #3999.
review.varveAssessment: Tab ordering in packages/editor/src/TabStrip.tsx and the session list.

title: Fix Vello rendering of Bezier paths created by the Pen/Freehand/Spline tools

review.reason: Non-closed shapes being invisible is a Vello tessellation defect in Graphite's GPU renderer. Varve's Canvas2D IR replay strokes open paths and there is no Vello path.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Integrate GPU textures into the Vello rendering pipeline

review.reason: Passing wgpu textures directly into Vello's pipeline is specific to that renderer's resource model. Varve's opt-in WebGPU compositor is an independent path with its own texture handling.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Apply correct stroke styles in Vello

review.reason: Porting stroke styles into Vello's stroke representation is a Vello renderer task. Varve paints strokes through its own IR replay with the full stroke model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Refactor artboard text label so it's an overlay

review.reason: The task is to move the artboard name label out of the artwork into an overlay so it cannot be painted or exported. Whether Varve draws frame or page name labels at all, and whether they are canvas overlays or engine-painted items, is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas overlay versus engine paint for frame and page labels would be the affected area.

title: Fix Vello not rendering non-default gradients

review.reason: Gradients breaking as soon as they are edited with the gradient tool is a Vello gradient and transform defect. Varve renders gradients through its Canvas2D replay and has no Vello gradient path.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Vello doesn't render nested group transforms

review.reason: Nested group transforms not applying is a Vello scene-transform defect. Varve composes group transforms in the scene and replays them per frame.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Fills without a stroke are not rendered with Vello

review.reason: Fills without strokes not rendering is a Vello fill and path bug. Varve's IR replay paints fills independently of stroke presence.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Transform cage rotate/scale click targets extend too far on narrow shapes

review.reason: Graphite's rotate and scale targets extended too far on narrow shapes and one axis superseded the other. Varve computes handle visibility from the selection's screen size and keeps 24px hit targets: when one axis is below the spacing it keeps only the opposite edge handles, when neither axis fits it shows none and leaves exact values to the Inspector, and skew handles are gated behind a 60px box so they cannot swallow the move drag.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay handle geometry, hit targets, and skew gating.

title: Tracking Issue: Pen and Path tool improvements

review.reason: This tracking issue is a long list of Pen and Path modifier behaviours (Alt equidistant handles, Shift 15-degree lock, Ctrl angle lock, Tab handle swap, Space anchor move, C bent/collinear toggle, and more). Varve's NodeEditTool already has corner, smooth, symmetric, and automatic modes plus anchor nudging, but which of these specific modifier conventions exist is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Pen and path modifier behaviour in NodeEditTool and the pen construction actions.

title: Viewport canvas for Vello doesn't resize when editor dimensions change

review.reason: The Vello viewport canvas not resizing with editor dimensions is a Vello integration bug. Varve owns canvas sizing in its own compositor and render worker.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Fix Vello rendering of opacity and blend modes (see Isometric Fountaintain)

review.reason: Opacity and blend-mode rendering in the Isometric Fountaintain demo is a Vello compositing bug. Varve applies blend modes in its own compositor with Canvas2D as the reference renderer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Adopt Svelte 5's runes and remove slow manual component event delegation

review.reason: Adopting Svelte 5 runes and Svelte event delegation only applies to Graphite's Svelte frontend. Varve's editor is React, so there is no manual component event delegation layer to remove.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Exported SVGs have many parts appearing black when imported into other vector editors

review.reason: Exported SVGs must be self-contained enough that other vector editors read the same paints; parts turning black usually means paints are expressed in a form importers ignore. Varve exports SVG through its codegen package, so export fidelity needs that guarantee, and the packet supplies only a screenshot as evidence.
review.varveAssessment: SVG export in packages/codegen.

title: Redesign the auto composition system and node_fn macro to give nodes access to their call argument

review.reason: Redesigning the autocomp system and node_fn macro is internal to Graphene's node composition model. Varve has no node graph, compose nodes, or macro system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Export dialog doesn't show the actual artboard names

review.reason: The defect was an export bounds menu showing placeholder artboard names instead of real ones. Varve's export dialog resolves targets, file names, and dimensions through the canonical export plan from each node's own name, and the same plan drives the Inspector naming preview.
review.varveAssessment: Export target naming in packages/editor/src/components/Export and buildExportPlan.

title: Export dialog resets its choices every time it's opened

review.reason: Varve persists export defaults in its settings store (ExportSettingsStore) and seeds the dialog's print and export options from the loaded settings rather than hardcoding them on each open.
review.varveAssessment: Export defaults in packages/editor/src/settings.ts and the ExportDialog state seeding.

title: Allow multiple output wires from the top of a layer stack

review.reason: Allowing multiple output wires from the top of a layer stack is a node-graph topology constraint, worked around in the packet with an Identity node. Varve has no wires or layer-stack node topology.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Segment domain point reference as index

review.reason: Storing segment point references as indices instead of resolving PointIds is a Graphene vector-table performance change. Varve paths hold their point data directly on the scene node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Click targets get offset after paint with the boolean operation node

review.reason: The offset click targets came from cached viewport-space targets tied to a footprint that was not reprocessed after panning. Varve hit-tests by converting the pointer into document space through the camera and testing the transformed scene geometry, so panning cannot desynchronise selection targets.
review.varveAssessment: Hit testing via hit_test in crates/varve-core and the canvas hit-test path.

title: Automatic Into node insertion in Graphene

review.reason: Automatic Into node insertion is a Graphene type-conversion feature, recorded here as also solving #1919. Varve has no typed node inputs to coerce.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Implement layer chains

review.reason: Layer chains are a node-graph presentation feature that groups nodes feeding a layer's left input into a glass box. Varve has no node graph or layer input nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Abstract all graph manipulations through a node network API

review.reason: Abstracting all graph manipulations behind a node network API is Graphene refactoring. Varve has no node network API.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Move network imports/exports from the "pseudo" nodes to the graph left/right edges

review.reason: Moving imports and exports from pseudo nodes to sticky graph edges is node-graph UI work. Varve has no graph edges or import/export nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Out of memory (editor crash) when loading large images with Vello

review.reason: The crash is an out-of-memory during autosave serialization of a large in-memory image, with Vello texture pressure as the initial suspect and a linked autosave issue. Varve bounds raster decode with a decoded pixel budget before allocation, but its autosave and snapshot memory behaviour for very large images is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Image ingest bounds plus the autosave/recovery serialization path.

title: Tracking Issue: Quick measurement overlays while holding the Alt key

review.reason: Varve already draws dimension lines and AABB distance readouts between the selected and hovered nodes in screen space, but that lives in an inspect-mode surface rather than an Alt-hold gesture. The rotated and skewed AABB semantics this tracking issue settled are not shown to be implemented in Varve.
review.varveAssessment: SpecPanel MeasureOverlay and measurement.ts.

title: Fix pixelated Vello anti-aliasing

review.reason: Pixelated anti-aliasing is a Vello rasterization defect, fixed there by switching to multisampled AA. Varve's Canvas2D replay uses the browser's own anti-aliasing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Black area around artboards in Chrome with Vello

review.reason: The black area around artboards appears only with Vello in Chromium-based browsers, a Vello and WGPU surface configuration bug. Varve does not render through Vello.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Black area around artboards in Chrome

review.reason: Same black-band-around-artboards symptom in Chrome, and the packet records it as a duplicate of #1901. It is also Vello-specific, so nothing in Varve is affected.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; a Vello-only rendering issue.

title: Vello rendering flickers on deeply nested layers with blending

review.reason: Flicker on deeply nested blended layers was traced to Vello and discussed upstream in a Vello PR thread. Varve composites nested groups itself with Canvas2D as the reference renderer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Node graph better organization

review.reason: Automatic node placement, collapsible node folders, and graph organisation are node-graph layout features. Varve has no node graph; the report itself cross-links #1820 and #1819.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Make all dragging actions abortable with right click

review.reason: Varve models cancellation with BaseTool's onDragCancel, invoked on Escape and pointercancel, so every tool drag has an abort path, and right-click is deliberately reserved for context actions so it can never start or confirm a tool gesture. The trigger differs from right-click abort, but the guarantee that an in-progress drag never commits silently is present.
review.varveAssessment: Tool drag lifecycle in packages/editor/src/tools/BaseTool.ts and ToolManager.ts.

title: Performance leak when many layers are in a scene

review.reason: This is labelled Graphene and concerns frame-time cost that grows with many layers until the editor is reloaded, which is per-frame node-network evaluation. Varve renders through IR replay of scene state and has no network evaluation layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Seperate the boolean operation and merge node

review.reason: Splitting the boolean operation node from the merge node is a graph topology change so a VectorData-only node can follow the operation. Varve's live boolean already outputs ordinary scene geometry, so no node split is needed.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Allow constructing IVec2 in graph

review.reason: Constructing an IVec2 value in the graph depends on Graphene's type system and value nodes, with the maintainers deferring it until automatic type conversion. Varve has typed scene properties rather than graph-authored values.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Clipping masks

review.reason: Varve has a masking system: a group or frame whose mask.type is clip points at one of its own children as the mask source, with alpha and luminance variants, reparenting invariants, and cycle rejection. The alternative clip-on-layer-beneath blend flag is not Varve's model, but the clipping-mask capability exists.
review.varveAssessment: Masking in packages/scene (mask source invariants, detectMaskCycles) and the clip-mask render path.

title: Reimplement the node graph UI in the backend

review.reason: Reimplementing the node graph UI in the backend through Vello is a combined graph and renderer project. Varve has no node graph and does not use Vello.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Set integer ruler increments in the Node Graph

review.reason: Integer ruler tick increments are requested specifically for the node graph ruler. Varve has canvas rulers but no node graph view whose ticks would need changing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Generalize all possible nodes to work on Table<Graphic> data

review.reason: Generalising nodes to work on Table<Graphic> data is a Graphene type-signature change across the node catalog. Varve has no Table<Graphic> data type or node catalog.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Make Fill and Stroke apply in-the-moment, not as part of the final rendered element

review.reason: Varve nodes already carry ordered fill and stroke stacks (fills: Fill[] and strokes: Stroke[]) rather than a single overwritable colour, and paint order between them is part of the node's render order. That is the multiple-fills-and-strokes model this issue asks for, without graph nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Fill and stroke arrays plus paint order in packages/scene.

title: The Transform node sets its GraphicGroup's final transform, but should only affect the data-so-far in the graph flow

review.reason: The complaint is that a Transform node's position in the graph flow decides which partial stack it moves. Varve transforms are scene-node properties applied hierarchically to a node and its descendants, which is the intended direct-manipulation model; there is no flow ordering.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; transform semantics follow the scene hierarchy, not graph flow.

title: Vertically repositioning layers should push layers above/below it like blocks

review.reason: Block-pushing layer repositioning is spatial auto-layout of graph nodes during a drag, with upstream and downstream collision waves. Varve has no node placement to animate.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Add and implement expand/collapse arrow buttons in the graph to hide upstream branches

review.reason: Expand and collapse arrows that hide upstream node branches are node-graph disclosure controls. Varve has no node branches to collapse.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Show nodes as mini layers in the Layers panel

review.reason: Showing non-layer nodes as mini layers in the Layers panel only makes sense when a layer stack is a node graph with mid-stack transform nodes. Varve's layers are scene nodes, so the panel already reflects the whole tree.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: "Assign Colors" node to map a group of VectorData fill/stroke colors to steps on a gradient

review.reason: The issue body is empty, so the only requirement available is the title: map a group of shapes' fill and stroke colours onto steps of a gradient. Varve has colour variables, presentation colour themes, and gradient maps, but no documented command that assigns a ramp to a set of shapes' existing colours.
review.varveAssessment: Colour variables/themes and gradient-map tooling would be the closest surface.

title: Aborting a drag with a tool destroys redo history

review.reason: Redo history being destroyed came from an aborted drag still entering history as an edit. Varve's undo boundary is a committed transaction, and an aborted gesture ends through BaseTool's onDragCancel without committing, so the redo branch is left intact.
review.varveAssessment: History transaction boundary and BaseTool.onDragCancel.

title: Crash when Fill node with no input shape is set to gradient

review.reason: The crash needs a graph Fill node with no input shape set to gradient, and it is debug-build specific. Varve fills are properties of an existing scene node, so there is no inputless fill operator to crash.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path.

title: Select tool's shallow select crashes when clicking a group

review.reason: The crash is in Graphite's Select tool shallow-select mode when clicking a group, localhost-only. Varve has no shallow-select mode toggle (group selection plus Ctrl/Cmd deep select cover the same intent), so whether the equivalent group click path is safe is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: SelectTool group hit testing and selection resolution.

title: Resizable text boxes and text editing features

review.reason: Varve text lives in resizable frames with automatic text layout, an inline text edit overlay, and line height controls in the Typography inspector, so the requested resizable text box and line-spacing configuration exist. The packet also redirects this discussion away from the tracker.
review.varveAssessment: Text layout and typography controls in the editor.

title: Incorporating Print-Specific Features: Measurement Conversion and PDF Export Capabilities in Graphite

review.reason: Maintainer closed this as moved to #1962; the asks are px-to-mm measurement switching plus direct printing or PDF output. Varve's print workspace already carries physical units and exports PDF/PDF-X through the varve-print crate.
review.varveAssessment: Print units and PDF/PDF-X export already ship, so nothing new is required in Varve.

title: Show selection bounding box width/height in the X/Y rulers

review.reason: Wants selection extents projected into the X/Y rulers with draggable endpoints and a projected vs axis-aligned mode. Varve's ruler (components/Ruler/Ruler.tsx) draws ticks and cursor position only, with no selection-extent line, endpoint drag, or origin marker.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the canvas ruler overlay and its integration with the transform cage.

title: bezier-rs 0.4.0: `Bezier::euclidean_to_parametric` is imprecise, with a big discontinuity at 0.5

review.reason: Defect in the third-party bezier-rs 0.4.0 euclidean_to_parametric lookup table, already fixed in-tree and later released. Varve does not depend on bezier-rs; its Bezier maths lives in @varve/engine and varve-trace.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path: the crate is not a dependency.

title: Shift+R to repeat the last action

review.reason: Asks for a Shift+R repeat-last-action command, gated on a searchable action architecture with adjustable parameters. Varve has an ActionRegistry, command palette, and repeatLastTransform, but no generic repeat-last-command.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the ActionRegistry and shortcut registry surfaces and the command palette.

title: Pen tool clicking an anchor to turn it sharp or close a path shouldn't rely on snapping

review.reason: Varve's pen tool hit-tests the first anchor with its own world-space proximity test (distanceToFirst(pointer) < 8 / zoom) and closes the path regardless of the snapping toggle.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool close and sharp-anchor behaviour does not route through the snapping system.

title: Text tool completly broken

review.reason: A Graphite regression from its #1946 click-target refactor: typing at the origin, stale text until pan. Varve's text tool commits through the shaping/layout pipeline and the frame is invalidated for the committed text rather than reusing already-painted pixels.
review.varveAssessment: Text entry and commit already go through the editor text pipeline and full-frame invalidation.

title: Pen tool start position offset on offset artboard

review.reason: Pointer input is converted to world space before geometry is built (screenToWorld plus camera state), and the artboard-local coordinate contract is pinned by tests/e2e/canvas/artboard-coordinates.spec.ts.
review.varveAssessment: Pen start placement on a frame away from the origin is covered by the world-space input contract and its E2E spec.

title: Incorrect pen tool overlay when placing a second anchor

review.reason: The Graphite root cause was overlays derived from render-output click targets. Varve's pen draft, including the first-anchor square, is drawn from tool state via PenTool.syncDraft, so placing a second anchor cannot drop the first.
review.varveAssessment: Pen construction overlay is tool-state driven.

title: Add automated testing for the freehand tool on an offset artboard

review.reason: Varve already keeps real-pointer drawing E2E (tests/e2e/canvas/pen-pencil.spec.ts) and artboard-local coordinate E2E (artboard-coordinates.spec.ts) covering the offset-artboard class that repeatedly regressed in Graphite.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas E2E already covers drawing and artboard-local coordinates.

title: Position no longer relative to artboard

review.reason: Children store artboard-local coordinates and are never rewritten when the frame moves; tests/e2e/canvas/artboard-coordinates.spec.ts asserts the frame and child move together.
review.varveAssessment: The frame parenting and coordinate model already provides this.

title: Pen tool has overlay for closed path

review.reason: The pen tool computes a closedPreview only while the pointer is within tolerance of the first anchor and otherwise draws an open draft, so no stray close overlay is shown.
review.varveAssessment: Pen draft preview state is explicit.

title: Cannot make point co-linear

review.reason: Handle coupling for corner, smooth, and symmetric anchors lives in node editing (NodeEditTool with PathNodeMode in @varve/shared/bezier) and is covered by NodeEditTool tests.
review.varveAssessment: Node editing already exposes colinear and smooth handle behaviour.

title: Cannot extend path with pen tool

review.reason: PenTool keeps a continuePathId; clicking an existing path endpoint continues that path instead of starting a new layer.
review.varveAssessment: Path extension is implemented in the pen tool.

title: Cannot close path with the pen tool

review.reason: Clicking the first anchor within tolerance commits the path closed (commitPath with closed true, announced as 'Click first anchor to close path'), independent of snapping.
review.varveAssessment: Path closing is already implemented on the pen tool.

title: SVG import is broken

review.reason: SVG import is a shipped importer in @varve/import, reachable from File > Import and from file drops, with parser tests.
review.varveAssessment: SVG import already works through the import package.

title: [Crash Report] Inconsistent crash when creating folder

review.reason: Panic inside Graphene's NodeNetworkInterface::chain_width, an unreproducible capacity overflow while creating a folder. Varve has no node network, no folder-to-network insertion, and no chain-width computation.
review.varveAssessment: Depends on the Graphene node network; no Varve path is affected.

title: Appearance table for encoding how vector shapes get rendered

review.reason: Proposes a spreadsheet-style Appearance table plus node-based rendering procedures inside Graphene. Varve has no node graph and renders an explicit scene and IR, so this data-model redesign has no target.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene data-model design; nothing in Varve to change.

title: Infinite canvas needs to show a white background in Vello

review.reason: Vello renderer must paint the infinite canvas background white; the body is empty. Varve has no Vello renderer, and its Canvas2D compositor owns canvas background painting.
review.varveAssessment: Vello-specific; Varve's compositor already paints its canvas background.

title: Outline render mode support in Vello

review.reason: Outline render mode in the opt-in Vello renderer. Varve's renderer stack is Canvas2D with opt-in WebGPU and has no Vello integration or render-mode switch of that kind.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work; Vello-only renderer feature.

title: Gradient transforms are broken in Vello

review.reason: Gradient transforms broken in Vello, with no body or reproduction. Varve composites gradients through its own renderer, so this Vello transform defect has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: Vello-specific renderer defect.

title: Canvases with spherical and non-euclidean coordinate spaces

review.reason: Proposes spherical and non-Euclidean canvas coordinate spaces with GIS and planetarium use cases. Varve's camera is an affine 2D world (pan, zoom, rotate); a non-Euclidean coordinate space is a different product architecture, not a missing feature.
review.varveAssessment: Requires a non-Euclidean canvas engine Varve does not have and has not scoped.

title: Alt-drag duplication makes snapping freeze the editor for seconds/minutes/forever

review.reason: Graphite's freeze came from per-point candidate loops in snap_drag. Varve snaps from node bounds (left, centre, right by top, centre, bottom) over a broad-phase spatial index, so candidate count is bounded per node rather than per path point.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping already gathers candidates by bounds plus spatial index.

title: Destructive node collapse

review.reason: Wants right-click destructive node collapse with equivalence reasoning such as e-graphs inside the node graph. Varve has no nodes to collapse; transforms and rounding are ordinary scene properties.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph capability Varve does not have.

title: Will there be a way to disable the AI features?

review.reason: Varve has a global AI master switch (aiEnabled in settings) that hides and disables AI features and blocks model downloads, surfaced in the Settings dialog.
review.varveAssessment: Users can already disable AI features.

title: Can't import SVGs with import menu or dragging files.

review.reason: The report was a stale-deployment bug that the reporter confirmed fixed on Graphite's dev build. Varve imports SVG through @varve/import for both menu and drag-drop paths.
review.varveAssessment: SVG import is implemented and tested in the import package.

title: Tracking Issue: Math expression parser/calculator

review.reason: Tracking a maths expression parser with units and a typeset formula widget for numeric entry. Varve's number fields commit with Number.parseFloat only, so no expression or unit evaluation exists in Inspector, transform, or export fields.
review.varveAssessment: Affects @varve/ui NumberInput and every numeric Inspector field; the Graphene AST item does not apply.

title: Feature: Add a production container image to run it on own server.

review.reason: Asks for a published container image to self-host the editor. Varve ships as a Tauri desktop app plus a static browser demo, so there is no server product to containerise.
review.varveAssessment: No server deployment surface exists in Varve.

title: Layer transforms are broken in Changing Seasons demo art in Vello

review.reason: Layer transforms render wrong in the Vello path for one demo document, with no body or reproduction. Varve's compositor does not use Vello.
review.varveAssessment: Vello-specific; no Varve path affected.

title: Having no artboard crashes the editor

review.reason: The crash came from Graphene's ClickXRayIter assuming an artboard parent. Varve documents are valid with zero frames, and hit testing plus layer iteration have no artboard precondition.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's scene model does not require an artboard.

title: Editor getting stuck if I upload 6 Images together. Just drag and drop 6 Images together

review.reason: Report is a stall while dropping six images, closed without a reproduction, with only a suspicion that one image was oversized. Varve bounds decoded image pixels (MAX_DECODED_PIXELS in imageBounds.ts), but multi-image drop timing is not evidenced in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the image import path in packages/editor; needs measurement before claiming a defect.

title: Click-and-drag number fields can't be released in Safari

review.reason: Varve's NumberInput drag uses setPointerCapture plus window-level pointerup, pointercancel, blur, and Escape teardown, and never pointer lock, so the scrub always ends.
review.varveAssessment: Number-field scrubbing is already release-safe.

title: Bevel path node

review.reason: Bevel path: chamfer corners on vertices with exactly two connected segments. Varve has parametric corner rounding (roundCorners in engine/pathOffset.ts) and bevel as an offset join style, but no chamfer operation on an existing path.
review.varveAssessment: Path geometry work in packages/engine/src/pathOffset.ts and node editing; the node packaging does not apply.

title: Extrude curves

review.reason: Wants segment extrusion: pull a polygon edge or subdivided curve outward into new geometry. Varve has offset and expand-stroke primitives but no extrude operation on selected segments.
review.varveAssessment: Path editing and geometry work in packages/editor and packages/engine.

title: Selection direction difference

review.reason: Varve already has a containment preference with a Ctrl or Cmd temporary toggle and Shift to add, implemented in selectionOperations.ts and SelectTool.ts and covered by the test 'marquee with ctrl key toggles containment mode'.
review.varveAssessment: Marquee contained-vs-touched selection is already implemented as a preference plus modifier.

title: Move network import type from NodeInput::Network to NodeNetwork in order to enable automatic Into node insertion

review.reason: Moves network import types from NodeInput::Network to NodeNetwork for automatic Into-node insertion. Varve has no typed node inputs or network nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Graph-craft typing internals; no Varve equivalent.

title: Improved node graph support for user created nodes

review.reason: Group and ungroup selected nodes into a user-defined node with editable input and output signatures. Varve has no node graph to group.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph authoring; nothing in Varve.

title: Ad-hoc graph introspection instead of Monitor nodes for thumbnails and click targets

review.reason: Replaces Monitor nodes with ad-hoc graph introspection for thumbnails and click targets. Varve generates thumbnails from the scene, not from graph taps.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene introspection; Varve's thumbnail system is scene-based.

title: Passthrough node has no compiled type

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: Passthrough node missing a compiled type in ResolvedDocumentNodeTypes. Varve has no compiled node-type map.
review.varveAssessment: Node typing internals only.

title: Bezier-rs web demo site's miter limit control doesn't work

review.reason: Miter-limit control on Graphite's bezier-rs demo website (website/other/bezier-rs-demos). Varve has no bezier-rs demo site and does not use the crate.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite website tooling for a third-party library.

title: Upstream transform in a layer stack offsets tooling downstream of it

review.reason: Graphite's offset came from a transform node inside the layer stack plus a global graphic-group transform. Varve has no node stack, and tool-created geometry is converted from the world click into the containing frame's local space via commitToParent and createShapeAt.
review.varveAssessment: Creation coordinates are parent-local by construction.

title: When editing text in the viewport, hitting Escape seems to delete all the text

review.reason: Varve's text tool documents and implements Escape as exit-edit that selects the text object, so Escape cannot discard the typed text.
review.varveAssessment: Text editing key handling already preserves content.

title: Store metadata as data flows through the graph

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: Stores per-row downstream transform metadata as spreadsheet data flows through the graph. Varve transforms are scene-node properties resolved through a parent index, not graph metadata.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene data flow; no Varve equivalent.

title: Overlays don't render when switching documents

review.reason: Varve overlays are declarative React and canvas layers recomputed from the active session's state (CanvasOverlays, SnapGuidesOverlay, canvas name labels), so switching documents cannot leave them unrendered.
review.varveAssessment: Overlay rendering is state-driven across document tabs.

title: [Crash Report] Brush tool on top of shapes crashes

review.reason: The crash came from converting the root parent to a node id when the brush looked up its parent transform. Varve's paint tools parent new layers through activeWorkspaceContentRoot and addNodeToActiveWorkspace and resolve transforms with parent index maps, so painting without a frame is an ordinary path.
review.varveAssessment: Painting on a frameless document is a supported path in Varve.

title: Add node button in the Properties panel

review.reason: Adds an add-a-node button to the Properties panel. Varve properties are typed scene properties, not a node list.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph UI; no Varve path.

title: Alignment snaps don't respect preserving aspect ratio

review.reason: Varve snapping has an explicit policy to keep the aspect ratio selected by the resize policy while snapping, declared in snapping.ts.
review.varveAssessment: Aspect-locked resize already integrates with snapping.

title: Crash when hiding the rectangle node

review.reason: Panic in graph_craft resolving a proto node when hiding the rectangle node. Varve has no graph compiler or proto nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene compiler internals.

title: Preserve point IDs without a path node

review.reason: Wants stable point IDs and correct colinear and point-insert behaviour for generated vector data with no Path node. Varve node editing requires an actual path node (pathNode in NodeEditTool), so parametric shapes expose no anchors to identify; an anchor-editing or convert-to-path model is the missing prerequisite.
review.varveAssessment: Blocked on anchor editing for parametric shapes in NodeEditTool.

title: Add list of acceptable types when hovering over node input

review.reason: Tooltip listing acceptable input types, filtered against node implementations and network casts. Varve has no typed node inputs.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph tooltip; no Varve equivalent.

title: Update to Svelte 5

review.reason: Upgrades Graphite's Svelte frontend to Svelte 5. Varve's frontend is React.
review.varveAssessment: Framework migration for a frontend Varve does not use.

title: Exporting an Artboard with a Scale Factor does not scale the Artboard-Location correctly

review.reason: Export regions are world-space rects and the scale factor only changes raster density: renderSelectionPng keeps the world viewBox and multiplies output width and height by the requested scale, so origin and size scale together.
review.varveAssessment: Export scaling already separates the world viewBox from pixel density.

title: Make the Pen tool connect separate layers by their endpoints to become one layer

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: Wants the pen tool to join two separate layers whose endpoints meet. Varve's pen tool can continue the same path (continuePathId) but has no path join or merge command across layers or nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Needs a path join/merge operation in the vector editing layer.

title: Aperiodic tile generator node

review.reason: Asks for an aperiodic monotile generator node to demonstrate adaptive resolution. That is a procedural node generator, and Varve has no node generator system.
review.varveAssessment: Node generator; no Varve target.

title: Path tool point nudging should be in document coordinates, not viewport coordinates

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: Path anchor nudges use getNudgeStep(mode, settings.nudge) and apply the delta in document units (defaults 1 and 10) via nudgeSelectedAnchors and commands/nudge.ts, not viewport pixels.
review.varveAssessment: Point nudging is already document-space.

title: Node versioning system

review.reason: Non-destructive per-node versioning with upgrade scripts and ignore boxes. Varve document migration is schema-versioned, not node-versioned, and there are no nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Node versioning; no Varve counterpart.

title: Fix the spline node algorithm to be continuous across start/end points

review.reason: Fixes the Spline from Points node algorithm so closed paths are continuous across the start and end. Varve has no Spline node; its curve fitting lives in tools/fitting.ts and is not node-driven.
review.varveAssessment: Node algorithm; Varve's pencil fitting is a separate implementation.

title: The shape tools should set shape node parameters, not transformations of unit shapes

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: Varve shape tools write real parametric geometry (rect x/y/w/h, ellipse cx/cy/rx/ry, line from/to) with a translation transform, as shapeBounds reads directly from the shape, rather than unit shapes wrapped in scaled transforms.
review.varveAssessment: Shape creation already stores parametric geometry instead of unit-shape transforms.

title: Allow users to escape from node implementations

review.reason: Users get stuck inside nested node networks with no way back out. Varve has no nested networks.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph navigation only.

title: Long node graph evaluations hang frontend

review.reason: Graphene graph evaluation runs on the main thread and hangs the frontend. Varve has no graph evaluation; heavy work runs through its render worker and lease-gated jobs.
review.varveAssessment: Graph evaluation does not exist in Varve.

title: Initialization flicker when creating a document with an artboard or imported image

review.reason: First frame is rendered at scale 1 with no offset before the viewport centres, causing flicker on new documents and dropped images. Varve fits the camera before showing a document and runs a loading experience, but the packet cannot establish whether an intermediate mis-scaled frame is ever blitted.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch the document-open and first-frame camera path; unverified.

title: Editor preferences has checkboxes overlapping their labels

review.reason: Varve preferences live in SettingsDialog using the shared switch and checkbox components in a grid layout with dialog tests, so labels and controls cannot overlap as in the broken Graphite dialog.
review.varveAssessment: Preferences layout already uses shared, tested controls.

title: [Crash Report] Trying to blend 2 images

review.reason: The crash was Graphene's Blend node asserting equal image dimensions. Varve composites with per-layer blend modes (blendModes.ts, blendConformance.ts) over overlapping extents rather than requiring matching sizes.
review.varveAssessment: Compositing does not rely on a same-size assertion.

title: Export with "All Artwork" may use incorrect bounds

review.reason: Reported cropped export with All Artwork; the maintainer closed it as a duplicate of #2129, which describes the outer-stroke bounds problem more clearly. Varve shares one geometry-only bounds contract for measurement, selection, zoom-to-fit, and export, so the same stroke-clipping case applies.
review.varveAssessment: Tracked by the same finding as #2129: export bounds are geometry-only.

title: Math node for running custom expressions with A and B

review.reason: Adds a Math node that evaluates an expression during graph runtime. Varve has no graph nodes; numeric-field expression evaluation is tracked separately by the parser request.
review.varveAssessment: Node runtime; no Varve path.

title: Add a parametric_to_euclidean() function to Bezier-rs

review.reason: Requests a parametric_to_euclidean API on the third-party bezier-rs crate. Varve does not use bezier-rs.
review.varveAssessment: Library API request for a non-dependency.

title: Advanced font management and browsing

review.reason: Varve ships a font browser (FontBrowserDialog, FontBrowser) with search by family or design language, license details, a document font usage panel with unused styles, and missing-font recovery. The JSON allowlist and disable-system-fonts ideas are not implemented, but the panel-level asks are.
review.varveAssessment: Font management and browsing already exist under components/FontBrowser.

title: Keep selection when clicking in properties after creating text

review.reason: Exiting text edit selects the text object (TextTool documents 'Escape exits edit to selects text object') and text creation selects the new node, so the Inspector keeps showing its properties.
review.varveAssessment: Selection survives text commit, so Inspector properties stay visible.

title: Make Text tool use click targets based on rectangles instead of precise glyph shapes

review.reason: Text hit testing is rectangle-based: Shape::Text containment in crates/varve-core/src/shape.rs tests the text box rect, not glyph outlines.
review.varveAssessment: Text selection already uses box targets.

title: Exporting with auto bounds doesn't account for outer stroke

review.reason: Auto export bounds exclude the outer half of a stroke. Varve's measurement, selection, zoom-to-fit, and export bounds all resolve through nodeWorldBounds and nodeLocalBounds, which are geometry-only with no stroke inflation, so a tight export can crop the outer stroke.
review.varveAssessment: Affects export region and selection PNG bounds through worldBBox and exportService.

title: SVG export `viewbox` typo.

review.reason: Every SVG emitter spells viewBox with a capital B (packages/codegen/src/svg.ts, codegen/src/index.ts, engine icon and thumbnail emitters), so exported SVGs scale correctly.
review.varveAssessment: SVG export attribute casing is already correct.

title: Drawing new shapes creates multiple selection history states

review.reason: Varve keeps selection history separate from document undo (selectionHistoryBack and selectionHistoryForward via selectPreviousSelection and selectNextSelection), so stepping back returns to the pre-draw selection instead of the newly drawn node.
review.varveAssessment: Selection history already exists as its own stack.

title: Change origin reference point with 9-dot selector (not just for rotations)

review.reason: The 9-dot control only sets the rotation centre; the reporter wants it to affect translation and scaling too. The maintainer closed it as a duplicate of #1530, the transform-encoding refactor.
review.varveAssessment: Same feature gap as #1530 if Varve adds a transform reference-point control.

title: Small click target when dragging/moving a straight line or small objects

review.reason: HitTestEngine applies a zoom-aware screen-space tolerance (tolerancePx converted to world via screenToWorldTolerance) with a padded-bbox fallback, so thin lines and small objects stay draggable.
review.varveAssessment: Hit testing already has pick tolerance.

title: [Blocked on browser support] Refactor floating menus to use HTML <dialog> and CSS popover with anchor()

review.reason: Varve already implements the requested end state: native dialog for modals and the native Popover API plus Floating UI anchoring for transient surfaces (FloatingPortal and OverlayRegistry), documented in docs/architecture/popover-system.md.
review.varveAssessment: Popover and dialog architecture already matches the target without waiting on CSS anchor positioning.

title: Artboard constrain to square broken on tilted document

review.reason: Shift constrain-to-square breaks when the document is tilted. Varve supports camera rotation and derives tool geometry from world-space deltas, but the packet cannot establish whether the shift constraint is applied in canvas space or viewport space.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect shape and frame creation constraints under a rotated camera; needs verification.

title: Resizing an artboard by its top/left edges should keep its content stationary

review.reason: Resizing an artboard from its top or left edge shifts its contents. Varve children are frame-local and the geometry resize path only rewrites w and h, so a changed frame origin would drag children unless a compensation pass exists; the packet cannot confirm which.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect frame resize handling in the transform and selection path.

title: Path tool should have a linear/quadratic/cubic toggle for selected anchors

review.reason: Wants an anchor-level linear, quadratic, or cubic indicator with a toggle, a quadratic handle overlay, and delete-to-zero-length. Varve's anchor model only has PathNodeMode corner, smooth, symmetric, and automatic, with no segment-degree type or affordance.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the path node model in @varve/shared/bezier plus the node-edit overlay and quick bar.

title: Add back segment-by-segment undo while drawing with the Pen tool

review.reason: The pen tool keeps construction tool-local and exposes an Undo Anchor action that pops the last placed anchor and announces it, leaving document history untouched.
review.varveAssessment: Segment-by-segment undo while drawing already exists as a construction action.

title: The Layers panel doesn't show expandable children for the lower layer, only the top layer

review.reason: The layers tree renders expansion per container row: LayersRow sets aria-expanded per node over the flattened tree from useFlatTree, so every parent shows its own arrow.
review.varveAssessment: Layer tree expansion is already per-node.

title: Lasso selection with the Select tool

review.reason: Varve has a dedicated lasso tool (LassoTool with lassoGeometry) that selects nodes whose transformed geometry intersects the lasso polygon, alongside marquee and pixel lassos.
review.varveAssessment: Lasso selection already exists.

title: Can't export in Graphite.rs

review.reason: Thread is a support case: the dialog needed its Export button pressed, then the failure self-resolved while maintainers could not reproduce it. No code defect was identified, and Varve exports through exportService with explicit dialog confirmation and tests.
review.varveAssessment: No defect to port; Varve export is a tested, explicit flow.

title: Status bar graph render progress spinner/indicator

review.reason: Status-bar spinner driven by Graphene graph evaluation start and finish. Varve has no graph evaluation pass to report.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene render progress only.

title: Tracking Issue: GPU integration

review.reason: Tracking issue for GPU integration of Graphene node buffers. Varve's acceleration is a separate wgpu compute path for effects and resampling (ADR-0237) with no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: GPU node-buffer integration does not exist in Varve.

title: Snake-like wires in the node graph

review.reason: Redesigns node-graph wire routing into orthogonal snake curves that avoid nodes and other wires. Varve has no node-graph canvas.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph UI only.

title: How to apply filters?

review.reason: The question was how to apply filters; Varve exposes live effects and adjustment layers with scope in the Inspector, with no node editing required.
review.varveAssessment: Effects are already reachable from the Inspector.

title: Bezier-rs API to check if a subpath is inside another

review.reason: Adds a subpath-inside-subpath API to the third-party bezier-rs crate. Varve does not use bezier-rs; its path containment and area selection use its own geometry code.
review.varveAssessment: Library API for a non-dependency.

title: Make the Spline tool draw a polylines with a `Path -> Spline from Points` node setup

review.reason: Requires Graphite's Path to Spline from Points node composition plus document upgrade scripts. Varve has no node chains or node upgrade scripts; the comparable behaviours (continue, close, new subpath) live on the pen and pencil tools.
review.varveAssessment: Node-composition and upgrade-script work; no Varve target.

title: Tracking Issue: Animation

review.reason: Tracks Graphene parametric animation: animation-time nodes, exposed keyframe channels, timeline panel, onion skins, and 2D rigging. Varve has no node graph, and its motion system already provides a keyframe timeline with easing and playback; onion skins and 2D rigging are unbuilt direct-manipulation features that would need their own scoped requests.
review.varveAssessment: Graph-based animation does not apply; the timeline items are already covered by the motion system.

title: Importing raw camera photos

review.reason: Varve has a RAW photo path: a classic uncompressed Bayer DNG opens as a RAW source from the Photo workspace, while vendor RAW containers such as CR2, NEF, and ARW are detected and refused with an explicit message that no embedded preview is substituted.
review.varveAssessment: RAW handling exists within declared bounds; vendor RAW decoding is a deliberate stated boundary, not a silent gap.

title: Reduce linear searches in fn append_subpath

review.reason: Performance fix in the third-party bezier-rs append_subpath used by Graphite's text and boolean code. Varve's boolean and path append code is its own in varve-core and @varve/engine and does not use bezier-rs.
review.varveAssessment: Third-party library optimisation; no Varve dependency.

title: Tauri buildscript issue (refers missing script "tauri:build-wasm")

review.reason: Graphite's Tauri config was vestigial and referenced a missing tauri:build-wasm script. Varve's Tauri 2 build is live (apps/desktop, just recipes, release pipeline), so no stale build script exists.
review.varveAssessment: Tauri build tooling is current in Varve.

title: Variable stroke width

review.reason: Variable stroke width along a vector path. Varve's engine can already outline a stroke with per-vertex widths (expandStroke(points, closed, widths) in engine/pathOffset.ts), but no stroke model or editing UI stores a width profile.
review.varveAssessment: Needs scene-model storage plus authoring UI on top of the existing expandStroke primitive.

title: Full support for changing subgraph node signatures

review.reason: Reorder, rename, and delete subgraph inputs and outputs and connect them to Properties rows. Varve has no subgraphs.
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph signatures only.

title: Prompt user to report a bug if graph becomes unrenderable due to an act of tooling

review.reason: Detects when WYSIWYG tooling leaves the node graph unrenderable and prompts a bug report. Varve has no graph that tooling can invalidate; tool failures surface through its own error and diagnostics paths.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene graph validity only.

title: In Firefox, tool control bar number input field dragging causes text entry afterward

review.reason: The Firefox drag-then-type bug came from event ordering and implicit focus. Varve's NumberInput calls preventDefault on pointerdown, only focuses and selects when the gesture stayed under the scrub threshold, and ends the drag on window pointerup, pointercancel, or blur.
review.varveAssessment: Number-field scrubbing already separates drag from text entry.

title: Tracking Issue: Biggest quality-of-life improvements

review.reason: The tracking issue carries no item list in the packet, only a note that some entries are good first issues. There is nothing concrete to map onto Varve.
review.varveAssessment: No assessable content; would need the issue's item list.

title: Laptop pinch zooming not working as intended

review.reason: Camera navigation is handled by the canvas input pipeline rather than by hit-tested content, so pinch-emulated ctrl-wheel zoom is not gated on whether the pointer is over artwork.
review.varveAssessment: Zoom handling is content-independent already.

title: Prevent the layer tree from allowing layer drag group formation of incompatible types

review.reason: Prevents dragging a layer into a layer whose node chain starts with an input that rejects group data, such as the Path node. Varve has no typed node chain; its layer tree validates structural reparenting such as mask release and cycle checks instead.
review.varveAssessment: Typed node-input compatibility does not exist in Varve.

title: Outline entire layer for snap to intersections/paths

review.reason: Wants the whole target layer outlined when snapping to an intersection or path. Varve's snap feedback renders guide lines, crosshairs, and the winning segment only (SnapGuidesOverlay with SnapGuide point and segment fields), never a target-layer outline.
review.varveAssessment: Affects snapping feedback in components/SnapGuidesOverlay and tools/snapping.

title: Experimental option for vector meshes

review.reason: Experimental vector meshes where more than two segments share an anchor. Varve's path model stores per-point handles on a path chain with no multi-segment anchor representation, and node editing requires a path node, so a vector-network data model is the missing prerequisite.
review.varveAssessment: Blocked on a vector-network (multi-segment anchor) model in the scene and path layers.

title: Motivating use case: Feynman diagrams

review.reason: Requires node-graph generation of diagrams: custom nodes plus a per-segment particle-type control in the path tool. Varve has no node graph or procedural evaluation engine, so automated diagram generation cannot be layered onto it.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve canvas, path or export workflow is affected; manual path drawing with labels is already ordinary vector editing.

title: Visualize the separate concepts of tooling pivot and graphical data origin

review.reason: Asks for distinct transform-pivot modes (bounding box centre, individual origins, median point) exposed in the Select and Path tool controls, separate from the persistent data origin. Varve's transform cage has no documented pivot-mode control, so the pivot half is a real direct-manipulation gap; only the origin half depends on Graphite's Transform node.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve's selection/transform tooling, its overlays and the tool-options surface in the floating palette.

title: Path tool creates unexpected 'Flatten Path' node

review.reason: Root cause is Graphite's executor caching resolved node types per document while node ids repeat across documents, so the Path tool decides to insert a Flatten Path node. Varve has no node executor, resolved-type cache or Flatten Path node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path-editing behaviour is affected; there is no document-type cache to go stale.

title: Shallow select mode not allowing a Ctrl-click select deepest if the target's ancestor is already selected

review.reason: In shallow-select mode a Ctrl-click should still reach the deepest target under the cursor when one of its ancestors is already selected. Varve's group/frame nesting needs the same selection-depth rule; the packet supplies only a Discord link, so the repro detail is thin.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve selection resolution for nested groups and frames.

title: Path tool sometimes snaps to the previous anchor positions

review.reason: Dragging a point from the centre of a rectangle made the Path tool snap it back toward its previous anchor position. Varve's path point dragging with snapping has the same risk of snapping against a stale anchor candidate.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path/node editing and its snapping candidates for selected points.

title: Use KeyNoRepeat instead of Key to avoid potential user confusion that Tab shouldn't be held in to swap dragged handles

review.reason: Holding Tab to swap dragged handles toggled repeatedly because the binding fired on key repeat; toggle-style controls need a no-repeat dispatch. Varve's configurable shortcut registry and path-handle toggles need the same repeat semantics.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve shortcut dispatch and held-key toggles in the path tool.

title: In the Path tool, selected points shouldn't be draggable from anywhere inside the shape

review.reason: Pressing inside a filled shape dragged a single selected anchor, producing surprising geometry; the expectation is either no interior drag or moving all anchors. Varve's path tool hit-testing decides whether an interior press moves points or the whole object.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path-tool pointer handling and anchor drag targeting.

title: Ctrl+Z on 'Edit > Convert to Infinite Canvas' creates leftover merge nodes

review.reason: Undoing Convert to Infinite Canvas leaves merge nodes because the graph transaction does not cover all inserted nodes. Varve has no node graph and no merge nodes, and its canvas is infinite without a conversion operation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve undo or canvas workflow is affected.

title: Reduce path editing clutter with options to hide non-selected anchors' handles

review.reason: Proposes three handle-visibility modes for the Pen and Path tools (all handles, handles adjacent to the selection, frontier handles only) as radio options in the tool control bar. Varve's pen/path tooling has no documented handle-visibility control, so dense paths stay visually cluttered.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path-editing overlays and path tool options.

title: Pen tool: dragging from the anchor breaks history, letting the user create vector meshes by mistake

review.reason: Undoing during pen drawing left the previous segment in place, so the next click drew from it and created an unintended vector mesh. Varve's pen tool plus persistent undo history must never leave a partially undone path in a drawable state.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve pen-tool state and undo/redo integrity for in-progress paths.

title: Update the input mapping system to not dispatch both a matched KeyDown and KeyDownNoRepeat

review.reason: The mapper matches a KeyDown binding and a KeyDownNoRepeat binding for the same key combination at once, so both actions fire instead of the single higher-precedence match. Varve's ShortcutManager/ActionRegistry resolves configurable shortcuts and needs the same single-winner semantics across repeat and no-repeat bindings.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve shortcut resolution order and repeat handling in the action registry.

title: G/R/S on a layer composed of a single anchor point crashes in dev mode

review.reason: G/R/S on a layer holding a single anchor point panicked in debug builds, and no crash dialog appeared. Varve's transform math must tolerate degenerate selections (zero-area bounds) without panicking or losing the session.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve transform math and crash handling for degenerate selections.

title: Stroke alignment

review.reason: Requests inside/outside stroke alignment, previously approximated with a filled shape plus clipping mask. Varve supports masks and multiple strokes per object, but stroke alignment is not in its documented paint feature set, so strokes always straddle the path.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve stroke rendering, mask usage and stroke properties in the Inspector.

title: Using fill tool on a raster layer temporarily breaks the graph

review.reason: The graph error comes from the fill node not accepting a raster input, which is node type checking Varve does not have. Whether Varve's fill tool refuses or safely degrades on raster layers is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch Varve's fill tool and raster layer handling if the tool currently applies a vector fill to raster content.
