title: Add a "Reverse" command to the "Order" menu

review.reason: Adds an Order menu command that reverses selected sibling ranges, ignores children of selected ancestors, and reverses each sibling set independently. Varve reorders paint order in the layers panel but has no documented reverse-selection command.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve layer ordering commands, menubar and command palette.

title: Restore prior selection after aborting a dragged box/lasso selection

review.reason: Right-clicking during a box or lasso drag should restore the selection that existed before the drag began. Varve's Select and Path tools own drag-selection state, so they need an explicit abort path that restores the prior selection.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve box/lasso selection state and pointer abort handling.

title: Menu lists should allow dragging from their spawner and releasing on a selection

review.reason: Menus should open on mousedown so the user can drag from the spawner onto a row and release to choose, with Esc or right-click aborting mid-drag. Varve's popover/menu layer documents click-then-click selection only, so drag-select and abort semantics need explicit support.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve menubar, dropdown and popover pointer interaction.

title: Improve Bevel node algorithm

review.reason: The deliverable is Graphite's node-graph Bevel node: distance-based bevels that do not vary with segment angle, support for curved segments, and a minimum-angle threshold. Varve has neither a bevel operation nor a node graph to host it.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; there is no bevel feature or node parameter to improve.

title: Compass rose translation gizmo in the Select tool's transform cage

review.reason: Adds a centre translate ring plus local-axis drag arrows to the transform cage and rotates grip squares with the layer rather than the viewport. Varve's transform cage has no documented translate gizmo, so unfilled shapes with no interior selection area are hard to move.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve selection overlay, transform gizmo hit targets and axis-constrained dragging.

title: [BUG]available now page is blank

review.reason: Resolved as a user-side browser extension making Graphite's hosted editor appear blank; no product defect was found. Nothing in Varve's canvas or document pipeline is implicated.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected; this is an end-user environment report about a hosted page.

title: [Fix]Typo in Readme

review.reason: Wording request for Graphite's own README contribution instructions. It is documentation housekeeping in another repository with no product behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected; Varve maintains its own contributor documentation.

title: Transform cage skew sliding triangle gizmos

review.reason: Adds hover-only skew triangles on transform-cage edges, replacing the hidden Ctrl modifier, with Ctrl to unlock the slide to both local axes. Varve's cage has no documented skew affordance, so skew is only reachable by an undiscoverable modifier.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve transform cage overlays, edge hit targets and modifier handling.

title: Pasting should be transfered in view if its placement wouldn't be in view

review.reason: Pasting should bring content into view when the copied position is entirely outside the viewport, offsetting by a whole number of pixels. Varve's clipboard/paste path needs the same off-screen placement correction.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve clipboard paste, camera framing and duplicate placement.

title: Conic gradients

review.reason: Varve already provides conic gradients in its paint stack alongside linear and radial gradients, which is the feature requested here. The pie-slice, raster and foreignObject strategies are Graphite's SVG-export workarounds, not a Varve gap.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient authoring and fill rendering in Varve; no new gradient engine is indicated.

title: Freeform gradients

review.reason: Requests freeform/mesh gradients spread from colour points or colour along a path, which are outside Varve's documented linear, radial, conic and gradient-map set. This would be new paint, hit-testing and export work.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve paint stack, gradient handle overlays and export fidelity.

title: Better gradient support

review.reason: Umbrella gradient issue whose only concrete request in the comments is spread-method support (repeat/reflect), opened as a PR. Varve's documented gradient types do not mention spread methods, so repeated or reflected gradient fills are unproven.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve gradient properties in the Inspector and SVG/PDF export mapping.

title: Along/across-stroke gradients

review.reason: Gradients along or across a stroke require subdividing the stroke or stroking repeatedly with masking for caps. Varve supports gradients, multiple strokes and masks but has no along/across-stroke gradient, so stroke-colour ramps are unpaintable.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve stroke paint, fill/stroke properties and export of stroke gradients.

title: Rendering the fills of vector meshes and intersecting paths

review.reason: Reticulate depends on vector-mesh half-edge topology with stable addressing of sub-segments and sub-regions across intersections. Varve has no vector-mesh model; its shape builder produces regions destructively rather than styling a continuously changing topology.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve renderer or path workflow is affected; there are no vector meshes or half-edge regions to style.

title: Rendering the strokes of vector meshes

review.reason: Stroking vector meshes (more than two edges meeting at a point) breaks cap and join assumptions and asks for per-segment caps and miter limits. Varve has no vector meshes, so nothing in its stroke pipeline has this shape topology.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve stroke rendering path is affected.

title: Consistant colours for axes

review.reason: The same axis was drawn in different colours by the compass-rose drag, Shift-constrained drag and G then X. Varve's axis-constraint overlays should resolve one token per axis so constrained drags always read identically.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve transform overlays and axis-colour tokens.

title: Click targets for axis contraint on 'compass rose' are very small

review.reason: The compass-rose axis handles are too small to hit reliably, which the reporter frames as an accessibility problem; Graphite closed it as not planned rather than fixing target size. Varve's gizmo hit targets need a minimum pointer/touch size even when the drawn handle stays small.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve gizmo hit testing, touch target sizing and accessibility contracts.

title: Incorrect snaps when using axis constrained 'compass rose'.

review.reason: Axis-constrained compass-rose drags snapped to non-existent geometry because the constrained snap function was not applied to the constrained candidate. Varve's snapping pipeline must apply constraint filtering consistently for constrained and unconstrained drags.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve snapping candidate filtering and transform overlay feedback.

title: Multiple "streams" for graphical data, click targets, snap targets, gizmos, and parameter widgets?

review.reason: Proposes extra graph streams in the subgraph for graphical data, click targets, snap targets, gizmos and parameter widgets, later compiled by Graphene. Varve has no subgraph or stream concept and derives hit testing and snapping from scene geometry.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected; there is no graph stream model to extend.

title: Node for tweening "topo lines" across several guide paths

review.reason: Requests a node that tweens topo lines across several guide paths, producing an evenly spaced family of interpolated paths. Varve's motion path morph interpolates between existing paths and there is no node graph to generate path families.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; only two-path morphing exists.

title: Proportional editing in the Path tool

review.reason: Blender-style proportional editing should give falloff-based influence on nearby path points, including Bezier handles. Varve's path/node editing has no documented proportional falloff, so shaping a curve moves only the selected points.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path tool point manipulation and node-editing overlays.

title: Unable to set Polygon tool to other amounts of points, doing so crashes

review.reason: A delayed or misaddressed widget value update for the pivot input panicked, and after changing the polygon sides option any shortcut crashed the editor. Varve's tool-option fields feed state updates that must tolerate stale or mismatched widget ids instead of panicking.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve tool-options palette fields, number input widgets and state-update validation.

title: Replace Bezier-rs usages with Kurbo in the editor

review.reason: Internal Rust dependency migration replacing Bezier-rs usages with Kurbo across Graphite's editor. Varve maintains its own geometry code and does not depend on Bezier-rs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path is affected.

title: Add a "Select Parent" command

review.reason: Adds a Select Parent command under Layer that moves each selected layer up one hierarchy level. Varve selects within nested groups and frames and has a command palette to host such an action, but no documented Select Parent command.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve selection commands, menubar entries and command palette actions.

title: Image trace vectorization

review.reason: Varve already ships image trace/vectorization natively in varve-trace, with silhouette, centerline and pixel-art modes plus Oklab quantization. VTracer is only Graphite's candidate library for the same capability.
review.varveAssessment: Image trace workflow in Varve; the requested capability already exists and needs no port.

title: Make dragging layers to rearrange them abortable with Esc/RMB

review.reason: Dragging layers to reorder must be abortable with Esc or right-click, restoring the original order instead of committing or silently doing nothing. Varve's layers panel drag-reorder needs the same abort contract across browsers.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve layers panel drag reordering and keyboard abort handling.

title: Proper node graph interaction aborting with Esc/RMB

review.reason: Both bullets are node-graph editor interactions: restoring a dragged wire's original connection and restoring the selection when a graph box-selection is right-clicked. Varve has no node graph; the canvas equivalents are tracked separately.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected; there are no graph wires or graph box selections.

title: Remove the old node macro

review.reason: Removes Graphite's legacy node macro and ports its remaining Brightness/Contrast, map_image and Into usages to the modern macro. This is Graphite-internal node-definition plumbing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path is affected.

title: Eyedropper tool doesn't support Vello

review.reason: The Vello support half is renderer-specific, but the reported web bug where cross-origin raster content taints the canvas and makes getImageData throw applies to any browser build. Varve's web/WASM build samples canvas pixels for colour picking and must handle tainted sources without throwing.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve web pixel sampling, image import origins and eyedropper failure handling.

title: Replace layer thumbnails with Vello renders

review.reason: Varve's thumbnail system already renders previews through the canonical engine path (flattenSceneToEngine plus engine generateThumbnail) with identity-keyed caching, scheduling and placeholder policy. Rendering them with Vello is Graphite-specific.
review.varveAssessment: Thumbnail pipeline in Varve; no renderer swap is required.

title: Add feature gate to only display GPU-based nodes when WGPU is available

review.reason: Gates display of GPU-only nodes in the node graph when WGPU is unavailable. Varve has no node list to gate; GPU features are already opt-in behind accelerator capability stages with a Canvas2D fallback.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected; there is no node catalogue to hide.

title: Modularize GPU blend mode as a merge node

review.reason: Modularises Graphite's GPU blend mode into a merge node inside the graph. Varve has no node graph or GPU buffer merge nodes; blend modes are a compositor property.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve compositor path is affected.

title: Add nodes for updating existing GPU buffers

review.reason: Requests nodes that update existing GPU buffers in place instead of reallocating. Varve has no GPU buffer nodes or graph to attach them to.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve render or GPU path is affected.

title: Rasterize vector content at the appropriate time in the graph

review.reason: Asks for the Into node, which rasterises vector content at a chosen point in the node graph. Varve has no graph stages; its renderer replays a built IR.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve rendering stage is affected.

title: Revamp menu bar for touch devices

review.reason: The body is empty; only the Web label indicates a touch-oriented menu bar revamp. Varve already gates touch-only affordances, but whether its menubar actually fails on touch devices cannot be determined from the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch Varve's menubar and touch capability gating, but no concrete gap is stated.

title: Thorough testing of tools for pen/touch usability

review.reason: The body is empty and the ask is broad manual testing of every tool with pen and touch input. No specific defect is described, so it is unclear which Varve tools would need rework.
review.varveAssessment: Would concern Varve's stylus/touch input handling, but nothing concrete is identified.

title: Keyboardless interaction throughout the editor

review.reason: The body is empty; the label suggests design work for operating the editor without a keyboard. Varve already exposes commands through the palette and context surfaces, but no concrete gap is described.
review.varveAssessment: Would concern Varve's command palette and pointer-accessible actions, but the packet gives no requirements.

title: Color palettes

review.reason: Asks for colour palettes with linked swatches plus design-token import so edits propagate to fills and strokes. Varve has a DTCG token engine (@varve/tokens) and document colour variables, but the packet does not establish whether a palette/swatch browser with fill binding exists.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch Varve colour variables, the Variables panel and @varve/tokens import.

title: Tracking Issue: Graphene language development

review.reason: Tracking issue for developing the Graphene language and its compiler, following pre-MVP work. Varve has no Graphene and no code-defined node system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Text alignment, justification, and hyphenation

review.reason: Remaining open items are hyphenation and mid-word wrapping plus last-line paragraph alignment and inter-word versus inter-character justification ratios. Varve's text pipeline covers shaping, BiDi and vertical writing but hyphenation is not documented, so wrapped text cannot break words.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve text layout, line breaking and the text Inspector controls.

title: Snapping improvements/revamp

review.reason: Umbrella snapping revamp; the concrete asks are grid snapping while nudging path points with G and optional snapping to stroke boundaries. Varve has a sticky-snap system but no documented point-level grid or stroke-boundary snapping.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve snapping candidates, point dragging and the snapping preference surface.

title: Checkboxes clickable by their labels

review.reason: Varve's shared @varve/ui primitives follow APG patterns with native form controls and associated labels, so clicking a checkbox label activates the control rather than only the box. Same request as duplicate #2381.
review.varveAssessment: Checkbox and label markup in @varve/ui; no editor workflow change.

title: New contextual Properties panel (and rename current one to Parameters)

review.reason: Varve already separates these surfaces: the Inspector is the complete editor, the context bar follows the selection with its properties, and tool options live in the floating palette. The requested contextual-versus-parameters split therefore exists without a Graphite-style node parameter panel.
review.varveAssessment: Panel architecture in Varve; no new panel split is needed.

title: Design clarification for the relationship between changing tool options for future shapes vs. for selected shapes

review.reason: The open design question is whether changing a tool option also patches already-selected shapes. Varve documents tool options in the palette and selection properties in the context bar, but not the edit-target rule between them.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve tool-option semantics in the floating palette versus the Inspector.

title: Redesigned vector tool fill/stroke selection in relation to the working colors and selected layers

review.reason: A broad design rework of how the fill/stroke selector relates to working colours and the current selection; the discussion notes the default white fill confuses users. Varve has multiple fills and strokes per object, but the packet does not establish whether its defaults or selector model share the problem.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch Varve fill/stroke properties, the Inspector and working-colour defaults.

title: Deprecate and archive Bezier-rs

review.reason: Archiving the Bezier-rs library once its Graphite usages are migrated to Kurbo. Varve does not depend on Bezier-rs; this is Graphite dependency housekeeping.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path is affected.

title: Node Graph UX: improved discoverability through type-based suggestions

review.reason: Node-graph UX: filter the Search Nodes suggestion list by the dragged port type and open it by double-clicking empty graph space. Varve has no node graph; its command palette is action-based, not type-filtered port insertion.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Deleting an artboard doesn't update

review.reason: Deleting an artboard left it painted until something else forced a redraw, a regression from a rendering refactor. Varve's render pipeline must invalidate and repaint when nodes are deleted instead of reusing a surface that no new frame will replace.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve canvas invalidation, frame/dirty-rect handling and delete operations.

title: Fix drawing with tilted viewport

review.reason: With a tilted viewport, drawing a rectangle aligned it to document space instead of viewport space, changing behaviour from the previous implementation. Varve supports a rotated camera, so its tools must decide and consistently apply view-space versus document-space alignment.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve camera-space handling in drawing tools and its screen/world transform helpers.

title: Vello breaks colour picker

review.reason: Closed as a duplicate: the colour picker returning black with experimental Vello enabled is the same renderer support gap tracked in #2340. Varve has no Vello, but the canvas-taint sampling failure described there is the transferable part.
review.varveAssessment: No separate Varve work beyond the taint-safe pixel sampling noted in #2340.

title: Select tool resizing with Shift held fails to preserve aspect ratio when snapping

review.reason: Shift-constrained corner resizing lost the aspect ratio as soon as snapping engaged, because the snap target overrode the constraint. Varve's snapping candidates and aspect-ratio constraint must compose rather than compete.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve resize handles, constraint modifiers and snapping resolution.

title: Copy/pasting vector and raster content between other graphics apps

review.reason: Copy and paste of vector and raster hierarchies between creative applications needs multi-flavour clipboard encoding plus web-versus-desktop degradation. Varve imports and exports many formats but the packet gives no evidence of OS clipboard interop.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve clipboard, import/export fidelity and platform abstraction on web versus Tauri.

title: Nudge-scaling of points with the Path tool

review.reason: Alt+arrow nudge-scaling should resize the bounding box of selected path points with proportional scaling of intermediate points. Varve nudges selections but has no documented nudge-scale for path points.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve arrow-key nudge handling and path tool point selection.

title: Make it possible to snap the pivot gizmo when dragging it

review.reason: Snapping the pivot gizmo while dragging it is soft-blocked on the pivot-versus-origin rework in #2225. Until Varve has a draggable transform pivot with selectable modes, there is no pivot gizmo to snap.
review.varveAssessment: Depends on the transform pivot-mode capability described in #2225.

title: Make modal interaction states take exclusive control over inputs

review.reason: While a modal interaction such as a tool drag or G/R/S is active, all other keys must be blocked from reaching global shortcuts that could switch tools or regroup layers. Varve's ActionRegistry and shortcut dispatch have no documented interaction-owned input lock.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve shortcut gating, BaseTool drag state and workspace-switch interaction resolution.

title: Lock axis when panning

review.reason: Panning with Space or MMB should lock to the viewport X or Y axis while Shift is held, staying view-aligned when the viewport is tilted. Varve's camera pan has no documented axis lock; the comments also flag conflicts between drag-pan and scroll-pan.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve camera pan interactions and modifier handling.

title: Fix and reenable the panic proxy to make debugging crashes a little easier

review.reason: Graphite-internal debugging tooling: repair and re-enable its web panic proxy so Rust panics surface usefully. Varve has its own crash-reporting crate and a Tauri/web split rather than this wasm panic-forwarding shim.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected.

title: Locally "peeking through" the overlaid node graph to view the artwork underneath

review.reason: A node-graph overlay feature: hold Space to peek through the graph at the artwork underneath through a magnifier bubble. Varve has no node-graph overlay to see through.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Replace the FontInput component with font DropdownInputs defined in the backend

review.reason: Refactor replacing Graphite's FontInput frontend component with backend-defined dropdown widgets, a prerequisite for its message-driven layout system. Varve's React UI composes its own font controls, so nothing structural transfers.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve font-picker workflow is affected by this refactor.

title: Clickable checkbox labels that toggle their associated checkbox

review.reason: Identical request to #2353: clicking a checkbox's text label should toggle the checkbox. Varve's shared UI components associate labels with their native controls.
review.varveAssessment: Checkbox and label markup in @varve/ui; no separate work item.

title: The pressed Spacebar should show an open hand cursor before click-dragging makes it a closed hand

review.reason: Holding Space without dragging should show an open-hand cursor, switching to the closed hand only while panning. Varve's camera pan needs the same two-state cursor feedback wherever the Space modifier is accepted.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve cursor management and pan interaction states.

title: Add a preference for the size of vector point anchor/handle manipulators

review.reason: Requests a preference for the size of vector point anchors and handle manipulators. Varve draws path handles as fixed-size overlays with no documented size preference, which affects precision on high-DPI and touch input.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path/node overlays and its preferences surface.

title: Hide the window title if there isn't enough room to display it

review.reason: The window title should hide via CSS when there is not enough room rather than clipping against adjacent controls. Varve's shell and menubar title area faces the same constrained-width problem.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve shell/menubar layout and responsive overflow behaviour.

title: Revise the styling of nodes in different states within the graph

review.reason: Restyling graph nodes so hidden and selected states differ, and so nodes stay legible over artwork at low overlay opacity. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Rename `responses` to `messages` throughout the message handlers

review.reason: Rename responses to messages throughout Graphite's Rust message handlers. Varve's React/TypeScript architecture has no equivalent message-handler layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path is affected.

title: Outline view mode doesn't always render with a consistent thickness

review.reason: Outline (wireframe) view drew many layers thicker than the intended 1px because layer stroke widths leaked into the outline pass. The packet does not establish that Varve has an outline or wireframe view mode, so no affected path is demonstrated.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's renderer only if such an outline view mode exists.

title: Recursive folder expand/collapse

review.reason: Alt-clicking a folder arrow should expand or collapse that whole subtree recursively, with the modifier plumbed through to the handler. Varve's layers panel groups have no documented recursive expand modifier.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve layers panel group expansion and its collapse state model.

title: Make the Pen tool show a path being closed by drawing a filled overlay when hovering the endpoint

review.reason: The Pen tool should preview closing a path with a filled translucent interior when hovering the endpoint that would close it, across multiple subpaths. Varve's pen tool has no documented close-preview affordance.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve pen tool overlays and path closing interaction.

title: Box/lasso selection should be compatible with PTZ

review.reason: Box and lasso selection must stay anchored to the canvas start point while panning or zooming mid-drag, while still drawing on rounded viewport coordinates. Varve supports camera pan and zoom during selection, so the same anchoring rule is needed.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve box/lasso selection, camera interaction during drags and overlay drawing.

title: Shallow Select mode fails to transfer selection to selected sibling

review.reason: In Shallow Select, clicking a sibling of the already-selected layer returned selection to the shared parent instead of transferring to that sibling. Varve's click-through selection under groups and frames needs the same scope-preserving rule.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve selection resolution for nested groups and frames.

title: Noise Pattern node is broken

review.reason: A node-graph node (Noise Pattern) lost its input definitions, so its unconnected generic parameters failed type checking. Varve has no node graph or dynamically typed node parameters.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Flick panning

review.reason: Optional flick (inertial) panning so the viewport glides after release, which speeds navigation on large artwork. Varve's camera pan has no documented momentum or deceleration behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve camera pan interactions and preference surface.

title: Canvas rotation

review.reason: Varve's camera already supports viewport rotation, with rotation-aware screenToWorld/worldToScreen shared by the renderer and overlays. Only the incidental suggestion of rotation angle snapping is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas rotation exists in Varve; no new capability is required.

title: Freehand vector objects cannot be moved with V + LMB

review.reason: Open unfilled paths from the Freehand tool could not be dragged by their bounding box because hit testing follows fill. Varve hit-tests selections and must let open stroked paths be picked and dragged by their stroke.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve hit testing, selection of open paths and default fill/stroke colours.

title: Operator for making point handles equidistant if they are not

review.reason: Wanted a batch operator making both handles of many points equidistant; the existing path was a modifier drag per handle that risks changing the angle. Varve's corner/smooth/bend node editing offers no documented batch handle-length command.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve path node editing commands and the command palette.

title: Preference option for turning off UI animations.

review.reason: Requests a preference to suppress UI animations; Graphite declined it as speculative for its 200ms graph fade. Varve's accessibility contract should honour a reduced-motion preference for panel and overlay transitions instead of leaving animation unconditional.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve overlay/panel transitions and its preferences and accessibility surfaces.

title: Subdivide Path node

review.reason: The deliverable is a Subdivide Path node taking path-element selections as an input. Varve has no node graph or node-defined path operations, so this request as filed has no place to live.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve node-less path workflow is affected by this node request.

title: Preference for zoom scaling

review.reason: Requests a multiplier for zoom steps so flying-scroll wheels and trackpads can be tuned, since browser wheel deltas are quantised. Varve's camera zoom has no documented rate preference; Graphite later implemented it in #2411.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve camera zoom steps and its preferences surface.

title: Inherit Alpha and Alpha Lock

review.reason: Inherit Alpha masks from the layer below without hand-building a mask, and Alpha Lock lets painting change RGB while preserving alpha. Varve has clip/alpha masks and raster brushes but no documented alpha lock or inherit-alpha layer option.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve raster paint tools, layer options and mask composition.

title: Node for calculating the "medial axis transform and "straight skeleton"

review.reason: Requests a node computing the medial axis transform and straight skeleton for rigging and masks. Varve has no node graph, and its stroke rigging and path tools do not consume skeleton graphs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected by this node proposal.

title: Boolean operations support for cutting out and separating non-manifold paths

review.reason: Wants boolean-style cutting and separating of non-manifold paths so the lines between coloured regions can be extracted and split into groups. Varve has a boolean operations module, but non-manifold cut and separate behaviour is not in its documented feature set.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve boolean operations, path geometry and shape builder.

title: Preference to adjust zoom rate

review.reason: Concrete follow-up to #2407: expose the hardcoded viewport zoom wheel rate as a preference, ideally on a log scale. Varve's camera zoom rate is not documented as user-configurable.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve camera zoom sensitivity and its preferences surface.

title: Fix tools not drawing in nested transform space

review.reason: Tools must inverse the transform of the space they draw into, so drawing inside a transformed group or a tilted viewport lands under the cursor. Varve has both transformed groups and a rotatable view, so its drawing tools need the same compensation.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Varve drawing tools, nested transform handling and camera transforms.

title: Can't connect "Color Value" node to "Background" input of an artboard

review.reason: Connecting a Color Value node to an artboard's Background input needs layer-type nodes to accept parameters, which the maintainer says is not actionable yet. Varve has no node graph or node-typed artboard inputs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Add custom data types for angles and factors/percentages

review.reason: Asks for node-graph value types for angles and factors so ports stop using bare f64 and stop confusing degrees with radians. Varve has no graph-defined value types; its number fields already carry units and display scaling.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve node or port type system is affected.

title: Add arc/unclosed shape options to circle node

review.reason: Requested as Circle-node parameters pairing a start angle with an angular distance to produce arcs and pie-style circles. Varve has no node graph, and the packet does not establish whether its ellipse or shape tools expose arc segment parameters.
review.varveAssessment: Would concern Varve shape tools only if they lack arc/pie segment parameters, which the packet does not establish.

title: Outline mode stroke width inconsistent related to parent layer scale value

review.reason: Graphite's Outline/wireframe view mode drew hairlines whose width changed under a parent layer's non-1 scale, and it was closed as completed by #2455. Varve has vector rendering with stroke widths, but the packet establishes nothing about a wireframe/outline view mode, so whether Varve has an equivalent non-scaling hairline path is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: If Varve has or adds an outline view mode, hairline strokes must resolve in screen space independently of nested layer transforms.

title: Attemtping to Add a Second Artboard crashes.

review.reason: Both symptoms come from Graphene specifics: an artboard inside another artboard is an invalid node data type, and the stray artboard was being displayed as a plain node instead of as a layer after an input was exposed. Varve has no node graph, no expose-parameter dot and no display-as-layer toggle, so neither failure mode exists there.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; adding a frame is a direct scene-model operation with no typed node connections to invalidate.

title: Using the Gradient tool on a raster layer creates an invalid graph

review.reason: The gradient tool injected a Fill node that cannot accept a raster input, leaving an invalid node graph (fixed in #2456). Varve tools edit scene nodes directly and there are no typed node connections that a tool interaction could invalidate.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the defect is a node-graph type-validation failure.

title: Gradient tool always re-selects its end point after any click/drag

review.reason: Clicking a non-end gradient point re-selected the end point because the PointerUp FSM transition rebuilt the selection with SelectedGradient::new (a regression from #1945, fixed by #2472). The durable requirement is that a click selects the stop or handle under the cursor and that pointer-up must not overwrite the user's selection.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's on-canvas gradient handle editing and the GradientEditor stop selection need this selection-preservation guarantee.

title: Page freezes when trying to auto-load some old documents

review.reason: One stored document that failed its upgrade/parse path panicked during startup autoload and left the whole editor unresponsive; Graphite's fix was to skip broken documents (#2453). Varve restores sessions at startup, but the packet gives no evidence about how its loader and schema migrations handle a document that cannot be loaded.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's session-restore/document-load path if a failing migration is not isolated per document.

title: Exposing a value to the graph should add and connect up an equivalent value node

review.reason: Expose-dot interaction, graph connectors and generic value nodes are Graphene node-graph concepts; the packet's own follow-up comment notes that values live in inputs and the identity node acts as a universal value node. Varve has no node graph, so there is no expose/un-expose state to keep in sync with a Properties panel value.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Dragging handle back into its anchor makes its opposite handle move around randomly

review.reason: A handle dragged back onto its anchor makes the opposite handle jump; the later reproduction narrows the root cause to collinear handles combined with Along Path snapping near the anchor point. Varve has path handle editing and a snapping module, so handle drag near an anchor must not perturb the opposite handle.
review.varveAssessment: Path/node handle dragging in CanvasArea together with the snapping logic in packages/editor/src/tools/snapping.ts.

title: Add node that plots graphs as geometry using parametric equations

review.reason: Requests a new parametric-equation node with density controls inside the Graphene node graph. Varve is direct-manipulation and has no node graph or procedural evaluation engine.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; a procedural node system is an explicit non-goal.

title: Allow math node to work with variadic inputs

review.reason: Variadic inputs for Graphite's Math node, explicitly blocked on the variadic-input node work in #2462. Varve has no node definitions, node macro, or Math node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Allow naming nodes and showing their names in the Properties panel

review.reason: Naming nodes and surfacing those names in the Properties panel is node-graph UI. Varve names scene nodes in its Layers panel and has no graph-node identities to label.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Node variadic inputs to represent T as T[]

review.reason: Variadic inputs (T[] exposed as multiple ordered wires into one port) are a node-macro and wire-routing feature of Graphene. Varve has no node graph, wires, or node macro.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Testing for GRS

review.reason: A Graphite-internal QA checklist for its modal G/R/S transform operator, with every row already checked against merged PRs. It records no defect statement and has no Varve counterpart; the modal grab/rotate/scale operator it tests is a Graphite workflow, not a Varve one.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve tracks its own affected-validation plans.

title: The 'Mask' node crashes when used

review.reason: Creating Graphene's Mask node panicked in the node-network interface with an index-out-of-bounds (fixed by #2474). Varve masks are scene-model properties on a group or frame (clip/alpha/luminance), not graph nodes, so there is no node-insertion path to crash.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve masking is applied through the scene model.

title: [Crash Report] In Node Graph view

review.reason: Crash while removing an export slot because the network's exports list and the node's output-name map had drifted apart. Exports as node-graph outputs are a Graphene concept; Varve export settings are not node outputs, so the divergence cannot occur.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Fix broken links in documentation

review.reason: rustdoc intra-doc-link warnings inside Graphite's bezier-rs crate (unresolved bracket links, bare URLs, links to private items). That is Graphite's own library documentation hygiene; Varve has no bezier-rs crate and the packet describes no user-facing documentation workflow.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve's docs gate covers its own Markdown docs, not Graphite's Rust crates.

title: Spline tool extending a transformed spline is broken

review.reason: Extending a spline that had been transformed placed the new point away from the cursor because the tool did not map the click through the layer's transform (Graphite later reported it fixed in the dev build). Varve's pen/path tools can continue a path inside transformed containers, so pointer-to-local mapping has to be applied consistently there.
review.varveAssessment: Pen/path tool continuation and the camera plus per-container transform mapping in CanvasArea.

title: Testing spline drawing

review.reason: Graphite's spline-drawing QA checklist; two rows remain unchecked, including C2-continuous closing when clicking the start anchor and appending to a transformed spline in a group (#2482). Varve has spline-capable pen/path tools, but the packet gives no acceptance detail and no evidence about Varve's closing continuity or append behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the pen/path tool spline fitting if Varve lacks C2-continuous closing.

title: Spline tool draws offset on an offset artboard

review.reason: A spline drawn on an artboard that had been dragged away from the origin came out offset because the tool used unshifted coordinates (fixed by #2489). Any tool placing geometry inside an offset or transformed container must map the pointer into that container's space.
review.varveAssessment: Pointer-to-document mapping for shape and pen tools drawing inside offset frames.

title: Line tool draws with offset on an offset artboard

review.reason: The same offset-artboard class as #2484, for the Line tool's start point; both were fixed together in #2489. The packet tracks it separately, so it is recorded as its own reproduction for Varve's line drawing.
review.varveAssessment: Line tool start-point mapping inside offset containers on the Varve canvas.

title: Line tool doesn't show overlays when drawing horizontal line

review.reason: For exactly horizontal or vertical lines (Shift-constrained) the blue endpoint overlays were not drawn, while every other angle drew them; fixed in the same PR as the other tool fixes (#2489). Axis-aligned geometry is the degenerate case for overlays and hit regions and needs explicit handling.
review.varveAssessment: Shape/line drawing overlays and the axis-aligned degenerate geometry case in the canvas overlay layer.

title: Testing line tool

review.reason: Graphite's line-tool QA checklist; all but one row are checked, and the open row is that after drawing only selected layers can have their endpoints dragged. Whether Varve restricts line endpoint dragging to selected geometry is not described in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the line/shape tool endpoint handles if Varve lets endpoints of unselected layers be dragged.

title: Testing gradient tool

review.reason: Graphite's gradient-tool QA checklist; all five rows are checked against merged PRs (offset documents, 15-degree snapping, double-click stop insertion, drag reorder, delete stop) and no outstanding defect is stated. Whether Varve's gradient stop editing covers the same set is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's gradient stop editing (GradientEditor and on-canvas gradient handles).

title: Unexposing an input doesn't immediately invalidate the cache

review.reason: Unexposing an input did not invalidate Graphene's node-graph cache immediately (fixed by #2512), so the canvas lingered on stale output. Varve has no node evaluation cache keyed on graph inputs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Fields MVP

review.reason: Fields MVP proposes per-repetition evaluation contexts for Graphene's Repeat node, including varargs index and node deduplication. Varve has no node evaluation engine, contexts, or varargs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Edit->Duplicate in the node graph makes extra duplicates of reused input nodes

review.reason: Duplicating a selection that shares upstream input nodes produced extra perfectly-overlapping copies in the node graph. Varve duplicates scene nodes, where shared upstream inputs are not a concept, so no equivalent wiring or overlap problem exists.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Pen tool creates single anchor path

review.reason: Mouse down/up with the pen tool and then switching tools left an empty layer containing a single-anchor path (fixed by #2511, with regressions reported afterwards). A shape tool should discard a path that never acquired real geometry instead of leaving an unusable empty layer.
review.varveAssessment: Pen/path tool press-release-without-drag handling and the resulting empty-layer creation.

title: Auto panning doesn't work (regression)

review.reason: Auto panning stopped working for every tool after #2443 and was fixed by #2562. Dragging past the viewport edge during a tool interaction must keep scrolling the camera in Varve too.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas camera auto-pan during drag interactions in CanvasArea and the tool handlers.

title: Testing auto panning

review.reason: A test-coverage tracker for the auto-pan regression in #2504, listing the tool combinations that should be covered. The defect itself was fixed in Graphite; whether Varve has auto-pan and any regression coverage for it is not described.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect canvas auto-pan interaction behaviour and its browser-test coverage.

title: Add tests for the layer tree

review.reason: Tracking issue for adding Graphite's own layer-tree test suite (#2577, #2578, #2579, #2580, #2585), all rows already checked. It requests Graphite-internal regression tests rather than reporting a user-facing defect Varve could adopt.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve maintains its own layers-panel tests.

title: Replace MemoizeImpure with Boundless Footprint -> Memoize

review.reason: Replaces Graphene's MemoizeImpure node with a Boundless Footprint -> Memoize pair and asks for an upgrade script for saved graphs. Varve has no memoization nodes or node-graph upgrade scripts.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: SVG import is exponentially slow with respect to the number of layers

review.reason: The reported O(n^2) cost comes from placing each imported node by shifting existing node coordinates (vertical_shift_with_push / shift_node_or_parent). Graph node placement is a Graphene concept; Varve's SVG import writes scene nodes with no node-network coordinate layout step.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected by this specific hot loop, though Varve's own SVG import performance would be measured separately.

title: Support multiple outputs in a proto node definition with return struct unpacking in the node macro

review.reason: Node macro changes so a returned struct is unpacked into multiple node outputs, ideally without generating a subgraph. Varve has no node macro, proto nodes, or subgraphs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Procedural vector data and attributes design considerations

review.reason: Closed as a duplicate; it is a design-considerations brain dump for Graphene's procedural vector data model (struct-of-arrays attributes, monadic attributes, compute-shader friendliness, Vello harmony). Varve has a concrete scene model and no procedural attribute graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Importing SVG gradients with userSpaceOnUse

review.reason: SVG gradients using gradientUnits=userSpaceOnUse imported as a solid black shape because the importer ignored that unit mode; fixed in Graphite by #3741 after earlier attempts in #3602. Varve imports SVG gradients into its linear/radial/conic model, so userSpaceOnUse coordinates must be resolved against the document rather than assumed to be objectBoundingBox.
review.varveAssessment: SVG gradient parsing in @varve/import and the coordinate mapping into Varve's gradient model.

title: Add Vello support for non-scaling stroke width

review.reason: Asks for Vello renderer parity with Graphite's SVG renderer for Stroke::non_scaling, which its Outline mode relies on. Varve has no Vello renderer; its compositor is Canvas2D by default with opt-in WebGPU, so this renderer-specific gap has no Varve equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the parity work lives inside Graphite's Vello backend.

title: Familiar shortcut commands

review.reason: Requests familiar industry shortcuts for filling a layer with the primary or secondary working colour (Alt/Ctrl plus Delete/Backspace, Shift variants for a fill-options menu). Varve already has multi-fill layers, a shortcut registry and a command palette, so this is a concrete familiarity gap over an existing workflow rather than a new subsystem.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's ShortcutManager bindings and the fill actions registered in the ActionRegistry.

title: In the graph, a click that deselects a node loses the entered input field value

review.reason: In the graph, a mouse-down deselect destroyed the Properties widgets before the typed value was committed; Graphite fixed it by deferring the properties-panel refresh to the next animation frame (#3337). Varve's Inspector controls are React components, so this Rust widget-lifecycle cause should not transfer, but the packet shows nothing about how Varve orders a field commit against a selection change.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector numeric/text field commit ordering when the selection changes or clears.

title: Dropping nodes onto a wire, to insert it inline, sometimes doesn't work for secondary inputs

review.reason: Dropping a node onto a wire to insert it inline failed for secondary inputs because the network interface could not resolve the upstream output. Varve has no wires, primary/secondary ports, or inline node insertion.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Add lasso selection mode to the node graph as well

review.reason: Requests Ctrl+drag lasso parity inside the node graph so it matches canvas selection. Varve has no node graph to apply selection modes to.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the request is scoped to the graph canvas.

title: GRS fails on sharp points and box selection wrongly targets its zero-length handles

review.reason: Box-selecting a corner anchor also selected its two zero-length handles, which then distorted the following transform, while a click-selected corner failed the modal transform entirely. Even without Graphite's G/R/S operator, treating coincident zero-length handles as separate selectable items is a selection defect for corner-node editing.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool box selection and corner-node handle selection in Varve's node editing.

title: Tracking Issue: Desktop application

review.reason: Varve already ships a Tauri 2 desktop app whose native Rust engine performs the rendering behind the same facade as web, delivering the native performance, file access and platform APIs this tracking issue exists to obtain.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; desktop delivery already exists.

title: Upgrade Tauri to v2 and get it running again

review.reason: Varve's desktop app is already on Tauri 2 (apps/desktop/src-tauri) with WebKitGTK/GTK3 on Linux.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the upgrade is already in place.

title: Make the Tauri part of the code base optional

review.reason: Varve keeps the Tauri shell in apps/desktop/src-tauri while the browser build runs the same public facade on the WASM engine, so the native part is not required to build or ship the web target.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; the native layer is already partitioned from the web-facing build.

title: Investigate moving editor code from Wasm to native in Tauri builds

review.reason: An investigation into moving Graphite's all-Rust editor logic from Wasm into a native Tauri process. Varve has no Rust editor logic in Wasm: UI and editor logic are TypeScript and only the engine is native Rust.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the architectural premise does not exist here.

title: Release desktop builds for direct download with an installer and self-updater

review.reason: Varve's release pipeline already produces platform installers for Linux, Windows and macOS plus a Tauri updater feed whose signatures are tracked separately from platform code signing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; packaging and the self-updater already exist.

title: Tracking Issue: Adapt systems to support native platform APIs

review.reason: Native platform APIs are already abstracted behind @varve/platform with Tauri, web and memory implementations, which is the adaptation this tracking issue describes. The remaining items were moved to #3507 and #3508 upstream.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the platform abstraction already covers native capabilities.

title: Get the viewport to render beneath the web UI

review.reason: CEF-style compositing where a web UI is rendered to an offscreen texture over a natively rendered viewport. Varve renders the canvas inside the webview by replaying engine IR to Canvas2D (opt-in WebGPU), so there are no two rendering surfaces to blend at the OS compositor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Release Mac builds through the Mac App Store

review.reason: A distribution-channel request (Mac App Store) with no body or defect. Varve's release pipeline targets direct-download installers and an updater; store channels are a product decision not described by this issue.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve engineering path affected.

title: Release Windows builds through the Microsoft Store

review.reason: A distribution-channel request (Microsoft Store) with no body or defect. Varve distributes installers directly through its own release pipeline, so no Store packaging work is implied.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve engineering path affected.

title: Release desktop builds through Steam

review.reason: A distribution-channel request (Steam) with no body or defect. Nothing in the packet describes behaviour Varve needs to change; it is a publishing decision only.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve engineering path affected.

title: Implement PWA resource caching and self-contained distribution of all static resources

review.reason: Asks for PWA resource caching so the web build is self-contained and usable offline. Varve is local-first and has a browser build, but the packet contains no evidence about whether that build registers a service worker or precache manifest.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the web build's static asset delivery and offline availability.

title: Get the Tauri build to render the viewport content natively (separately for now)

review.reason: Getting Graphite's Tauri build to render the viewport into a separate native window, as a step toward #2541. Varve renders in a single webview and has no separate native viewport window.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Package and distribute Graphite across common desktop platforms

review.reason: Varve already packages and distributes desktop builds for Linux, Windows and macOS through its release pipeline, including signing verification and an updater feed.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; cross-platform distribution already ships.

title: Transform node rotation breaks Pen tool shapes when entered manually

review.reason: Graphite closed this as intended behaviour: typing a rotation edits the object's raw transform about its local origin while interactive rotation also compensates position, and a pivot-based numeric rotation was filed as follow-up #2225. Varve's own numeric rotation semantics (Inspector field versus on-canvas pivot) are not described in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's Inspector rotation field and its relationship to the on-canvas transform pivot.

title: It's impossible to drag axis-aligned lines

review.reason: Axis-aligned lines had almost no hover or click area, could not be dragged (a box selection started instead), and always showed the rotate cursor; fixed by #2561. Zero-area bounding boxes are a hit-testing trap for any direct-manipulation editor, Varve's included.
review.varveAssessment: Selection hit-testing and transform-handle placement for zero-area axis-aligned geometry in the canvas.

title: Add options to the 'Repeat' node for the spacing with envelope/span/pitch/gap

review.reason: Spacing modes (envelope/span/pitch/gap) and angular limits for Graphene's Repeat and Circular Repeat nodes. Varve has no Repeat node, node parameters, or node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Space when dragging to shift what's being drawn

review.reason: Requests that holding Space during any drag offset what is being dragged, and enumerates the tools that still lack it (transform cage, box/lasso select, artboard, gradient, path, line, shapes, text). Varve has these drag interactions with a shared tool/base-handler layer where one uniform modifier could apply.
review.varveAssessment: Shared drag handling across Varve tools (BaseTool and tool handlers) plus the canvas modifier-key layer.

title: Path tool click targets erroneously include hidden 'Path' node modifications

review.reason: Path-tool click targets were generated from hidden modifier nodes inside the node graph (resolved by #2932). Varve's path tool reads scene nodes directly and has no hidden modifier nodes to bypass.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Proportional editing mode

review.reason: Feature request for Blender-style proportional editing, closed upstream as a duplicate without further requirements. Varve's documented node-editing modes (corner/smooth/bend) have no falloff-weighted mode, so the surrounding workflow exists without the proportional-editing capability.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's node editing/transform tools would need a falloff radius affecting neighbouring points.

title: Add overlays for anchors, just like segments, for hovered/selected vector layers

review.reason: Hovered/selected vector layers showed segment overlays but no overlay for isolated anchors with no connected segments (closed by #2630). Varve draws canvas overlays for path editing, so segment-less anchors need the same visibility.
review.varveAssessment: Selection/hover overlays for path anchors in the canvas overlay layer.

title: Shallow Select mode should also display hover overlays for what a click and double-click will select

review.reason: Describes hover overlays for a Shallow Select mode that previews what a click and a double-click would select, with up to three concurrent overlays at different opacities (fixed by #2639). Varve's selection depth model is not described in the packet, so whether an equivalent shallow/deep selection exists is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's selection overlay and click/double-click target resolution inside groups and frames.

title: Single, unified Value node that picks its type from usage

review.reason: A single generic Value node whose type is chosen by usage, driven by a widget-picker popover on the node's expose dot. Varve has no nodes, typed graph values, or expose dots.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Scatter points does not work on shapes with holes

review.reason: Graphite's Scatter Points node filled holes because point-in-region testing ignored subpath winding. Varve has no scatter node; its hole handling lives in boolean/path operations, which this issue does not touch.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected by the node defect described.

title: Drawing a shape at non-100% viewport zoom wrongly applies the scale to the Transform node not the shape

review.reason: Varve has no per-object Transform node: shape tools compute document-space geometry through the camera, so viewport zoom cannot leak into an object's scale. Graphite keeps the scale on a Transform node because its viewport rotation would otherwise rotate new layers.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected by the reported mechanism.

title: Drawing by appending to the selected layer fails on empty layers

review.reason: Shift-append drawing into a brand-new or modifier-only layer produced a broken result because the tool always appended a Flatten Vector Elements node instead of creating Path/Stroke. Varve's pen/pencil tools build scene geometry, but whether it supports shift-append into an existing or empty layer is not described.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect pen/pencil drawing with a selected target layer in Varve.

title: Ergonomic way to define enums for use by nodes

review.reason: Generating dropdown/radio widgets for node parameter enums in Graphene (resolved by #2589). Varve has no node parameter or TaggedValue system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Packing algorithm node

review.reason: Requests a nonconvex packing/nesting algorithm exposed as a Graphene node with selectable algorithms. The requested surface is a node; Varve has no node graph, so the issue as written has no Varve representation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected by the node-shaped request.

title: Path tool box selection creates small square upon mousedown when animation is playing

review.reason: Pressing the mouse without dragging with the Path tool while motion playback was running drew a tiny stray marquee around the pointer. Varve has a motion timeline, a path tool and a marquee overlay, so the drag threshold must gate the marquee regardless of animation ticks.
review.varveAssessment: Marquee overlay state in the path tool during motion playback.

title: Folder with transform produces warning

review.reason: A node-graph runtime warning (failed to downcast monitor node output) when a Transform node precedes a folder. Varve has no monitor nodes, node downcasting, or graph runtime.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Guide lines

review.reason: Varve's canvas already provides guide lines with snapping, which is the substance of this request; the remaining asks (ruler-drag creation, View > Guides visibility toggle, cancel-on-Esc semantics) are affordances over that existing guide/snap system.
review.varveAssessment: Guide and snap behaviour already exists; only optional creation and visibility UI would be added.

title: Tracking Issue: Design a new vector table-based data representation for paths, meshes, nondestructive styling, and appearance

review.reason: Tracking issue for a table-based vector representation (points, paths, bends, stroke and fill styles) designed around Graphene evaluation and Vello. Varve has a concrete scene model rather than an attribute-graph data representation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Node deletion is too greedy

review.reason: Deleting a selected node also deleted upstream nodes that other nodes still used, because the delete-with-children cleanup over-reached. Varve deletes scene nodes and their descendants by design and has no upstream node dependency graph to over-prune.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Incorrect oblique snapping to a path

review.reason: Oblique snapping to a path looked incorrect, but Graphite never reproduced it reliably (suspected only for very small, heavily zoomed rectangles) and closed it as not planned for lack of steps. Varve has snapping, but the packet supplies no reproducible case to compare against.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect path/line snapping at extreme zoom if a reproducible case existed.

title: Distribution snappers are positioned based wrongly on mouse position instead of tracked object

review.reason: Distribution/alignment snapper guides were positioned from the mouse position instead of the tracked object's bounds. Snap candidates and their indicator lines must derive from the dragged geometry, which applies directly to Varve's snapping module.
review.varveAssessment: Snap candidate computation and guide rendering in Varve's snapping module.

title: Make the Fill tool work on strokes

review.reason: Asks the fill tool to target strokes as well as fills with a dotted hover overlay, and to composite the overlay so it does not spill over half the stroke. Varve has fills, multiple strokes and raster paint, but whether it has an equivalent vector fill-targeting tool is not described.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's fill/paint targeting overlay for stroked geometry.

title: Add an isolation mode to the Path tool

review.reason: Requests a Path-tool isolation toggle that fades non-selected layers and restricts selection to the selected layers unless Ctrl is held, with a possible Blender-style / key. Varve's path tool and selection have no documented isolation mode.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool options and selection filtering in Varve's canvas/sidebar selection model.

title: Nudges in the same direction should be combined in history

review.reason: Repeated same-direction arrow-key nudges should collapse into one history step, with a direction change starting a new one; Graphite notes its clone-the-document history makes coalescing hard. Varve's append-only operation-log history is a better fit, but nudge coalescing is not among its documented behaviours.
review.varveAssessment: Undo granularity for arrow-key nudges in Varve's operation-log history.

title: Adjusting the Polygon/Star tool number of points while drawing

review.reason: While drawing with the Polygon/Star tool, bracket, minus/plus, arrow keys and scroll should adjust point count, with brackets also working whenever the tool is selected. Varve's polygon/star shape tools and shortcut registry have no documented binding for this.
review.varveAssessment: Polygon/star tool options plus keyboard and wheel handling during shape drag.

title: File > Import should allow the user to place the image(s) in the viewport

review.reason: Wants File > Import to attach each image to the cursor with a thumbnail preview and click/drag placement, handling multiple files; Graphite deferred it pending requirement updates. Varve imports bitmaps but the packet says nothing about its placement behaviour after import.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's image import placement flow if imports currently land at a fixed centre.

title: Local testing in Windows

review.reason: A Windows-only compile failure in Graphite's own winit event-loop setup (wayland cfg gate and a missing EventLoopBuilderExtWindows import). That is Graphite's Rust build tooling; Varve does not compile its own winit event loop.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: With a high display scaling ratio, overlays don't get cleared in the bottom/right edges

review.reason: At non-1 device-pixel-ratio or browser zoom, overlay pixels along the bottom/right edges were never cleared, leaving trails whose size shrank as the user zoomed out. That is the stale-pixel class Varve guards against, and overlay surface sizing must track the backing store under fractional scaling.
review.varveAssessment: Runtime overlay surface sizing under devicePixelRatio changes, next to Varve's painted-surface/backing-store guards.

title: Tracking Issue: Refactor nodes to use Kurbo instead of Bezier-rs

review.reason: Tracking refactor of Graphite's nodes from Bezier-rs to Kurbo, itemized per node. Varve has no node library built on Bezier-rs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Double-click selecting anchors in a filled region, with anchors disabled, crashes the editor

review.reason: Double-clicking inside a filled region to select anchors crashed when anchor overlays were disabled. A tool must validate targets that are not currently rendered instead of assuming the overlay's presence; Varve's path tool draws anchors conditionally and needs the same guard.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool anchor hit-testing when anchor overlays are hidden.

title: [Question] I noticed that the underlying implementation of the renderer in the web version is SVG?

review.reason: A question about Graphite's SVG-DOM renderer being the default while its WebGPU/Vello renderer is opt-in. Varve has no SVG-DOM renderer; its compositor replays engine IR to Canvas2D with opt-in WebGPU.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the question concerns Graphite's renderer architecture.

title: Benchmark suite for 2D graphics

review.reason: Varve already maintains a benchmark harness (packages/engine/src/bench with goldens, canvas10k.bench.test.ts, pnpm bench) plus a frame-time/perf oracle, which is the technical core of this request; the proposed public hardware-review suite is not required for it.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required for benchmark infrastructure.

title: Lasso/box selection switching and usage over existing layers

review.reason: Asks for Ctrl to switch between lasso and box selection mid-drag, Ctrl-drag over an object to always start a lasso, and a fix so aborting a lasso (Esc/RMB) clears the accumulated path instead of extending it and wasting memory; PRs #2792/#2799 target it. Varve's marquee selection is documented, but whether it has a lasso mode and abort cleanup is not described.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's marquee/lasso selection state and its memory retention during abort.

title: Deleting (dissolving) a point should scale its adjacent handles to minimize curvature change

review.reason: Dissolving a selected anchor currently changes the shape; the request is to rescale the adjacent handles to approximate the original curvature, working on multiple selected points, bound to Shift+Delete with Cut Anchor moved to Alt+Delete. Varve supports deleting path nodes, so the deletion path needs a refit step.
review.varveAssessment: Path node deletion and handle refitting in Varve's node-editing operations.

title: Fix the Draw Canvas internal node and make it run automatically

review.reason: Graphite's internal Draw Canvas node, which turns an SVG string into foreignObject canvas drawing instead of a base64 PNG, made obsolete by #2903. Varve has no SVG-DOM renderer or such an internal node; it replays IR to Canvas2D/OffscreenCanvas.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Line Tool doesn't reflect endpoint changes made by Path Tool

review.reason: The Line tool kept showing the line as it was before the Path tool moved an endpoint, because the tool retained its own stale geometry. Tools must re-read current document geometry rather than a snapshot taken when they were last active.
review.varveAssessment: Tool state and geometry re-reads when switching between the line and path tools in Varve.

title: Using the path edit tool on one of the corners of a raster image breaks the graph

review.reason: Varve's path tool edits vector geometry only; image nodes expose no path anchors, so there are no phantom corners to drag and no hidden Path modifier that a graph could break (Graphite resolved its equivalent via #3727).
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the node-graph corruption the report describes cannot occur.

title: Support correctly shifting a dragged layer into an empty layer that has a Transform node

review.reason: After a dummy-row removal, dropping a layer into an empty container that carries a Transform node stopped counteracting the container's offset, so the object jumped. Reparenting across different transforms must preserve on-canvas position, which Varve's reparenting path would need to guarantee.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's node reparenting/drag-into-container path and its transform compensation.

title: Wrong transform on shapes used in a boolean operation when coming from folders with different transforms

review.reason: Boolean operations between shapes from folders with different transforms produced a wrong result because operands were not brought into a common space; a 2026-07-26 comment reports it no longer reproduces on Graphite master, possibly fixed by the boolean rework. Varve's boolean module accepts geometry from groups and frames that carry their own transforms, so operand flattening needs the same care.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's boolean operations module and transform flattening of operands.

title: Tracking Issue: Improving editing support for vector meshes

review.reason: Concerns vector meshes where an anchor joins more than two segments, and the handle rules (C during drag, Alt colinearity, Tab handle swap, deletion, colinear toggle) that assume at most two. Varve's node editing is path/anchor based with corner/smooth/bend rather than mesh topology, so the multi-segment cases have no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the mesh topology premise does not exist.

title: Arabic writing support

review.reason: Varve's text pipeline does full shaping with BiDi and CJK support, so right-to-left Arabic renders correctly with any font that covers the script.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; RTL shaping already exists.

title: Squircle / Corner Smoothing Support

review.reason: Varve already implements corner radius with squircle corner smoothing on shapes, which is the Figma-style corner smoothing requested here.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve work required; squircle smoothing already exists.

title: [Crash Report] Crash on double export

review.reason: Exporting from one document, switching tabs and exporting another crashed on an unwrap in the export dialog; it was closed as not reproducible because the report's settings details were unclear. Varve has per-session documents and an export dialog, but the packet says nothing about dialog state across document switches.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Varve's export dialog state and per-document export settings.

title: `Sample Points` Node: Sampled path not closed and duplicate endpoint

review.reason: Bug in Graphene's Sample Points node output: adaptive sampling of a closed path omitted ClosePath and duplicated the first point at the end. Varve has no sample-points node producing geometry from a graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected by the node defect described.

title: Point sliding with G G

review.reason: Adds G G point sliding in the Path tool: move an anchor along its adjacent segment while adjusting handles to best preserve the original curvature. Varve's documented node-editing operations (corner/smooth/bend) do not include sliding an anchor along its segment.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool anchor manipulation in Varve's node editing.

title: Improve Path tool layer and point selection behavior

review.reason: A completed checklist refining Path-tool selection semantics: box-select from inside a shape must not drag its points, single click transfers selection only when nothing is selected, double-click selects a layer's points, and Alt+double-click deselects them. Whether Varve's path tool follows these rules is not described in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect path tool click/drag selection semantics and its interaction with layer selection.

title: Layer isolation mode

review.reason: Requests a layer isolation mode that fades everything outside the isolated subtree and constrains selection, and notes renderer and design work will be needed. Varve has no documented isolation mode; it is closely related to the Path-tool isolation request in #2616.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's selection model, layers panel and canvas opacity rendering for non-isolated layers.

title: Category text label isn't clickable in the Node Graph editor context menu

review.reason: Context-menu label clickability inside Graphite's Node Graph editor. Varve has no node graph or node-graph context menu.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected because Varve exposes no node graph editor.

title: Sample Points should have option to sample by count (like in blender)

review.reason: Sample Points is a Graphite node-graph node, and sampling by count versus by distance is a node parameter. Varve has no procedural node system.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve is affected; there is no sample-points node to configure.

title: [Docker] Built image and successfully ran

review.reason: Self-hosting and Docker packaging for Graphite's web build, which upstream declined to maintain in-repo. Varve ships a Tauri desktop app and has no server or Docker distribution model.
review.varveAssessment: Out of scope: Varve has no self-hosted server deployment to containerize.

title: Tracking Issue: Code quality refactors

review.reason: Graphite-internal refactor tracker covering Rust message-handler match statements, immediate-mode UI diffing, node-graph coupling and input macros. Varve's editor is React contexts plus a tool registry, so none of those structures exist to refactor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is described; the SVG-fidelity note inside is already tracked separately in Varve's own import/export work.

title: Star tool right-angle visualization should be drawn parallel to star corner edges

review.reason: An on-canvas star corner indicator draws a right-angle mark for angles that are not 90 degrees, and the debate covers whether it should follow the downstream transform. Varve has a Star tool, but the packet does not establish whether Varve draws any corner-angle gizmo.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the Star tool overlay if Varve draws an angle marker; capability unconfirmed.

title: Copying and pasting geometry while in the Path tool

review.reason: Copy/paste and Ctrl+D operate on whole layers while the Path tool is active; the request is geometry-level clipboard plus duplicate-in-place, with layer creation only when 0 or 2+ layers are being edited. Varve has path/node editing and a Ctrl+D duplicate command, so the same tool-scoped clipboard routing would be needed.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the Pen/Node Edit tool clipboard and duplicate handling in the editor tool layer.

title: Boolean operation fills holes in some cases

review.reason: Boolean output fills interior holes in some configurations, and the report was closed as assumed fixed without a root cause. Varve ships a boolean operations module, so hole and fill-rule correctness in boolean results is a live workflow.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the boolean operations module and how resulting contours are wound and filled.

title: Boolean operations no longer work the same

review.reason: Same hole-disappearing boolean defect as #2749: subtract front stopped working between two CI builds. This report bisected it to merge-by-distance losing contour direction, which the non-zero fill rule then renders as a filled hole.
review.varveAssessment: Same boolean contour-winding area in Varve's boolean module as the canonical issue.

title: Path tool dragging, then pressing Shift to constrain horiz./vert., should begin from a snapping point

review.reason: Shift constraint during a path-point drag always anchors to the drag origin, but when the point has snapped to another point the constraint should re-anchor to that snap target. Varve has path/node editing with snapping, so a snap-aware constraint origin would be needed there too.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the Pen/Node Edit tool drag constraint logic and snap resolution.

title: [BUG] Persistent "New Document" Popup
