review.reason: The New Document dialog kept reopening and a high-resolution image import locked the editor; the reporter and maintainer never isolated a cause and it was closed unconfirmed after clearing IndexedDB appeared to help. The packet does not establish whether Varve has an equivalent dialog-state or large-raster import defect.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the new-document dialog lifecycle or image import performance if Varve reproduces it; unknown.

title: Suggestions/Requests: Graphite is awesome!

review.reason: A wishlist for more raster formats such as webp, avif and gif, plus export compression settings and touch-first mobile use. Varve decodes animated GIF/APNG/WebP media, but the packet states no concrete defect and Varve's AVIF or WebP export behaviour is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch bitmap import/export format coverage; no verified gap from this packet.

title: Color in Tool Color Picker is Scaled for Shape Tools (Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Shape)

review.reason: The tool colour picker shows a scaled colour for the line, rectangle, ellipse and shape tools, with both mouse drag and typed input affected. Varve has the same family of shape tools plus a tool-options colour control, so the same tool-scoped colour scaling would surface there.
review.varveAssessment: Affects shape tool creation colour handling in the editor tools and floating tool options.

title: Create Color from Component Values

review.reason: A Construct Color node that builds a colour from scalar channel inputs is a node-graph feature. Varve has no procedural node system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; colours are direct properties, not graph outputs.

title: Add Option to Disable Antialiasing

review.reason: Requests per-object anti-aliasing control so edges are fully opaque or fully transparent for thresholding workflows, mapping to SVG shape-rendering externally. Varve renders through canvas replay and also exports SVG and raster, so an AA or shape-rendering option would need to be honoured in both paths.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the render pipeline's shape drawing and the SVG/bitmap export path.

title: Pen/Freehand/Splines tool should set its origin to the first drawn point location when the new layer is created

review.reason: Newly created pen/freehand layers take their origin from the parent canvas rather than the first drawn point, so later scale and rotate pivots sit far from the artwork. Varve creates a layer per drawing tool and would need the same first-point origin behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Affects newly created shape layers and their transform origin in the pen/pencil tool paths.

title: Paints as graphics

review.reason: Paints-as-graphics depends on Graphite's node type-coercion design, where fill and stroke accept any Table of graphic data and colour/gradient/tiling entries join the Graphic enum. Varve has no Table<Graphic> coercion or node graph; fills and strokes are direct paint properties with their own paint stack.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem matches the proposed graphic-enum paint model.

title: Boolean operation | Subtract Front | Fails on text node sometimes

review.reason: Subtract Front intermittently fails on some text glyph outlines depending on font weight and style (Cabin lowercase d and e). Varve has boolean operations and converts text to outlines for boolean work, so glyph-level boolean robustness applies.
review.varveAssessment: Affects boolean operations applied to text-outline geometry.

title: Is it possible to view network traffic by application process?

review.reason: A general question about inspecting an application's network traffic, answered with Wireshark and strace advice. It describes no graphics-product behaviour and implicates nothing in Varve.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve is affected; this is an OS tooling question.

title: Jitter Points node has unexpected behaviour

review.reason: Jitter Points is a node-graph node, and the defect was traced to a singular transform matrix making the inverse fall back to default. Varve has no node graph or jitter node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; there is no jitter node or graph transform chain.

title: Sliders get stuck to the mouse

review.reason: Numeric sliders never release the value after mouse up. Varve's numeric ranges are native input type=range under the documented slider contract, where the browser owns pointer capture and release, so there is no custom mouse-follow slider state to get stuck.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the slider system's native-range rule; no custom numeric slider drag state exists.

title: Wrong link in frontend/README.md

review.reason: A stale Tauri link in Graphite's frontend README, fixed by an unrelated pull request. Repository documentation, not product behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve is affected; the issue is a link in Graphite's own repository.

title: JS debugging: dragging the increment mode number field sometimes jumps at the start

review.reason: Increment-mode number fields sometimes teleport on drag because Pointer Lock reports a spurious movementX spike. Varve's NumberField scrub uses setPointerCapture plus window pointermove handlers and computes deltas from clientX, so the Pointer Lock event-ordering defect cannot move the value.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the NumberField scrub implementation; no Pointer Lock dependency exists.

title: [Crash Report] Opening new document crashes in firefox

review.reason: The crash is a WASM panic in editor/src/node_graph_executor.rs when a generation request is sent on a closed channel. Varve has no node-graph executor or generation channel.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve code path matches the reported panic site.

title: Suggestion: Tab to swap between Select and Path tool similar to Blender

review.reason: Suggests Tab toggling between object mode (Select) and edit mode (Path), replacing the A-V-A key dance. Varve has both a Select and a Node Edit tool plus a configurable shortcut registry, but no context-dependent object/edit mode toggle.
review.varveAssessment: Affects tool switching in the shortcut registry and tool manager.

title: Jj

review.reason: Empty report containing no description of any behaviour or request.
review.varveAssessment: No actionable finding exists to map onto Varve.

title: Graph Editor Comments

review.reason: Design annotation on Graphite's node Graph Editor. Varve has no graph editor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Add nodes for modifying vector paths

review.reason: Proposes Path Index, Path Position, Path Color and Path Weight nodes with matching setters, and is blocked upstream on custom table attributes. Varve has no node graph or attribute-driven path data.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; path data is edited directly, not through nodes.

title: Make MoldingSegment be a mode of Dragging versus its own PointerMove state

review.reason: Refactor of Graphite's Rust pointer state machine in path_tool.rs so MoldingSegment becomes a Dragging mode. Internal tool architecture with no user-visible behaviour, and Varve's tools use a different BaseTool/InteractionContext handler design.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve tool state machine shares this structure.

title: Yo

review.reason: Empty report containing no description of any behaviour or request.
review.varveAssessment: No actionable finding exists to map onto Varve.

title: Duplicate in Layers Panel with Alt+Drag

review.reason: Alt-dragging a row in the Layers panel should duplicate the layer, matching canvas Alt-drag. Varve duplicates on canvas Alt-drag but its layers panel drag session has no modifier-duplicate, so the same gap exists.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the layers panel drag/drop session and duplicate command wiring.

title: Pen Tool Crash

review.reason: A pen-tool crash reported around undo/redo with the stack only in an attachment, later said to be fixed by #2692. Without the attachment contents the packet does not show whether Varve's pen tool has a comparable failure.
review.varveAssessment: Would fall on the pen tool and undo/redo interaction if reproducible; unverified.

title: Refactor node graph wires to be generated in Rust not JS

review.reason: Move node-graph wire geometry generation from JavaScript into Rust. Pure node-graph rendering architecture.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is involved; there are no graph wires.

title: Brush tool doesn't work

review.reason: The brush tool broke because the grapheme proto-node name was missing from Graphite's Graphene registry. Varve has no proto-node registry; its brushes are not registry-resolved nodes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected by a node-registry lookup.

title: Path tool segment editing mode polish

review.reason: A checklist of path-tool segment and point selection polish: never allow all modes off, radio-like modes with Shift multi-select, segment/point selection coupling, insert-point modifier, anchor hover highlight and contextual hints. Varve has a Node Edit tool with point selection and hover overlays, but the packet does not establish whether it has a segment-selection mode at all.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the Node Edit tool's selection overlay and modifiers if Varve adds segment selection.

title: A generator node can be erroneously given a left input by reordering a stack it's on the bottom of

review.reason: A generator node can be given a left input when a layer stack it sits at the bottom of is reordered. Generator and input semantics of the node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve layers have no node inputs.

title: Clipped Layer ignores `Blend Mode`

review.reason: A clipped layer renders without its blend mode applied, so the clipped result differs from the same content unclipped. Varve composes clipping through clip masks in its render pipeline and also supports blend modes, so this interaction needs the same parity check.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the render pipeline's clip-mask and blend-mode compositing order.

title: Graphite Tutorials and Demos

review.reason: Announcement of a community YouTube tutorial channel. There is no product change or defect described.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve is affected; this is community content.

title: Canvas scrollbars should respect artboard clipping

review.reason: Canvas scrollbar extent ignores artboard clipping. Varve's canvas navigates by camera pan/zoom with a minimap and ships no scrollbars, so there is no scrollbar extent to correct.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve scrollbar exists to recompute from clipped content.

title: Layer Panel should scroll to the selected layer when selecting in viewport

review.reason: Selecting a layer in the viewport should reveal it in the Layers panel, expanding groups. Varve's layers tree already expands ancestor containers and scrolls the virtualised list to the selected row whenever selection originates outside the panel (the layers.autoReveal setting).
review.varveAssessment: Covered by LayersTree auto-reveal with selectionOrigin guarding.

title: Undo behaviour regression

review.reason: Undo after repeated fill-colour edits did not step back, and undo stopped working after clicking the canvas until the shape was reselected. Varve's history is transaction-based, but the packet gives no evidence whether an equivalent canvas/selection interaction can strand undo.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect undo transaction boundaries in the colour inspector and selection state; unverified.

title: Offline use ?

review.reason: Asks whether the editor can be used offline. Varve is local-first: documents are edited and stored on the device through the platform file layer with no server round-trip, and AI model downloads are explicit rather than implicit.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by Varve's local-first desktop architecture.

title: Please stop the build bot comment spam!

review.reason: Complaint about build-bot commit comments flooding GitHub notifications. Repository and CI notification hygiene, not editor behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve is affected; this is upstream project administration.

title: Double-click on an endpoint to switch between "Colinear Handles", select Colinear Handles.

review.reason: Same double-click endpoint versus collinear-handles report as #2862, filed minutes later with no additional reproduction detail. #2862 carries the video and the maintainer's explanation of the intended behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Same node-editing handle behaviour area as the canonical issue.

title: Double-clicking an endpoint can switch between "Collinear Handles," and switching is not possible when "Collinear Handles" are selected.

review.reason: Upstream confirmed the behaviour is correct by design: unticking Collinear Handles disables colinearity, and double-clicking a point converts it from smooth to sharp. Varve exposes point type explicitly (corner, smooth, bend) rather than through a double-click colinearity toggle, so there is no conflicting state to reconcile.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by Varve's explicit point-type editing model.

title: When selecting a layer blend mode preview, hovering the mouse over the dividing line changes the blend mode to "Normal".

review.reason: Hovering the divider between blend-mode previews applies the current blend mode instead of leaving the value unchanged. Varve has a blend-mode field inside its popover system, but the packet does not establish whether Varve previews blend modes on hover.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the Inspector blend-mode field if hover previews exist there; unconfirmed.

title: Custom cursor icons for every tool and their states

review.reason: Requests a tool-specific cursor for every tool and its states. Varve's tool registry declares tools without a cursor contract and the canvas does not set a per-tool cursor, so the same gap exists.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the tool registry and canvas cursor handling.

title: It is recommended that when selecting shapes by dragging, the selected state should be displayed as the mouse moves over them, rather than only after releasing the mouse button, as shown in the video.

review.reason: Asks for a pre-selection state while dragging a marquee, not only after release. Upstream already shows pre-selection as a path outline rather than a bounding box, and Varve's canvas overlays already render a hovered-node pre-selection highlight.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the canvas overlay hover/pre-selection highlight.

title: Interactive rounded gizmos at polyline corners

review.reason: Wants an interactive corner-radius gizmo that appears on selection and can be dragged to round polygon corners. Varve has corner radius and squircle smoothing as geometry and Inspector controls, but no on-canvas radius handle.
review.varveAssessment: Affects selection overlays and the corner-radius geometry controls.

title: Offset display issue when moving shapes

review.reason: Reports that moving a shape up shows a negative Y offset. Upstream explained this is the standard Y-down screen convention, which it declined to change, and Varve's document space is Y-down to match canvas and SVG painting.
review.varveAssessment: No change needed; the sign convention is inherent to Varve's canvas coordinate space.

title: Simplified Chinese writing support

review.reason: Simplified Chinese text rendered as boxes because the selected font had no CJK glyphs; choosing a CJK-capable family fixed it. Varve's text pipeline already shapes CJK and BiDi text, with glyph availability determined by the chosen font family in the same way.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the text pipeline's CJK shaping plus font-family selection.

title: Rarely-occurring offset between node graph appearance and pointer interactions

review.reason: Node-graph hit areas drift away from node visuals until the window is reloaded. Varve has no node graph, and its canvas overlays share the renderer's camera transform.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve graph surface exists to misalign with pointer hit areas.

title: Accidentally touching the keyboard when selecting a dropdown box will input content

review.reason: Typing while a dropdown is open filters its options; upstream confirmed this is the intended feature and only some keys behaved inconsistently. Varve's Select implements APG type-ahead through a key buffer, so typed characters filter without changing the value until commit.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the shared Select component's listbox type-ahead.

title: Layer Panel Feature Enhancements

review.reason: Requests layer-type icons, richer per-layer attributes and layer filtering. Varve's layers panel already provides type icons and thumbnails, a name/kind/attribute/blend-mode filter bar, colour tags and a layer details popover.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the layers panel filter bar, row type icons, colour tags and details popover.

title: Node for constructing a Gradient

review.reason: A Gradient constructor node is needed because fill nodes accept the Gradient type in the graph. Varve has no node graph; gradients are direct fill and stroke properties.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; gradient construction is a paint property, not a node.

title: Set exported SVG tag ID to its source layer name

review.reason: SVG export should write deduplicated layer names onto exported element ids, skipping unnamed layers, so downstream styling and animation can target them. Varve's SVG codegen emits internal mask and pattern ids plus data-varve-* attributes but no per-layer id.
review.varveAssessment: Affects SVG export in the codegen package and any export options surfaced in the export dialog.

title: Masking-focused feature requests for the Gradient tool

review.reason: Gradient-tool masking requests: gradient as a mask layer with solid, gradient or image fill, automatic clipping masks when filling shapes, and mask targeting of fill, stroke or path. Varve has clip/alpha/luminance masks and gradient paints, but creating masks automatically from a fill workflow is outside that explicit mask-source model.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the masking system and gradient tool workflows.

title: Feature Request: export images with a unified DPI of the document resolution

review.reason: Vector exports of documents containing mixed-resolution images produce arbitrary effective DPIs, and the request is to resample embedded images to the document or export DPI. Varve's print path already carries DPI and preflight, so export-time image resampling belongs in that pipeline.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the PDF/print export pipeline and preflight image handling.

title: Add connections for layers with the same attributes

review.reason: Wants linked layer connections whose shared attributes, such as fill colour, edit together, with linked layers also selectable together. Varve supports multi-selection edits and document colour variables but has no layer-linking model.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the layers panel, inspector multi-edit and colour-variable binding.

title: Proposal: stable color spaces and earlier CMYK support

review.reason: Proposal for stable colour spaces and earlier CMYK support so print work does not round-trip through RGB. Varve already ships a colour-science crate with ICC transforms plus a print pipeline with CMYK, PDF-X, ICC profiles and preflight.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the varve-colour and varve-print CMYK and ICC paths.

title: Multi toggle layer visibility through click and drag on "eye"-icon

review.reason: Dragging across visibility eye icons should toggle many layers at once and must not reorder the dragged layer. Varve already stops drag activation on the eye button, but it has no drag-across multi-toggle.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the layers panel row toggle and drag session handling.

title: Images remain opaque in outline view

review.reason: Images stay fully opaque in outline view instead of appearing as outlines or ghosted. Varve has an Outline Mode that rewrites every IR item to a stroke-only draw, so image items need equivalent treatment.
review.varveAssessment: Affects render pipeline Outline Mode handling of image items.

title: Text node tilt is a bit broken

review.reason: Changing a text node's tilt renders many skewed copies of the text instead of one skewed text. Varve's text pipeline composes skew and transform for text nodes, so the same duplicate-draw class would appear there.
review.varveAssessment: Affects text transform/skew application in the text pipeline and canvas replay.

title: Add sub-divisions to the viewport grid

review.reason: Wants subdivisions under the main viewport grid lines with snapping to the finer increment. Varve's grid settings already carry gridSubdivisions alongside snapGrid spacing and several grid overlay modes.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the existing grid settings and grid overlay.

title: [ Suggestion ] Grids should be per-artboard / only affect active artboard

review.reason: The grid originates at document 0,0, so isometric grids do not follow the active artboard; a per-artboard origin or explicit grid-origin gizmo is wanted. Varve anchors the grid to the document and only offers artboard-relative rulers via rulerMode.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the viewport grid overlay and grid origin settings.

title: Inputs go wild after clicking with mouse

review.reason: Dragging a dimensions field on Safari made the value run away with the mouse, attributed upstream to Safari's Pointer Lock implementation. Varve's numeric fields scrub from clientX deltas with pointer capture and never use Pointer Lock, so that defect cannot move the value.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the NumberField scrub implementation in the inspector.

title: Path tool feedback

review.reason: Hiding a path with the eye toggle removes its fill and leaves a stray selection box, freehand strokes do not close, and click targets must not be affected by disabled nodes. Varve's hit testing and visibility toggles interact the same way, so the same class of mismatch applies.
review.varveAssessment: Affects hit testing and selection overlays when nodes are hidden or disabled.

title: Some newly discovered issues and suggestions

review.reason: A bundle of eight findings including text stroke display corruption, marquee direction selection rules, inability to deselect in the Path tool, and a non-revertible infinite canvas switch. Varve's text rendering, marquee selection and Node Edit tool would each need the corresponding check.
review.varveAssessment: Affects text stroke rendering, marquee selection semantics and Node Edit deselection.

title: Selecting a layer twice with the select tool causes the properties to disappear

review.reason: Clicking the same layer twice adds it to the selection twice, so the properties panel decides two layers are selected and renders nothing. Varve also stores selection as an id array, which leaves the same exposure, but the packet does not show whether its click path can append a duplicate.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect selection bookkeeping and the single-selection inspector gate; unconfirmed in Varve.

title: Replace wasm-pack, which is being deprecated

review.reason: wasm-pack is being sunset and needs a replacement. Varve's justfile builds every WASM artifact with wasm-pack build (baseline, SIMD, colour and threads), so the deprecation is a direct build-toolchain dependency.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the WASM build recipes in the justfile and the artifacts under apps/desktop/public/wasm.

title: Quick measurement with Alt is incorrectly showing viewport coordinates instead of document coordinates

review.reason: Alt-hover measurement showed viewport-scaled numbers instead of document distances, so measured values changed with zoom. Varve's MeasureOverlay derives dimension lines from world-space node bounds through worldToScreen, keeping values in document units at any zoom.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the measurement overlay's world-space math.

title: Quick measurement with Alt should also measure to the edges of artboards

review.reason: Wants Alt measurement to also target artboard edges as if they were rectangles. Varve's measurement computes edge distances from node world bounds for any node, and frames are ordinary nodes, so frame and artboard edges already act as targets.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the same measurement overlay; frames are measurement targets.

title: Feedback on Path Tool and other issues in use

review.reason: A long path-tool feedback list: inconsistent right-click and Esc cancellation, a click without dragging creating empty layers or point shapes, spline handle edits doing nothing, plus clip-mask layers blocking selection of the layers below and inconsistent image import centring. Varve has pen and pencil tools, clipping masks and a shared hit-test path where these behaviours would show.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the pen/photoshop-style drawing tools, clip-mask hit testing and image placement on import.

title: NodeCatalog QoL improvements

review.reason: NodeCatalog summary rows are only clickable outside their text label. Node-graph panel behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected; there is no node catalog.

title: Allow strokes to not be affecting by a scale transformation

review.reason: Wants a stroke scaling option so stroke width can stay constant while the object is scaled. Varve applies node transforms to stroke geometry, so a non-scaling mode would need stroke-width compensation in canvas replay and SVG export.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the stroke model, render replay and SVG export of strokes.

title: Path tool snapping to the X or Y axis with Shift held is broken for handles

review.reason: Shift axis constraint works for anchors but is broken for bezier handles and should work with any number of selected points. Varve's node editing drags handles and has axis snapping, so handle constraints need the same coupling.
review.varveAssessment: Affects Node Edit handle dragging and snapping in the path tool.

title: Fix Vello not rendering on desktop startup

review.reason: Vello renders a blank canvas on desktop startup because viewport bounds are never applied to the texture. Varve has no Vello backend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve renderer shares the Vello texture path.

title: Fix Vello canvas rendering not being displayed in sRGB

review.reason: Vello canvas output looks washed out because sRGB conversion is applied twice on desktop. Vello-specific colour handling.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve does not render through Vello.

title: Fix keyboard shortcuts not working on desktop

review.reason: Common shortcuts such as Ctrl+0 did not work in the desktop build, with the reporter noting Windows had no shortcuts at all. Varve routes shortcuts through one registry that also feeds native menu accelerators in the Tauri menu module, so webview and menu bindings come from the same definitions.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the shared shortcut registry plus native menu accelerators.

title: Move file handling to native code

review.reason: Desktop builds used browser file APIs and lacked not-saved, modified and saved state handling. Varve performs open and save through the Tauri-backed platform layer, and the lifecycle system tracks per-session dirty state with revision-safe saves.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the platform file layer and the lifecycle dirty/save authority.

title: Make checkboxes not use interior mutability

review.reason: Replaces an interior-mutability CheckboxId in Graphite's Rust UI framework with a plain u64. Varve's UI is React components, not a custom immediate-mode Rust UI.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve UI code uses that widget framework.

title: Document Export Issue

review.reason: Exporting one specific document to any format silently does nothing, with the document supplied only as an attachment. Varve's export path should surface a failure instead of returning with no output.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the export dialog and export pipeline error reporting.

title: Implement the desktop wrapper crate

review.reason: Adds a desktop wrapper crate encapsulating message forwarding, filtering and input processing. Architecture specific to Graphite's message pipeline; Varve's desktop shell is Tauri commands behind a platform abstraction.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve crate corresponds to the proposed wrapper.

title: Row filtering in all nodes that operate on tables

review.reason: Row filtering over Graphene tables, including field-based filter predicates and tooling for ranges of elements. Varve has no node graph or table data type.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; there are no graph tables.

title: Lazily evaluate list items by treating lists as iterators

review.reason: Treating Graphene lists as lazily evaluated iterators or fields instead of collected vectors. Node-graph evaluation design.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem evaluates graph lists.

title: Rearranging layers in the Layers panel does not work on desktop

review.reason: Layer reordering stopped working in the desktop build, but the report body is empty and contains no reproduction detail. Varve implements layer reordering with its own drop resolver rather than webview HTML5 drag-and-drop, but the packet gives nothing to compare against.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the layers panel drag/drop session if the same desktop input limitation exists; unverified.

title: Node graph view does not work on desktop

review.reason: Clicking the node graph overlay button in the desktop app does nothing. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Text input is broken on desktop

review.reason: Text entry was broken in the desktop build. Varve edits text through a DOM TextEditOverlay input that handles IME composition and isComposing, so keyboard entry does not depend on raw webview key events.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the TextEditOverlay DOM input with IME handling.

title: Implement overlay drawing API functions for Vello

review.reason: Overlay drawing API functions for the Vello renderer. Varve has no Vello backend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve renderer exposes that API.

title: Queue messages in the wasm wrapper if the editor is locked

review.reason: Queue messages in Graphite's wasm wrapper while the editor lock is held, to stop console spam and lost messages. That wrapper and lock design is specific to Graphite.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve equivalent of the editor lock or message queue exists.

title: Having multiple documents open currently breaks

review.reason: Multiple open documents break because executions of the inactive document count toward the after-graph-execution counter. Varve has no node-graph executor; its multiple documents are per-session editor state.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path shares the graph-execution counter mechanism.

title: Export images with native Vello rendering

review.reason: Replace browser SVG rasterisation for image exports with native Vello rendering on desktop. Varve has no Vello backend and exports through its own canvas and codegen paths.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve export path uses Vello.

title: Grid-aligned node connections jump around when zooming

review.reason: Grid-aligned node connections drift while zooming. Node-graph wiring geometry only.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Middle-click panning invokes paste action on some Firefox Linux configurations

review.reason: Middle-click panning on Linux Firefox also fires the browser's PRIMARY paste and drops clipboard content into the canvas. Varve's canvas input pipeline already suppresses the browser-generated middle-click paste while a middle-button pan is active and for a short window afterwards.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the middle-button paste guard in the canvas input pipeline.

title: Editor tools operating on full tables of data, not just the first element

review.reason: Update editor tools to operate on whole Graphene tables instead of only the first row, with table-range selection for the Select and Path tools. Table-based graph data model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve tool operates on graph tables.

title: Vello renders image with a half-pixel offset

review.reason: Vello renders images half a pixel off and anti-aliases the shift, traced to a pixel-centre versus pixel-corner difference between SVG and Vello. Varve has no Vello backend.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve renderer shares the Vello sampling path.

title: Fix dark fringing around brush stroke semitransparent areas

review.reason: Semi-transparent brush stroke areas show dark fringing, traced to gamma or straight-versus-premultiplied alpha being applied twice or not at all. Varve has raster brushes and live effects with its own RGBA compositing, so the same colour/alpha correctness check applies.
review.varveAssessment: Affects brush compositing and the colour-space handling in the render pipeline.

title: Regression: shallow select double-clicking is broken

review.reason: Double-clicking a shape inside a group stopped drilling down to the child. Varve performs deep selection through an explicit gesture (Ctrl-click or the long-press deep-selection menu in SelectTool) rather than a double-click path, so there is no separate double-click drill to regress.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the SelectTool deep-selection gestures.

title: Remove dependecies on viewport element

review.reason: Removes dependencies on the inner viewport DOM element in Graphite's frontend and moves them to the container. Internal frontend restructuring of their own element hierarchy.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve element hierarchy corresponds to Graphite's viewport element.

title: Node Graph does not open on Desktop

review.reason: The node graph does not open in the desktop build. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve surface is affected.

title: Tunnel node

review.reason: Tunnel sender and receiver nodes that route a connection by shared key to reduce crossing wires. Node-graph feature.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem routes graph connections.

title: Cannot insert new point in gradient with double click

review.reason: The Graphite failure comes from a cloned NodeNetworkInterface losing DocumentMetadata across a deferred graph execution. Varve's gradient editor inserts a stop synchronously on gradient-bar pointer-down (GradientEditor handleBarPointerDown -> addStop) with no deferred evaluation step that could observe stale metadata.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient editing in the Inspector color panel is unaffected; there is no deferred graph/metadata pipeline in Varve.

title: Document name doesn't update after saving on desktop

review.reason: The packet only records closure by a desktop PR and says nothing about how the document name is refreshed after a save. Whether Varve's session tab/title reflects the new file path after Save and Save As on desktop is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Session/title state around usePersistence.ts and the tab strip would be the affected area; post-save titling is unverified.

title: Display tracing errors as error dialogs in the editor UI

review.reason: Varve's Vectorize workflow already surfaces tracing failures in the editor UI: the preview carries an 'error' status and provider failures are rewritten into plain language by describeTraceError before display. The ask for visible trace errors is therefore met, if inline rather than as a global dialog.
review.varveAssessment: Image-trace workflow in packages/editor/src/components/Vectorize already reports provider errors.

title: Support viewing third-party licenses in-editor (need on desktop)

review.reason: Varve bundles third-party assets (fonts with license policy, ONNX models, Rust/JS dependencies) but exposes licensing only on the website under /about/license, with no in-editor viewer. An in-app licenses surface is a genuine compliance/UX gap.
review.varveAssessment: The Help system (@varve/help) or an About dialog would host the third-party license list.

title: Fix UI and viewport blending

review.reason: The report is a UI/viewport blend mismatch on an NVIDIA driver in Graphite's GPU compositing path. Varve renders with Canvas2D by default and an opt-in WebGPU path, so whether an equivalent compositing mismatch exists is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's compositor backends (packages/compositor) would be the affected area if the mismatch is driver-level.

title: Menu bar does no longer work on desktop

review.reason: Closed with no product defect: the reporter's frontend build was out of date, and the menu bar worked once updated. Nothing in Varve's shell or menubar is implicated.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Opening then closing the node graph permanently makes the artboard label overlay disappear

review.reason: The artboard-label overlay disappears only after opening and closing Graphite's node graph panel; Varve has no node graph panel, so that overlay lifecycle does not exist. The secondary rename-until-mouse-move detail is an overlay invalidation symptom of the same panel interaction.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; there is no node graph view to toggle.

title: Stroke alignment should affect click targets

review.reason: Varve's hit test expands candidate bounds by the node bounding box plus a zoom-aware screen tolerance only; stroke width and inside/center/outside alignment never enter the calculation. Outside-aligned strokes are therefore under-picked and inside-aligned strokes over-picked, exactly the defect described.
review.varveAssessment: Click targets in packages/editor/src/hitTest/HitTestEngine.ts and the per-node bounds used for picking.

title: Lock width and height ratio in properties panel

review.reason: Varve's Inspector already has the requested ratio lock: the Position & Size section renders a 'Constrain proportions' toggle (insp-proportion-lock with Link2/Link2Off icons) that ties W and H edits together.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector transform fields already cover this; no new work.

title: Allow opening a document passed as a desktop app launch argument

review.reason: Varve's desktop shell already accepts documents from the OS: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/file_open.rs collects argv[1..] paths on Windows/Linux and open-file events, queueing them as pending document opens.
review.varveAssessment: Desktop launch/open-with handling already exists in the Tauri file_open module.

title: Use OS scaling factor on desktop

review.reason: Varve's render backends size their backing surfaces from devicePixelRatio (compositor Canvas2D/WebGPU/WebGL2) and the Tauri webview applies the OS scale factor, so UI and canvas already follow the platform scaling factor.
review.varveAssessment: DPI handling is already in the compositor backends and platform layer.

title: Defer messages across dispatcher invocations

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's Rust message dispatcher deferring messages across invocations until the editor is ready to render. Varve has no message-dispatcher architecture; React state updates and its render scheduler are separate concerns.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Display modified shortcuts with Alt key added, when on web and not fullscreen

review.reason: The report concerns browser-reserved combinations (Ctrl+N opens a tab) making displayed shortcut labels wrong in web non-fullscreen, and Firefox passing a narrower key subset. Varve's web demo shares the desktop shortcut registry, but whether it suppresses or remaps browser-reserved bindings is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut labels in the menubar/toolbar and the browser demo build would be affected.

title: Display browser console messages on the command line

review.reason: Graphite-internal desktop developer tooling: forwarding browser console output to the terminal for the dev build. This is a build/debugging convenience for their shell, not a design-app capability Varve needs to mirror.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Allow the Select tool to partially interact with artboards

review.reason: Varve has no artboard-only tool restriction: frames are ordinary selectable nodes handled by the shared selection overlay and transform handles, including multi-selection, so the Select tool already interacts with frames and their contents.
review.varveAssessment: Frame selection and transform cages already work through the shared select tool.

title: Move persistence to native

review.reason: Varve already persists natively rather than through browser storage: varve-sync provides a SQLite DocumentStore behind Tauri IPC, on top of the Platform abstraction and the persistent revision store.
review.varveAssessment: Native persistence already exists (varve-sync + @varve/platform).

title: Very slow performance importing SVGs

review.reason: The slowness is attributed to Graphite's node-graph layout for 500+ paths plus embedded bitmaps, a mechanism Varve does not have. Varve does import SVG, but the packet contains no measurement of @varve/import cost on a comparable file.
review.varveAssessment: SVG import performance in packages/import and the editor import report would need a large-file benchmark.

title: Example Files do not show

review.reason: Same reporter and same symptom as #3126 (example files showing layers but no artwork); the maintainer pointed this thread at #3126, where it was diagnosed as a local browser extension/accessibility setting.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; resolved as a client environment issue.

title: Example File do not show

review.reason: Closed as an environment problem: the reporter's browser extension or accessibility option was breaking the color scheme, and the maintainer declined support. There is no product defect to port.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Canvas does not render

review.reason: Closed as unsupported hardware: a hackintosh iMac 2011 with an OpenCore installation and a nonstandard GPU. No Graphite code defect was established, and there is nothing for Varve to change.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Avoid needing the TaggedValue enum

review.reason: A Graphite node-definition serialization architecture question (whether TaggedValue can be replaced by typetag-style link-time registration). Varve has no node graph, tagged values, or node registry.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Move the Spline tool to a spline/path mode option in the Pen tool

review.reason: This is a tool-design decision (fold the Spline tool into the Pen tool as a mode) rather than a defect. Varve exposes Pen, Pencil and Node Edit tools, but whether a separate spline mode exists or should be merged is not covered by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Tool palette composition (toolRegistry/toolbarComposition) would be the affected area.

title: Integrate custom window frames for each desktop platform

review.reason: Varve's desktop app already runs a custom window frame: apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json sets decorations: false and apps/desktop/src/chrome/TitleBar.tsx supplies the in-app title bar with a drag region.
review.varveAssessment: Custom desktop window chrome already exists across platforms.

title: Crash in debug mode: dragging a brush layer into a boolean operation layer

review.reason: The crash comes from dragging a brush layer into a Graphite boolean operation layer, which is a node container. Varve booleans are live operations over selected shape nodes (packages/scene/src/boolean, liveBoolean.ts) and there is no boolean container layer to drop a paint layer into.
review.varveAssessment: No equivalent interaction exists; reparentNode also rejects non-container targets.

title: Rewrite the Path tool's transaction management logic in delete messages

review.reason: An explicitly internal refactor request: the user-visible path-tool transaction/undo defect was already fixed in the referenced PR, and what remains is replacing flag-passing between methods in Graphite's own code.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve has no equivalent path-tool transaction flags.

title: invitation to deveop svg preservation tool for artists.

review.reason: A request to commission a separate 'locked SVG' tool (non-editable paths with embedded rights metadata), which is outside a design suite's scope and was closed without action.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Request: Locked SVG conversion tool with embedded metadata

review.reason: Duplicate commission request for a locked-SVG conversion tool with embedded metadata; not a design-app capability and closed as not planned.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Request: Locked SVG conversion tool with embedded metadata

review.reason: Third identical copy of the locked-SVG commission posted minutes after the previous two; closed as duplicate.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Renderer bug with Vello and stroke alignment gets cropped by a parent transformation

review.reason: A Vello/gsvg renderer defect where stroke alignment is cropped by a parent transformation. Varve has no Vello or gsvg renderer; it replays an IR through Canvas2D by default, so this geometry path does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Text tool inserts text with an offset when in a transformed parent layer

review.reason: Text, line and freehand insertion landing offset inside a transformed parent is a generic world/local conversion bug. Varve composes the ancestor transform chain in the tool context, but whether its text and line insertion compensate for a rotated or scaled parent is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Tool insertion coordinates in packages/editor/src/canvas/toolContext.ts and the text/line tools.

title: A rotated group displays the wrong transform cage bounding box

review.reason: A rotated group shows the wrong transform cage bounding box. Varve's selection overlay uses rotation-aware worldToScreen rather than the rotation-blind helpers, but correct cage bounds for rotated containers is not demonstrated anywhere in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay transform cage for rotated groups.

title: Add Light Mode/Theme

review.reason: Varve already ships Light, Dark and High-Contrast themes over a 12-step neutral plus teal token ramp (ADR-0002), so the forced-dark-only accessibility problem does not apply.
review.varveAssessment: Theming already covers light mode via @varve/ui tokens.

title: Integrate custom window frames for Linux Wayland

review.reason: Custom desktop window chrome is already implemented in Varve: Tauri runs with decorations: false and apps/desktop/src/chrome/TitleBar.tsx provides the draggable in-app frame, and dev icon/desktop-entry installation is scripted for Wayland.
review.varveAssessment: Wayland window chrome already exists.

title: Integrate custom window frames for Linux X11

review.reason: Same custom-frame implementation serves X11: Tauri decorations are disabled and the in-app TitleBar supplies drag/resize regions, so there is no per-toolkit window chrome work outstanding.
review.varveAssessment: X11 window chrome already exists.

title: Integrate custom window frames for Windows

review.reason: Windows uses the same custom frame: tauri.conf.json sets decorations: false and the in-app TitleBar handles the drag region, avoiding a second platform-specific implementation.
review.varveAssessment: Windows window chrome already exists.

title: Integrate custom window frames for Mac

review.reason: macOS is covered by the same Tauri decorations: false configuration plus the shared in-app TitleBar, so the platform-specific custom frame request is already satisfied.
review.varveAssessment: macOS window chrome already exists.

title: Edge case where moving layers between groups changes the location, rotation or scale on the canvas

review.reason: Varve's reparent operation accepts a compensating local transform (reparentNode with a localTransform argument, computed by the drop path and by computeReparentTransform) so moving a layer or group into a transformed parent preserves its on-canvas position, rotation and scale. Invalid targets (non-containers, own ancestors) are rejected.
review.varveAssessment: Layers-panel and canvas drop reparenting in packages/scene/src/document-nodes.ts already preserves appearance.

title: Pointer Offset in iPad Safari

review.reason: iPad Safari pointer ink landing up-left of the finger is a CSS-pixel versus device-pixel coordinate mapping problem, with a separate brush type error reported alongside. Varve's camera consumes client coordinates and its surfaces are devicePixelRatio-aware, but iOS touch/stylus mapping in the browser build is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas pointer mapping (screenToWorld and the browser platform layer) would be the affected area.

title: Show node name instead of custom alias on tooltip

review.reason: Node tooltips showing a user alias instead of the node type name; Varve has no nodes, node graph, or node tooltips.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: "Round Corners" node removes bezier curves from vectors

review.reason: The report is that applying a Round Corners node flattens pre-existing Bezier curves into straight segments. Varve applies corner radius and squircle smoothing as direct shape properties, but whether that operation preserves unrelated curve segments on a path is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Corner radius / squircle smoothing in the Inspector and path geometry ops.

title: Opacity node does not work directly on colors

review.reason: Root cause is Graphite node-graph type semantics: MultiplyAlpha sets the table row's alpha_blending attribute instead of the Color value, and the fill node discards that attribute. Varve has no Table<Color> graph values or alpha_blending attributes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Using "Brightness/Contrast Classic" crashes

review.reason: An index-out-of-bounds panic in Graphite's node property widget construction (node_properties.rs) when instantiating the Brightness/Contrast Classic node; Varve has no node property editor or node instantiation path.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Node Graph Keybindings presets (Blender)

review.reason: A reference list of Blender node-editor keybindings proposed for Graphite's node graph. Varve has no node graph or node editor to bind.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Box selecting only the child nodes of a Merge Node

review.reason: Box-selecting only the child nodes of a Graphite Merge Node, a node-graph selection concept with no analogue in Varve's layer tree.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Option to pin node placement relative to Merge Node

review.reason: Pinning node placement relative to a Merge Node to make procedural insertion order predictable; Varve has no Merge Node or wire order.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Nested Node Groups backwards navigation keybinding

review.reason: A keybinding for navigating back up nested node groups; Varve has no node groups or sub-network navigation. Closed as a duplicate of the sub-network escape request.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Make new document with doubleclicking on empty tab space

review.reason: Double-clicking empty tab-strip space to open a new-document dialog. Varve has session tabs and a New Design dialog, but the packet gives no evidence about what empty tab-strip space does in Varve's shell.
review.varveAssessment: Session tab strip / New Design dialog interaction.

title: Autosnapping to selection transforms for manual Custom Pivot placement

review.reason: Snapping a manually dragged custom pivot to selection corners, midpoints and boundaries. Varve has a snapping system and pivot/origin controls, but whether pivot placement participates in snapping is not covered by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping targets in packages/editor/src/tools/snapping.ts and pivot placement UI.

title: Rename the 'Scatter Points' node parameter Separation Disk Diameter -> Separation

review.reason: Renaming a Scatter Points node parameter in Graphite's node library; Varve has no scatter node or node parameter registry.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Change Repeat Node Direction with manual pivot placement/manipulation in the viewport

review.reason: Manipulating a Repeat node's direction with a viewport pivot gizmo; Varve has no repeat/procedural node whose direction parameter could be driven this way.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Close Pen Tool path with double click

review.reason: Varve's pen tool closes a path only by clicking the first anchor (its own on-canvas hint says so); there is no double-click that adds a final anchor and closes the path, which is the convention users expect from the referenced PR.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool FSM in packages/editor/src/tools/PenTool.ts.

title: Crash when creating cyclic nodes

review.reason: Connectivity changes call position() before the acyclicity check, so a self-connected layer allocates until the allocator overflows. Varve has no node graph; its only reference graphs (masks and adjustment scope) already run cycle detection before applying changes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: [BUG] Can't draw over an erased part of the canvas

review.reason: Erase mode leaving a region that can no longer be painted over is a raster-layer compositing defect. Varve ships raster paint and brushes with erase, but the packet gives no evidence about erase-then-paint behaviour in its raster layer model.
review.varveAssessment: Raster paint/erase compositing in the brush tools and rasterLayer nodes.

title: Keyboard navigation for node catalog

review.reason: Arrow-key navigation in the node catalog search results; an implemented Graphite node-graph picker feature with no Varve equivalent surface.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Lazy connect nodes

review.reason: Blender-style lazy connect between node sockets with modifier-drag; Varve has no node sockets or wires.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Network node/Merged nodes have no input types, cant edit input name, when creating new inputs from inside

review.reason: Network-node imports defaulting to type () with no type picker, so names cannot be edited until an external connection infers a type. This is Graphite node encapsulation machinery; Varve has no custom nodes or import types.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Mouse input offset in the node graph

review.reason: Node-graph pointer offset caused by the graph panel shifting when a menu opens at the window edge while the input layer does not move. Varve has no node graph panel or separate input layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Circular repeat radius not correct for paths

review.reason: Circular repeat radius being measured from the node's local space origin was confirmed as expected behaviour, not a defect, with a follow-up planned elsewhere. Varve has no repeat node and no such local-space parameter.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Improve SVG import UX

review.reason: Asks for a drop-time choice between importing an SVG as a new layer and as a new document, plus drop-on-empty-tab-area behaviour. Varve has an SVG importer and shell drop handling, but whether a destination choice is offered at drop time is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Import UX in the Shell drop handler / import report and the Home surface.

title: Keybindings for selecting vector mesh elements

review.reason: Varve's node editing exposes point and segment editing but defines no keyboard binding to switch element-selection modes, so the 1/2/3 element-mode convention described here is a real gap for keyboard-driven vector editing.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut registry (ShortcutManager) and the Node Edit tool's element modes.

title: Cursor should wrap around window when using G/R/S

review.reason: Cursor wrapping depends on a Blender-style modal G/R/S transform loop that captures the pointer for the duration of the transform. Varve transforms through on-canvas handles and the inspector rather than a modal keyboard loop, so there is no such capture to wrap.
review.varveAssessment: No affected path until a modal keyboard transform interaction exists.

title: Lazy drag layer(s) to the bottom of the stack if there is only 1 Artboard

review.reason: Dropping a layer into the empty area below the layer stack should re-home it at the bottom of the last artboard/frame instead of rejecting the reorder. Varve resolves a container and index for layer drops, but the empty-below-stack case is not described in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Layers panel drop planning (useLayerStructureCommands / layerCanvasDrop).

title: Expanding Artboard node inputs in the Node Graph removes it from the Layers Panel.

review.reason: Exposing an artboard's inputs in Graphite's node graph makes it disappear from the Layers panel; that coupling exists only because Graphite models layers as nodes. Varve's layer tree is independent of any graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Snapping for Gradient gizmo

review.reason: Extending snapping to gradient gizmo handles (object origin, midpoints, path elements, bounding box). Varve has a snapping system with target providers, but whether gradient handles are among the snappable targets is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping target registry and the gradient gizmo overlay.

title: While dragging a new Artboard only the starting point is snapped

review.reason: When dragging out a new artboard only the starting corner snaps, not the actively dragged side. Varve creates frames from a drag with snapping available, but the second corner's participation is not covered by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Frame creation drag and snapping in the frame/shape tool.

title: Web client gets slower as I paint more

review.reason: Painting progressively slowing the web client is attributed to the absence of GPU acceleration for the brush. Varve has raster paint plus a render-worker/WebGPU path, but accumulation cost across many strokes is unmeasured in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Raster brush performance and canvas frame time (perf harness).

title: new feat: render LaTeX/Typst Math formula to SVG

review.reason: Inserting LaTeX/Typst math as vector output requires a bundled math typesetting engine (or an asset-store dependency), which Varve does not have; its text pipeline does shaping/layout, not formula typesetting.
review.varveAssessment: No current Varve path; blocked on a math-typesetting capability.

title: Exit sub network with escape

review.reason: Escape inside a node sub-network should move up one level instead of closing the graph. Varve has no sub-networks or graph navigation.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Add scroll to status bar keybind hint groups

review.reason: Status-bar keybind hint groups overflow and cannot all be seen. Varve's responsive overflow work is documented for the floating tool palette (toolbarRetention), but whether its StatusBar hint groups collapse or scroll is not established.
review.varveAssessment: StatusBar hint layout and the toolbar retention/overflow system.

title: Bug: Offset while using brush tool on iPad

review.reason: Same iPad brush-ink offset as #3199 (the reporter cross-references it), confirmed still present on dev after several attempted fixes. This is the tablet/touch instance of the pointer-mapping family rather than a new defect.
review.varveAssessment: Same canvas pointer-mapping area as 3199; no separate Varve work.

title: Kurbo capacity overflow with `Offset Path` node

review.reason: A kurbo bezpath capacity overflow while offsetting specific artwork. Varve has boolean/path geometry but no documented offset-path operation, so whether an equivalent unbounded-allocation path exists is unverified.
review.varveAssessment: Path geometry ops (packages/scene boolean/liveBoolean, engine geometry) would need an allocation bound if offsetting is added.

title: Node graph ui misaligned

review.reason: Node-graph UI and click targets drifting out of alignment, with no reproduction steps. Varve has no node graph canvas, so the layer/viewport alignment between graph rendering and its input surface does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Performance issues selecting node graph

review.reason: Slow selection updates in the node graph, attributed to redrawing graph visuals rather than selection logic. Varve has no node graph rendering path.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: [feat]:Add hovering effect on buttons

review.reason: Varve's shared Button/IconButton/ToggleButton system already defines hover and active states across the closed variant vocabulary (the components stylesheet carries hover rules for every variant), and hand-rolled buttons are blocked by tests.
review.varveAssessment: Button states already exist; no hover work needed.

title: Avoid text-justify: inter-character in website

review.reason: Varve's Astro website never declares text-justify: inter-character (no occurrence anywhere under apps/website), so the inter-character justification that stretches inline code on mobile is not in use.
review.varveAssessment: Website typography; no change required.

title: wow this is incredible! Where's the download button though?

review.reason: Not a defect: a user asking where the desktop download is, answered in-thread that it was planned. Varve already ships desktop builds, so there is nothing to mirror.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Leverage dirtry rect from cef's accelarated paint api

review.reason: Depends on CEF's accelerated-paint capture_update_rect in Graphite's desktop shell, which the maintainer also judged not to be a bottleneck. Varve's desktop shell is Tauri (WebKitGTK/WKWebView/WebView2), not CEF, and it already has dirty-rect redraw on its own compositor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve has no CEF shell.

title: Add an arrow to the Shape tool

review.reason: Varve already has an arrow as a shape/tool: packages/editor/src/tools/ArrowTool.ts builds arrow geometry with dedicated tests, and the arrow shape is registered in the tool registry.
review.varveAssessment: Arrow shape already exists.

title: Path handles glitch out when moved

review.reason: Path handles vanishing after editing a path fed by Spline and Flatten nodes was traced to the spline node not producing stable segment ids. Varve path geometry is edited directly, not produced by graph nodes with ephemeral segment ids.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Crash when drawing artboard with stuck resize handles

review.reason: The artboard tool keeps cached bounds after Ctrl+Z deletes the artboard, then re-enters resize with no target and panics on unwrap. Varve's tools and overlays cache document snapshots too, but whether stale bounds are cleared when the target node disappears is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Frame/artboard tool state and undo invalidation in the tool + overlay layer.

title: Artboard Tool creates new artboard instead of moving existing one on infinite canvas (causes background disappearance)

review.reason: On an infinite canvas, the artboard tool creating a new artboard instead of moving the existing one and blanking the background. Varve has frames on an infinite canvas but the packet does not describe its frame-tool behaviour there.
review.varveAssessment: Frame tool semantics and the canvas background path.

title: Extrude node for lines and shapes

review.reason: 3D extrusion of lines and shapes for isometric illustration. Varve's engine is 2D vector/raster (Canvas2D default with opt-in WebGPU) and has no 3D geometry or projection subsystem.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: The same kurbo bezpath capacity overflow (number of path items exceeding i32 range) reproduced by changing Offset distance on text; the maintainer confirmed it is a duplicate of #3288 and already fixed upstream.
review.varveAssessment: Same unknown as 3288; no separate Varve work.

title: Additional color picker modes

review.reason: Varve's colour fields already offer HEX, RGB, HSL and HSB, which covers the easy half of the request, but there are no Lab, LCH, OKLab, OKLCH, XYZ or LUV picker modes and only a square area selector. The remaining colour-model modes and alternate visualizations are real missing work.
review.varveAssessment: ColorPicker modes in @varve/ui and the colour-science helpers in varve-colour.

title: Mac Alt+_ shortcuts don't work on desktop

review.reason: macOS turns Option+key combinations into composed characters, so shortcuts only fire when a menu is open. Whether Varve's shortcut matching normalizes to key-without-modifiers or event.code on macOS is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut matching in ShortcutManager and the desktop key-event bridge.

title: Hitching when there's a hidden raster layer in the document

review.reason: Hitching with a hidden raster layer was traced to a one-second autosave interval, not to rendering. Varve has its own autosave/persistence cadence and revision store, but the cost of serializing raster layers on that cadence is unmeasured here.
review.varveAssessment: Autosave cadence in usePersistence and the revision store's snapshot cost.

title: Local-axis grab (G key) doesn't work on groups

review.reason: Local-axis transforms ignoring a rotated group's basis, in fact reversing, is a transform-correctness class Varve also has because groups carry rotation. Whether Varve offers a local-axis constrained transform at all, and whether it handles group bases, is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Transform application for rotated groups in the canvas/transform ops.

title: Local-axis grab (G key) dashed line should show only the X or Y component, tilted

review.reason: The request is to tilt an axis-guide dashed line with the layer's local space during a modal grab. Varve has no Blender-style G/R/S modal overlay drawing axis guides; transforms run through on-canvas handles.
review.varveAssessment: No affected path until a modal axis-constrained transform overlay exists.

title: [UX] Move the "Node graph" button to the left

review.reason: Node graph button discoverability in Graphite's control bar; the maintainer reframed the underlying defect as control-bar overflow and tracked it separately. Varve has no node graph button.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: The document panel's control bar overflows and hides elements behind a horiz. scrollbar

review.reason: Control-bar elements hidden behind a non-obvious horizontal scrollbar on small windows. Varve implements retention-ordered overflow with a sticky More control for the floating tool palette, but whether its document/context bar uses the same mechanism is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Control/context bar layout and the toolbar retention system.

title: Clean up the app menu bar code to send its TextButtons directly as a layout

review.reason: An internal Graphite refactor to send the app menubar's TextButtons through its widget layout/diff system instead of a special MenuLayout case. Varve's menubar is React components, so there is no layout-diff special case to remove.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Instance Index/Instance Repeat

review.reason: Instance Index supplies 0 for the first instance, so a radius or scale multiplied by it produces a zero-size shape that appears missing. Resolved as expected node semantics; Varve has no instance-repeat or instance-index node.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Regression: cannot add new nodes inline

review.reason: A regression from Graphite's message-deferral change: inline node-add buttons and overlay popover checkboxes reference invalid widget ids and stop working. Varve has no backend-driven widget layout or diffing protocol.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Deletion of a node results in incorrect upstream nodes being deleted

review.reason: Deleting a node also deletes upstream nodes because deletion follows wire connectivity semantics. Varve's layers have no wires; deleting a node removes only that node and its descendants.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Retrieving all Context components from outer nested iteration scopes

review.reason: A Graphene architecture request to read any Context component from outer nested iteration scopes without heap allocation. Varve has no Graphene evaluator, iteration scopes, or node Context.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: 'Instance Index' node's 'Loop Level' parameter counts from the wrong direction

review.reason: A Graphene regression where the Instance Index node's Loop Level counts from the outermost instead of the innermost scope; Varve has no loop levels or instance indexing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Vello renderer crash

review.reason: A panic in the gsvg/Vello renderer when unwrapping a stroke style that is absent. Varve has no gsvg or Vello renderer; stroke replay goes through the Canvas2D/WebGPU compositor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Add the artboard dimensions to the Context

review.reason: Adding artboard dimensions to Graphite's node Context as a var arg node. Varve has no node Context and no artboard-size node; frame size is already a document property.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Checkbox labels are now one-time use for clicking to toggle their checkbox

review.reason: Labels toggling checkboxes only once was caused by randomized widget/checkbox ids in Graphite's Rust-to-Svelte diff protocol. Varve renders native React inputs associated with real label elements and stable useId values, so labels toggle every time.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; standard DOM label association.

title: PDF export

review.reason: Varve already writes PDF itself: the varve-print crate does lopdf-based PDF and PDF/X output with CMYK and ICC profiles (plus font outlining), exposed through the @varve/print facade and the print/preflight workflow. The deeper conic-gradient and print-colour fidelity points would be separate verification, not a missing capability.
review.varveAssessment: PDF export already exists via varve-print; fidelity cases would be separate.
