review.varveAssessment: LayersPanel layerContextMenu/addMaskToSelected is the only clip-mask entry point; the modifier-hover affordance does not exist.

title: On desktop, automatically fall back to non-hardware accelerated UI on failure

review.reason: Depends on CEF's first-frame texture handoff and a persisted non-accelerated compatibility mode for the embedded browser UI. Varve has no CEF layer: the desktop shell is Tauri/WebKitGTK and rendering already defaults to Canvas2D with WebGPU opt-in.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path; there is no embedded-browser texture surface that can come back blank.

title: Opening an image to create a document has a half-pixel offset

review.reason: A dropped image should not land with a half-pixel offset in the artboard. Varve has an image drop/import placement path, but neither the packet nor the code establishes whether dropped images are rounded or land on fractional coordinates.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect @varve/editor file-drop placement and the camera-to-artboard coordinate conversion.

title: Dragging range-style number inputs constrained to integers doesn't accumulate slow mouse movements

review.reason: Varve's NumberField drag-scrub is an accumulator: each move recomputes the value from total pointer travel (base + travel x step) and emits a delta, so sub-step slow movement is never rounded away and lost.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector NumberField/RangeValueControl scrub already accumulates fractional travel.

title: Convert node no longer supports strings

review.reason: A regression in the Graphene Convert node's automatic type-conversion table for the String type. Varve has no node graph, wire types, or type-inference system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: RC2 Flatpak Desktop installation - Sub standard Performance ... system HOG !

review.reason: The reported hog was an always-on software-emulated GPU render loop (llvmpipe). Varve renders with Canvas2D by default (WebGPU is opt-in with Canvas2D fallback) and its accelerator capability model reports discovered/loadable/device-usable/execution-verified stages instead of assuming acceleration.
review.varveAssessment: Renderer default plus truthful accelerator capability staging removes the emulation-at-idle failure mode.

title: RC3 Windows Desktop - Artboard off-screen on New Document

review.reason: New-document centring is dispatched before the viewport reports a non-zero size, so the artboard lands off-screen. Varve fits the camera on document creation, but the packet does not establish whether its first-document fit can also run before layout settles.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the new-document camera fit and viewport-size readiness in @varve/editor.

title: Cannot add node with context menu

review.reason: A Svelte 5 reactivity regression in Graphite's NodeCatalog context menu. Varve's UI is React and it has no node catalog.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Selection jumps back to previously selected node after its drag abort, upon clicking to select new node

review.reason: Selection state restored from a stale drag-abort record in the node graph. Varve has no node graph selection model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: [Crash Report] Pen Tablet Eraser Button

review.reason: The crash is a panicking bitmask decode of mouse keys. Varve's pointer input is TypeScript over DOM PointerEvents, where an unmapped pen button (the eraser button) matches no tool handler and is ignored rather than decoded with an expect.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas pointer input cannot hard-crash on an unrecognised pen button.

title: Clarify Stroke and Fill Icons

review.reason: The complaint is that two identical circles are primary/secondary colours rather than fill/stroke, which the reporter was told would be redesigned in the control bar. Varve's Inspector exposes separate Fill and Stroke sections, but whether it shows an unlabelled primary/secondary swatch pair is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch the Inspector fill/stroke controls and any toolbar colour swatch pair.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: Closed upstream as a duplicate of #3288; the crash is the Graphene Offset Path node when Distance is set to an extreme value (reproduced only on the editor build, not the dev build).
review.varveAssessment: Node-graph node evaluation; Varve has no Offset Path node.

title: On desktop, a drag followed by a click causes a double click

review.reason: Varve consumes the browser's native dblclick (CanvasArea onDoubleClick -> inputPipeline -> ToolManager.handleDoubleClick) with no drag-then-click suppression, so a drag released over a node followed by a single click can be treated as a double click.
review.varveAssessment: CanvasArea double-click handling and BaseTool drag bookkeeping in @varve/editor canvas/inputPipeline.ts.

title: No rasterize node on desktop

review.reason: A Graphene node compiled only for the wasm target (cfg(target_family = "wasm")), tracked separately. Varve has no node catalog to gate per platform.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Desktop: parse and include CEF credits

review.reason: Parsing the CEF binary archive's CREDITS.html into Graphite's third-party licence dialog. Varve's desktop shell is Tauri/WebKitGTK with no CEF dependency bundle, and its licence inventory is its own.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Simplify layer structure hierarchy plumbing

review.reason: Replacing Graphite's custom Rust-to-Svelte encoding of layer hierarchy depth with plain serde structs. Varve's layer tree lives in @varve/scene and is rendered from React state, so this plumbing has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Custom pivot in some cases has poor visibility

review.reason: A pivot gizmo becomes invisible when the artwork uses the same colour. Varve uses a pivot only as a TransformEngine rotation option and draws no user-facing pivot gizmo, so the reported visibility problem has no established Varve surface.
review.varveAssessment: Relevant only if Varve adds an on-canvas pivot marker; SelectionOverlay/gizmo styling would be the area.

title: Scaling with S+X/Y should not require mouse movement in the desired direction to take effect

review.reason: The request is Blender-style axis-absolute scaling via S+X/Y. Varve's ScaleTool currently constrains only with Shift (uniform), so the directional-movement requirement described here cannot be confirmed or denied from the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch ScaleTool axis-lock semantics in @varve/editor tools.

title: [Crash Report] Ability to create a recursive layer

review.reason: Connecting a layer's outgoing wire to its own input in Graphene's graph. Varve has no node graph; its mask/scope cycle detection is a separate mechanism.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Segment molding Shift key X/Y constraint

review.reason: Shift X/Y constraint for Graphite's segment-molding graph editing interaction, which reuses its X/Y snapping overlay. No equivalent graph editing subsystem exists in Varve.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Graphite MCP Server

review.reason: An external MCP server for driving the editor from another tool. Varve exposes no automation API or server surface (its trust-boundary rules keep clients backend-free) and has no plugin protocol.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Line tool needs Ctrl to lock angle only after drag has begun

review.reason: Varve binds line-angle locking to Shift (45-degree increments in LineTool) and snaps endpoints through the automatic snapping engine, so Ctrl carries no double meaning that would need to be staged before or after the drag.
review.varveAssessment: LineTool modifier semantics do not have the Ctrl conflict described.

title: Holding Ctrl in the graph doesn't allow selecting nodes unless some are in a layer

review.reason: Ctrl-based multi-select in the node graph. Varve has no node graph selection model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Use automatic type conversion to convert from () and T into T with Merge nodes

review.reason: Graphene type inference converting () to T so Merge nodes stop mismatching. Varve has no node graph, wire types, or inference.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: First-class Item and List wire types with rank polymorphism (foundation for data trees)

review.reason: A spec for Graphene Item/List wire types with rank polymorphism and data trees. Varve's scene is a direct document tree edited by hand, not a dataflow graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Async executor refactor

review.reason: Building a custom async runtime that operates on Graphene's graph instead of the shadow-structure polling model. Varve has no graph evaluator or async node executor.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: On desktop the entire ui is unresponsive unless in windowed mode

review.reason: The desktop UI becomes unresponsive in fullscreen on Wayland with no root cause in the packet; logs were requested and never supplied. Whether Varve's Tauri/WebKitGTK window shares the mechanism is unknown.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect desktop window/fullscreen handling on Wayland if the mechanism is shared.

title: Pen tool preview line disappearing during repeated undo

review.reason: The pen tool's preview line disappears after repeated undo. Varve has a PenTool draft overlay and an undo path, but neither the packet nor the code establishes whether the preview survives consecutive undos.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect PenTool draft/overlay state across undo in @varve/editor tools.

title: Desktop: replace SVG Preview render mode renderer with resvg

review.reason: Replacing Graphite's SVG Preview render mode with resvg. Varve has no SVG-preview render mode; its preview and export path is the Canvas2D IR replay.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Pasted node should spawn at cursor's position in the graph

review.reason: Paste placement relative to the cursor inside the node graph, including collision avoidance. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Right-click on a wire to paste by inserting copied nodes

review.reason: Right-clicking a wire to insert copied nodes at that point in the graph. Varve has no wires or node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Desktop: support the Eyedropper outside the app window

review.reason: Sampling colour anywhere on screen needs native full-window sampling; Varve's EyedropperTool samples the document canvas only, and the Tauri webview exposes no screen-sampling primitive (Wayland forbids it outright).
review.varveAssessment: Blocked on a native screen-sampling capability behind the EyedropperTool.

title: Path tool overlays no longer showing with Vello renderer active (regression)

review.reason: A Vello-renderer regression that stopped path-tool overlays from drawing. Varve has no Vello renderer; overlays are drawn in the overlay layer with the shared camera transform.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Ctrl+D inside a layer's sub-graph causes the parent layer to be placed inside itself

review.reason: Ctrl+D inside a layer's node sub-graph duplicating the parent layer into itself. Varve has no node sub-graphs.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Midpoint controls between gradient stop markers

review.reason: Varve gradient stops carry a per-stop midpoint and the GradientEditor exposes it (numeric control plus ramp interpolation), so a stop's influence can be biased between markers.
review.varveAssessment: GradientEditor / scene gradient stop model already supports midpoint biasing.

title: Gradient paints on strokes

review.reason: Varve already paints gradients on strokes: the engine replays stroke.gradient through gradientStrokeToFill, and strokes accept the same gradient paints as fills.
review.varveAssessment: Engine stroke replay and stroke paint model already support gradients.

title: New document > close it > new document > the artboard doesn't render

review.reason: A render cache assumes a value is never reset, so a new document stops drawing after all documents are closed. Varve has comparable caches (SubtreeReplayCache, painted-surface reuse), but the packet gives no evidence whether they reset on session close.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect document-lifecycle cache invalidation in @varve/editor canvas/render.

title: Dev server fails on Windows if port 8080 is already in use (EACCES error)

review.reason: Graphite's Vite dev-server host/port configuration and setup-guide wording for its contributor workflow. This is Graphite developer tooling, not a product capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Auto-Tangents node with spread = 0 and preserve existing = true causes weird change

review.reason: Handle maths in Graphene's Auto-Tangents node when spread is zero. Varve has no auto-tangents node or node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Fill node solid colour backup resets when just clicked

review.reason: Varve's fill type switch keeps the retained solid colour: setFillType('solid') patches with the existing fill.color and only falls back to the first gradient stop when no solid colour exists, so switching gradient and back does not reset to white.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector FillSection fill-type switching already preserves per-mode colour.

title: The Artboard Preview image doesn't reset with the artboard.

review.reason: Closed upstream as a duplicate of #3597: the artboard preview thumbnail is not invalidated when the artboard itself is reset.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's thumbnail identity is revision-based, so a stale preview would be a different defect.

title: Getting a C++ API?

review.reason: A request for a public C++ (or any-language) embedding API. Varve is an application plus a headless CLI and ships no library/embedding surface.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Community gallery

review.reason: A hosted community gallery with upload, view, edit and fork. Varve is local-first and, by its trust-boundary rules, has no backend service to host shared projects.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: [Crash Report]  change individual corner radius while rectangle has offset

review.reason: An unbounded kurbo fit recursion (capacity overflow) when one corner radius is changed on a shape that also has an offset and stroke. Unclear whether Varve's corner-radius and path-offset geometry shares that recursion pattern.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect corner-radius recomputation on stroked/offset geometry in @varve/scene and the Rust engine.

title: Pasted image is stuck in the canvas

review.reason: Varve's render invariant guarantees painted pixels are only a loan against a fresh authoritative frame, so a pasted image cannot stay stale on the canvas while its layer preview updates.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas render pipeline invalidation already prevents a stale pasted image.

title: Exporting Circle Cuts Edges

review.reason: Export bounds in Varve expand by appearancePaddingWorld, which adds centre/outside stroke width plus miter-limit and arrowhead extent, so a thick stroked circle is not cropped at the path bounds.
review.varveAssessment: Export world bounds already include stroke appearance padding.

title: Same Artboard name selects on export

review.reason: Export jobs and target selection are keyed by nodeId (plus preset id), not by layer name, so identically named artboards stay independently selectable.
review.varveAssessment: ExportDialog job selection is identity-keyed.

review.reason: Titleless report whose only substantive comment says the Firefox-only fix is covered by #2340; no separate finding remains.
review.varveAssessment: No distinct Varve surface; folds into the eyedropper work.

title: Vello rendering incorrect colors in Firefox on Mac

review.reason: Incorrect colour output from the Vello renderer in Firefox on macOS. Varve has no Vello renderer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Text Vertical Align.

review.reason: Varve's text model carries textAlignVertical ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'), the Inspector TypographySection edits it, and it is passed into the render IR alongside horizontal alignment.
review.varveAssessment: Vertical text alignment already exists end to end.

title: [RC4] Window Resizing breaks App (frequently)

review.reason: CEF failing to re-invalidate its embedded view after a window resize; the accepted fix is a CEF host patch that drops the platform gate on host.invalidate. Varve has no CEF host, and its UI is the native webview.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Handle operations don't work on shapes created with the Shape Tool

review.reason: Alt-drag (grow handles symmetrically) and Ctrl-drag (snap handle angle) do not work on geometry created by the shape tool. Varve has node editing with corner/smooth/symmetric handle modes, but the packet does not establish whether shape-tool output accepts those drag modifiers.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect NodeEditTool handle modifiers on parametric-shape geometry.

title: Stroke weight inconsistency between Shape tools and pen/pencil/spline tool

review.reason: Default stroke weight looks different, and changes differently under transform, between shape tools and pen/pencil/spline tools. Varve's tools emit ordinary stroked nodes, but the packet gives no evidence about default-weight parity or stroke scaling under transform.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect tool default stroke presets and stroke scaling in the transform path.

title: Flatpak RC4 doesn't launching

review.reason: The crash indexes an adapter/surface list that can be empty. Varve's native accelerator path discovers capabilities and runs a bounded self-test before use, with Canvas2D as the renderer of record, so an unusable adapter degrades instead of panicking at startup.
review.varveAssessment: Accelerator capability staging plus Canvas2D default removes the hard adapter-index failure.

title: Shaking a Text layer breaks its type signature

review.reason: A Graphene type-signature break when a text layer passes through graph operations. Varve has no node-graph type system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Crash when adding an Extract node in the node editor

review.reason: The Graphene Extract node reaches an unreachable resolve path; upstream noted the node is not wired into the application at all. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: After importing an image and then doing cmd + z , the layer isn't deleted.

review.reason: File import commits a single history batch (useFileImport: 'One batch, so the whole import is a single undo step'), so Ctrl+Z removes the imported image layer.
review.varveAssessment: Import history batching already covers undo of imported images.

title: The pen merging tool is creating a jitter at the endpoints [RESOLVED]

review.reason: Endpoint jitter when the pen path-merging tool joins segments, reported upstream as resolved. The packet carries no reproduction detail and Varve's pen endpoint-merge behaviour is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect PenTool path joining if Varve's merge path shares the defect.

title: Font value

review.reason: Font as a graph value type feeding a Text node. Varve has no node graph; fonts are node properties edited in the Inspector.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: Closed upstream as a duplicate of #3576: the export dialog panics on an unwrap when export is attempted after copying paths between open documents.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's export path is preflight-driven; no equivalent unwrap exists on the packet's evidence.

title: Improve and  Add unit tests for untested tool and editor modules

review.reason: Graphite-internal tracking of missing unit-test coverage in specific editor/src modules. No Varve capability or behaviour is described.
review.varveAssessment: Test-coverage bookkeeping for another codebase.

title: `cargo run` fails on WebAssembly target due to `CARGO_BUILD_TARGET` leaking into `rustc_codegen_spirv` build

review.reason: A Rust-GPU/cargo-gpu nested build inheriting CARGO_BUILD_TARGET from a wasm-pack invocation. Varve has no Rust-GPU shader pipeline or cargo-gpu build script.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Resizing a shape to zero locks it permanently

review.reason: Varve clamps scaled dimensions in the transform path (Math.max(1, ...) for width/height, and fontSize), so a shape cannot be driven to a zero-size state that a later nudge would divide by.
review.varveAssessment: TransformEngine dimension clamps already prevent the zero-size lock.

title: convert string value to float or int

review.reason: String-to-number conversion inside the node graph; upstream resolved it with a String To Number node. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: trim string

review.reason: A string-trim operation exposed as a graph node. Varve has no node graph or string value type.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Add tests for polygon shape, star shape, and grid snapping tools

review.reason: Adding Rust unit tests to Graphite's polygon, star and grid-snapping tool modules. This is test-coverage work for another codebase, not a Varve behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Smooth brush caps for the freehand and line tools

review.reason: Stroke cap (round/butt/square) is a first-class stroke property in Varve's model and Inspector, and the line and pencil tools emit ordinary stroked paths, so smooth caps are already available.
review.varveAssessment: Stroke cap property already provides smooth caps for freehand and line output.

title: Add Comprehensive “Getting Started” Guide with End-to-End First Project Walkthrough

review.reason: A Getting Started guide plus first-project walkthrough for Graphite's users and contributors. Documentation for another project; Varve has its own docs set.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: [Docs] Contributor onboarding: host vs wasm build target and raster-shader (Rust-GPU) setup

review.reason: Contributor onboarding docs about host-vs-wasm targets and Rust-GPU setup. This documents Graphite's build toolchain, which Varve does not share.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: cache font outline lookup in `path_builder.rs` (performance)

review.reason: Caching font outline lookup per glyph run in the text node's path builder. The issue was closed upstream as unverified, and neither the packet nor Varve's code shows whether outline construction repeats per replay.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect text outline cost in @varve/engine textOutlines if outlines are rebuilt per frame.

title: Add unit tests for spiral shape and arrow shape tools

review.reason: Adding unit tests for Graphite's spiral and arrow shape tool modules. Test-coverage work for another codebase.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: [Crash Report]

review.reason: Closed upstream as a duplicate of #3319: the artboard tool unwraps None when resizing an artboard that contains a resized imported SVG.
review.varveAssessment: Varve resizes frames through the shared transform path rather than an artboard-tool unwrap.

title: Mesh gradients

review.reason: Mesh gradients. Varve's paint model covers linear, radial and conic gradients plus gradient maps only, with no mesh geometry or mesh rendering; the upstream 'blocked on raster infrastructure' caveat does not apply to Varve, which already has a raster pipeline.
review.varveAssessment: @varve/scene paint model plus @varve/engine replayGradient would need a mesh patch type and renderer.

title: Gradient spread methods

review.reason: Gradient spread methods (pad/reflect/repeat). Varve's gradient model has no spread-mode field, so a gradient cannot tile or mirror beyond its handles.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient paint model, GradientEditor, and replayGradient would all need a spread mode.

title: Gradient radial focal point

review.reason: Radial gradient focal point. Varve's radial gradient is centre plus radius with no focal offset, so the falloff cannot be decentred from the ellipse.
review.varveAssessment: Radial gradient model, canvas gradient handles, and the Canvas2D replay would need a focal-point input.

title: Gradient tool gizmos for setting radial ellipse's minor and major axis

review.reason: Varve's canvas gradient handles already expose radial-u-axis and radial-v-axis drag handles, and moveGradientHandle edits the unit-fill affine matrix while preserving the untouched axis.
review.varveAssessment: GradientHandleOverlay plus gradientHandleGeometry already provide minor/major axis gizmos.

title: Gradient interpolation color spaces

review.reason: Gradient interpolation colour space is modelled as GradientInterpolationSpace (srgb, linear-srgb, oklab, oklch, hsl) with oklab as the default.
review.varveAssessment: Scene colour management already exposes gradient interpolation spaces.

title: Gradient interpolation with independent alpha from color

review.reason: Gradient stops interpolate a single rgba colour in Varve, so alpha cannot be driven independently of the colour ramp.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient stop model plus GradientEditor would need a separate alpha-ramp representation.

title: Gradient positioning line based on vector line control geometry

review.reason: Varve resolves gradient geometry through the node's own unit-fill-to-local affine transform rather than a control-path data type, matching the upstream resolution ('we use the transform instead now').
review.varveAssessment: Gradient transform model already covers positioning without new geometry types.

title: Contour gradients

review.reason: Contour gradients (SDF-style projection inward from a shape's perimeter to its centre). Varve's paint model and renderer have no perimeter-derived gradient mode.
review.varveAssessment: Would require a new fill type in @varve/scene plus an SDF-based render path in @varve/engine.

title: Very long text does not forcibly wrap at its max width

review.reason: Text nodes persist maxWidth in the scene model, and layout breaks over-long units at grapheme boundaries (graphemeBreakUnits) so a long word wraps instead of running out of the box.
review.varveAssessment: Text layout already forces grapheme-safe wrapping at the persisted max width.

title: Text alignment should work without an explicit max-width

review.reason: Alignment should fall back to the block's own bound when no max width is set. Varve carries textAlign into the render IR over the node box, but the packet does not establish what it aligns against without an explicit max width.

title: Checkered background in main viewport

title: The Artboard tool needs to support G/S (grab and scale) transformation

review.reason: Frames/artboards in Varve are ordinary scene nodes selected and transformed through the shared TransformEngine and SelectionOverlay, so there is no separate artboard-tool transform path that could lack grab/scale.
review.varveAssessment: No divergent artboard transform path exists.

title: Text tool layer flashes at origin (0,0) before snapping to cursor position

review.reason: Varve's TextTool creates the node directly at the pointer position (createTextNodeAt) and previews the drag as a draft overlay, so no interim text node is rendered at the document origin.

title: Bind groups getting created while zooming / panning out

review.reason: Bind-group churn in the Vello/WGPU executor when caching render output as stitchable textures. Varve has no Vello renderer or WGPU executor render graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Changing the font in a text object doesn't work

review.reason: Varve's text quick bar applies font changes to the selected text node through fontFamilyChanges, and the Inspector edits the same node, so a font pulldown is not limited to future objects.
review.varveAssessment: Font changes already route to the current selection.

title: [Crash Report] Crash on canvas click after editing String node with a pinned Number node

review.reason: Pinned node-graph value widgets: committing a String node's text field panics while a Number Value node is pinned. Varve has no node graph or widget pinning.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Version of docs vs public web app

review.reason: Version drift between Graphite's auto-generated node docs and its hosted editor release. Documentation-site policy for another project.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Boolean Operations sets pivot to (0, 0)

review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Read Index for Repeat On Points not affected by Reverse

review.reason: Repeat On Points' Reverse flag not affecting the context-fed read index order in Graphene. Varve has no node graph or repeat-on-points node.

review.varveAssessment: Engine fontResolver plus .notdef reporting already covers missing-script fallback.

title: Existing file broke on editor.graphite.art

review.reason: A legacy Graphene document where an 'Image' wrapper network was never migrated to the image proto node. Varve's scene documents contain no node networks, and its own versioned schema migrations cover scene structures only.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Transparent PNG Option on Export Disappeared

review.reason: Varve has no separate transparent-background export toggle: exported alpha follows the document's own page/frame background, so hiding or clearing the background already yields a transparent PNG.
review.varveAssessment: Transparency is document content, not an export option, so no option can disappear.

title: Stroke weight inconsistency depending on angle

review.reason: Graphite's pen-tool stroke width looked thinner on axis-aligned edges than on inclined ones; a second reporter says it no longer reproduces on a later build, and the packet contains no root cause or fix reference. Varve's stroke rendering is its own implementation, and the packet shows nothing about whether stroke width varies with segment angle.
review.varveAssessment: Varve stroke rendering and preview/export parity would be the affected area, but no Varve defect is established by the packet.

title: Fill color does not work properly

review.reason: The blue fill rendering brown is a macOS plus Firefox colour-handling defect; a commenter links the same behaviour to #3880, where a fix PR is mentioned, and the maintainer closes this as duplicate. The reporter confirmed Chrome renders correctly and that an imported raster image also shifts colour, so it is a rendering-path issue rather than a document issue.
review.varveAssessment: Varve colour-managed rendering and SVG/preview parity would be the affected area if the browser colour defect recurred; the canonical report is #3880.

title: Crash in Opening Graphite in Web "https://editor.graphite.art/" for Open With File

review.reason: The report is an unfilled crash template with no reproduction steps and no error log, and it was closed as not planned for containing no information. Nothing in the packet identifies a behaviour that could be mapped onto Varve.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow can be assessed from a report with no reproduction or stack trace.

title: Skewing images doesn't preview

review.reason: Graphite's SVG render mode computed a wrong matrix for raster image transforms, so skew previewed only in the vello renderer and in export; the comment supplies a renderer-side matrix fix. Varve skews images through its own transform path, and the packet gives no evidence whether its canvas preview and export agree for skewed images.
review.varveAssessment: Varve image transform rendering and SVG/PNG export parity would be the affected area.

title: New nodes added in the wrong place

review.reason: The bug is in Graphite's node-graph canvas: a shifted mouse position is used to spawn a node, so it appears somewhere other than the right-click point. Varve has no node graph or procedural node system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node-graph canvas.

title: Stroke alignment selection bug

review.reason: Graphite zeroed the stroke width for inside alignment and then derived click targets from that width, making inside-aligned strokes hard to hover or select. Varve's HitTestEngine tests path proximity with a screen-space stroke tolerance that does not depend on stroke width or alignment, so inside and outside strokes stay selectable.
review.varveAssessment: Varve selection and hover hit testing on strokes is the analogous area and is not exposed to this failure.

title: Text migration fail from Jan 16 2026

review.reason: The failure came from the first text migration not updating the Graphene node's inputs_count, which then blocked a later migration that required a specific count. Varve migrations are explicit per-version steps (v0.9 through v2.33) applied in sequence, with no node input-count gate for an earlier step to leave stale.
review.varveAssessment: Varve document schema migration is the analogous area and its sequential versioned mechanism does not share this defect.

title: Pen tool offset when merging

review.reason: The offset appears when placing an anchor on another layer's endpoint triggers an automatic layer merge. Varve's pen tool never merges separate layers automatically and joining geometry is an explicit command, so the merge-during-anchor-placement path does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen-tool anchor placement is the analogous workflow and has no automatic cross-layer merge.

title: Allow avoid merging layers with pen tool

review.reason: The request is for an indication of, and an option to avoid, automatic pen-tool layer merging on coincident anchors. Varve never merges layers on anchor coincidence, so two layers are never silently combined and the requested escape hatch is unnecessary.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen-tool layer behaviour already satisfies the request by not merging automatically.

title: Graphite Fails to Load in Brave Browser with Fingerprinting Protection Enabled

review.reason: The blank page was caused by Brave shielding setting navigator.keyboard to null while Graphite's frontend tested it with a not-undefined check. Varve's frontend never calls the keyboard-lock API, and its fullscreen path uses requestFullscreen only, so this null dereference path does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: Varve web and desktop fullscreen paths do not use navigator.keyboard and are unaffected.

title: Relases and versions - for downstream packaging?

review.reason: This concerns Graphite's release and versioning process plus downstream distro packaging, asking for tagged releases, signed artifacts and AUR/nixpkgs coordination. Varve already has its own release lifecycle (release:prepare, release:certify, release manifests and signing policy) and takes no action from Graphite's packaging process.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite release and packaging process only; no Varve product workflow is affected.

title: Dependency uses nightly toolchain even when building app with stable toolchain

review.reason: The build failure is Graphite's rust-gpu shader pipeline, where rustc_codegen_spirv needs a pinned nightly toolchain and the build script tries to install it. Varve's Rust workspace builds with a stable toolchain and has no GPU shader codegen build step.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite build tooling only; Varve does not compile shaders through rust-gpu.

title: License handler lock file issues

review.reason: This is about Graphite's third-party-licenses tool invoking cargo about with --frozen and how packagers prefetch dependencies for offline builds. It is build tooling rather than an editor capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve has no cargo-about licence-generation build step.

title: Values in property sliders getting tied to mouse position

review.reason: The stuck-slider behaviour came from pointer-lock drag cleanup being overwritten by a rapid second click, leaving no reference to the old cleanup closure; the diagnosis suggests setPointerCapture instead. Varve's property sliders are native input type=range controls styled by .varve-native-range, so the browser owns capture and there is no application-level activeDragCleanup to lose.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's native-range slider system is structurally immune to this class of stuck drag.

title: Support more types in the «Extract Element» node

review.reason: The request is for more List<T> variants in Graphene's Extract Element node so values from Read attribute can be consumed. Varve has no node graph or typed value-list system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Strange behavior with place duplicate and move duplicate

review.reason: Ctrl+D duplication does not update the select tool's drag state, so snapping and Alt-duplicate act on stale layers after a mid-gesture duplicate. Varve has its own duplicate command and Alt-drag clone in the select tool, but the packet gives no evidence whether a duplicate during a move gesture desynchronizes Varve's gesture selection.
review.varveAssessment: Varve select-tool duplicate and clone gestures would be the affected area.

title: Hold Shift to constrain dragging with Select Tool no longer has 45° increments

review.reason: Shift-drag constrains movement to the X and Y axes only, and users want 45-degree increments as in other drawing tools; the thread discusses scroll-wheel or arrow-key angle increments as options. Varve's select tool has the same axis-only Shift lock for moves, while its drawing tools already model a 45-degree angle-snap increment.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SelectTool shift-constrained moves and SnapGuidesOverlay would gain the 45-degree option; drawingAssists already models angle-snap increments.

title: Shift drag shows alignment lines at wrong object

review.reason: With two objects, Shift-dragging the second showed alignment guides anchored to the first, unless the second was reselected; it was closed as completed with no explanation. Varve's SnapGuidesOverlay resolves a target per guide, and the packet gives no evidence whether a stale selection can retarget guides.
review.varveAssessment: Varve alignment-guide targeting during a drag would be the affected area.

title: Dragging and alignment overlay color coding

review.reason: This is a design proposal to colour-code horizontal versus vertical alignment guides, draw centre alignment as infinite lines and show object distances, not a defect report. Varve's SnapGuidesOverlay already colours guides by type, but axis-distinct colouring and distance readouts are design decisions the packet does not settle.
review.varveAssessment: Varve snapping-guide visual language would be the affected area.

title: Crash using merge nodes when data panel open

review.reason: The crash is in Graphite's node-graph merge path interacting with the Data panel's monitor node, whose insertion assumes every node has at least one output. Varve has no node graph and no data panel.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Constructing List<T> from T

review.reason: Closing comment says constructing a List<T> from a T is the aim of #3779, and the long follow-up is entirely about Graphene table/row type ergonomics. The reported context is that Extend only accepts lists, so raw f64 values cannot be combined into a List<f64>.
review.varveAssessment: Graphene type system only; Varve has no typed node graph.

title: Grab Rotate Scale Handle Mode Requires Seemingly Redundant Confirmation

review.reason: Grab, Rotate and Scale handle modes required a second click and the preview segment did not follow the cursor; the maintainer changed the preview to track the pointer and closed it as completed. Varve's pen and node handle modes are its own implementation, and the packet does not show whether Varve has an equivalent two-step confirmation.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen and node-editing handle interactions would be the affected area.

title: Security Advisory: Self-Hosted Runner Risk (Skor: 20/100)

review.reason: An automated security advisory about Graphite's self-hosted GitHub Actions runners and risky triggers. It is Graphite CI infrastructure, not an editor capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve runs its own workflow-policy and secret-scan audits.

title: Tangent on Path node unclear output

review.reason: The complaint is that the Tangent on Path node returns degrees clockwise from +X without a unit hint or directional convention. That is Graphene node semantics and node-graph UX.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Typing of disconnected node outputs

review.reason: The request is to type disconnected output ports in Graphite's node graph by consulting the proto-node registry when no resolved type exists. Varve has no node graph or port type resolution.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Node graph connection to export in wrong place

review.reason: Wire connectors were not refreshed after altering an export node in Graphite's node-graph view, leaving the connection drawn in the wrong place. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Support compress punctuation to optimize CJK typography

review.reason: CJK justified text does not compress full-width punctuation or adjust inter-character spacing, so punctuation cannot be held off line starts and the justify looks wrong; the reporter provides a Chinese sample and Scribus, LibreOffice and Typst comparisons. Varve supports CJK shaping, JLREQ line-break prohibition and justify, but its justify path distributes space only across whitespace runs, which CJK text does not contain.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's text pipeline (engine replay justify and lineBreakProhibition) would need punctuation compression and character-space distribution for CJK.

title: The Esc key exits the full screen mode before exiting the text box

review.reason: Escape exited browser fullscreen before committing a text box, and the reporter later confirmed that updating Chrome fixed it, so the packet shows no remaining application defect. Varve's text-edit Escape handling versus presentation-delivery fullscreen is not covered by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Varve text editing and presentation fullscreen key handling would be the affected area.

title: Corner Attment Misplacement [RC6]

review.reason: Attaching a line to a corner of another path misplaced the new geometry, first seen in RC4 and reported again for RC6; 0HyperCube marks it a duplicate of #4213. The retained reproduction is a line attached to a corner ending up displaced.
review.varveAssessment: Same Varve pen-tool area as #4213, which does not merge layers automatically.

title: SVG renderer ignores artboard color for blend modes

review.reason: The entire report is a screen recording showing Graphite's SVG render mode ignoring the artboard colour when compositing blend modes. Varve exports SVG and applies layer blend modes, but the packet gives no written reproduction for either.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG export and blend-mode composition against artboard backgrounds would need checking.

title: Round corner break the blend of layers

review.reason: Blending or morphing two layers with different topologies inserts points that do not map to the closest targets, and rounding corners changes topology; the maintainer closed it as inherent to the feature. Varve has no Graphite-style blend layer that interpolates between vector layers.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve's motion path morph does not build a blend layer over vector topologies.

title: Support for SVG filter effects

review.reason: Graphite lacks SVG fe* filter effects, which compose blur, morphology, glow and similar vector-friendly effects and affect both rendering and SVG export fidelity. Varve has live effects but its SVG importer neither applies fe* filters nor reports them among unsupported features, so filtered artwork imports silently flattened.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG import/export (packages/import/src/svg and unsupportedMetadata warnings) and the live-effects model would be affected.

title: Broken resizing with rectangle tool when scale ≈0

commentCountDiscrepancy.explanation: Issue listing count differs from the retrievable issue-comment connection; retain as unresolved until the source explains the discrepancy.

review.reason: A flattened transform cage (scale near zero) jitters because the bound transform becomes extremely small and loses precision; the proposed fix normalizes the cage scale and judges flatness in viewport space. The packet gives no evidence about Varve's transform-cage maths at degenerate scale.
review.varveAssessment: Varve selection transform cage and shape-tool resize maths would be the affected area.

title: Type hint is selected in node graph view

review.reason: The node catalogue auto-selects the typed search text, losing the type hint, and the issue is about Svelte node-graph UX. Varve has no node catalogue.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node catalogue.

title: Update winit

review.reason: Graphite crashed at startup with a Wacom tablet because it pinned an old winit commit; the fix was updating winit. Varve's Tauri desktop shell also builds on winit/tao, so the same upstream tablet crash could apply, but the packet does not state Varve's winit version or whether a tablet start was tested.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's Tauri desktop windowing stack (winit/tao on Linux) would be the affected area.

title: Gradient tool handles desync from exposed Fill gradient chains

review.reason: The desync came from the gradient tool reading identity while the renderer used the Fill node's bounding-box transform through an exposed gradient chain. Varve's gradient handles edit the canonical unit-fill to node-local affine directly through gradientHandleGeometry and gradientTransformForBounds, so handles and rendering share one source and cannot desync.
review.varveAssessment: Varve gradient tool and handle editing is the analogous workflow and is structurally free of this chain desync.

title: Merging anchors in path tool

review.reason: Graphite can join anchors with a new segment (Ctrl+J) but cannot merge anchors without creating a segment, and the request is to do it across layers. Varve's node editing has close and open path actions but no anchor-merge command, so coincident endpoints cannot be collapsed.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's NodeEditTool and path operations would need an anchor-merge command alongside close/open path.

title: Select tool double click text to edit in shallow select mode

review.reason: Double-clicking a text layer switched to the text tool only in deep-select mode, so the inconsistency was resolved by removing that shortcut from deep select. Varve's select tool never enters text editing on double-click (text editing is entered through the text tool and TextEditOverlay), so shallow and deep select behave the same.
review.varveAssessment: Varve select-tool text entry already matches the resolved behaviour.

title: SVG`s imported incorrectly

review.reason: The aggregate SVG import report was split by the maintainer into clipPath being ignored (#4331) and fill-rule evenodd being ignored (#4332), and the reporter closed it in favour of those two. Its own context is that imported artwork did not match browser rendering.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's SVG importer handles both clip-path and fill-rule, as recorded in those two assessments.

title: Filtering based on types false negatives

review.reason: Type-filtered node search produces false negatives because only default input types are sent to the Svelte node catalogue, so filtering cannot see List<Vector> variants. Varve has no node catalogue or typed graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: SVG importer ignores `clipPath` applied to a group

review.reason: Varve's SVG importer resolves clip-path references, including on groups, builds a mask source node and applies it through the clipping-mask model; svg-clipmask.test.ts covers the clip cases. The reporter confirms a working fix exists upstream.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG import and clipping masks already cover this behaviour.

title: SVG importer ignores `fill-rule="evenodd"`

review.reason: Varve's SVG importer reads fill-rule from attributes and inline style and carries evenodd or nonzero onto the imported shape. Compound-path even-odd and clip-rule cases are covered by the SVG clipping-mask tests.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG import already honours fill-rule evenodd on imported paths.

title: Another svg not importing.

review.reason: The imported artwork lost its mask attribute, which the reporter traces to usvg group masks never being read. Varve's SVG importer resolves mask references, builds a mask source node and applies it with a mask type.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG import already applies mask attributes to imported groups and shapes.

title: Graphite reads clip_path but ignores usvg::Group::mask()

review.reason: Graphite read clip paths but never read resolved usvg group masks, so masked artwork imported unmasked. Varve's importer handles the mask attribute on elements and groups and attaches the mask source with a maskType of clip, alpha or luminance.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG mask import already covers the group-mask case.

title: Graphite clipping masks do not support SVG luminance masks ?

review.reason: Graphite treats every clipping mask as alpha-only, so an opaque black mask hole stays visible. Varve's mask model distinguishes clip, alpha and luminance masks, and the SVG importer maps mask-type through maskTypeFromElement, with luminance preserved.
review.varveAssessment: Varve masking already models alpha versus luminance, the distinction this issue asks for.

title: Seeing fill and stroke colors in layer preview thumb, but not on the artboard

review.reason: The blank artboard occurred only in the GPU render path on one Mac and Chrome configuration, while SVG mode rendered fills and strokes correctly. Varve defaults to Canvas2D and treats WebGPU and WebGL2 as opt-in experimental paths with Canvas2D fallback, so a driver-level failure does not leave an empty canvas by default.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's default Canvas2D renderer with opt-in GPU paths is the relevant area and is not exposed by default.

title: Context varargs can smuggle graph-runtime references past the borrow tree's lifetime discipline

review.reason: A Graphene lifetime-soundness report: the borrow tree launders lifetimes to static, with_vararg accepts laundered references, and Monitor contexts escape recompiles. Varve has no node graph execution engine or borrow tree.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no graph runtime.

title: Restructure and clean up the network interface

review.reason: A Graphite-internal refactor task to restructure and clean up the node network interface, filed with no body. Varve has no node network interface.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected.

title: Stylus/tablet click (ButtonPress) not registering in desktop (CEF) build when device uses absolute positioning — works in Relative mode, in browser, and with physical mouse

review.reason: Pen clicks from absolute-positioning tablets fail only in Graphite's CEF desktop shell, while the same tablet works in the browser, in relative mode and with a physical mouse. Varve's desktop app is Tauri with WebKitGTK, not CEF, so that input-routing layer does not exist.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve does not embed a CEF webview.

title: Canvas doesn't rerender on moving left by text field

review.reason: The grey band appeared because Graphite panned the canvas to reveal the caret without requesting a layout or redraw. Varve paints from camera and viewport state each frame and forces a full replay when no fresh frame is available, so a camera shift cannot leave stale blank pixels.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's render pipeline already guarantees a fresh frame after any camera or viewport change.

title: Brush tool breaks the document when using Photoshop-style blend modes (e.g. Linear Burn, Vivid Light, Divide)

review.reason: Graphite's brush panicked because BlendMode to_peniko hit todo for Photoshop-only modes the tool offered. Varve's BlendMode is a closed CSS blend vocabulary applied through the canvas composite operation, so the UI cannot select an unmapped mode; Graphite also closed this as legacy brush work.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's blend-mode vocabulary is closed to supported modes, so no unimplemented-mode crash path exists.

title: Resizing a text box by one edge handle incorrectly locks both Max Width and Max Height, silently clipping text

review.reason: Dragging a single text-box edge sets both max width and max height, freezing height and silently clipping rewrapped text; the code already carries a TODO to gate the two input pairs on the dragged edges. Varve text nodes carry auto-layout min, preferred and max sizing rather than text max-width and max-height constraints, so the specific defect has no direct analogue and one-axis resize behaviour is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Varve text resizing and text sizing constraints would be the affected area.

title: [Crash Report] Crash when using eyedropper on Friefox

review.reason: The eyedropper panicked on texture readback (Failed to download texture data) on Firefox WebGPU, and the follow-up console output points at Firefox WebGPU feature gaps such as rgba16float canvas textures. Varve has an eyedropper tool and an opt-in WebGPU compositor, and the packet gives no information about Varve's readback path.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's eyedropper colour sampling under its opt-in WebGPU path would be the affected area.

title: NaN point causes document not to deserialize

review.reason: A NaN in a segment handle field was saved as JSON null and the document then could not be deserialized, requiring manual JSON editing. Varve's canonical serializer rejects non-finite numbers, but whether the project-save path enforces the same check before writing is not established here.
review.varveAssessment: Varve document save and load validation would be the affected area.

title: DAffine2 handling with "transform" as the primary attribute

review.reason: A Graphene data-model design issue about treating the transform attribute as primary or secondary and using primary attribute names to choose w=0 or w=1 for vectors. Varve has no node graph or typed attribute system.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no typed node graph.

title: No longer possible to connect nodes

review.reason: Dragging wires between nodes stopped working in Graphite's node graph and was fixed the same day. Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Create all shapes from center

review.reason: The complaint was that grid, QR code, arrow and line generators anchor differently at the same transform; the maintainer kept the current behaviour for lines and arrows and closed it as likely not actionable. Varve shape tools all derive geometry from one normalized drag rectangle (BaseTool.computeDragRect, with Alt for from-centre), so per-shape origin conventions do not diverge.
review.varveAssessment: Varve shape creation already uses a single origin convention across tools.

title: Linkage across vertices when Shift-Deleting multiple vertices

review.reason: Shift-deleting several vertices left one vertex's position linked to another vertex's handle because path_modify applies point changes and then segment changes in separate phases. Varve stores each path point with its own handles, but multi-point delete plus handle editing is not covered by the packet for Varve.
review.varveAssessment: Varve node editing and multi-point deletion would be the affected area.

title: Stroke alignment on «Solidify Stroke»

review.reason: Solidify Stroke assumes centre alignment, so inside and outside strokes convert to the wrong outline geometry; a correct implementation must also handle intersecting beziers and multi-contour paths. Varve's Expand Stroke to Outline calls expandStroke with the stroke weight and cap but never the alignment, which is the same centre-only assumption.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's expandStrokeNode in packages/editor/src/geometry/vectorOps.ts produces incorrect outlines for inside and outside stroke alignment.

title: Create mobile version of UI

review.reason: The small-touchscreen UI request is marked a duplicate of #1545 by a maintainer. The reported context is that the current desktop-sized UI is hard to use on a small touchscreen without a mouse.
review.varveAssessment: Varve touch affordances are gated by reported touch capability; the canonical tracking issue is #1545.

title: Bug Report: Swapping Fill and Stroke color with Shift+X

review.reason: Shift+X swapping fill and stroke does not affect the selected object, and the packet contains no reproduction detail or maintainer diagnosis. Varve has fill and stroke editors but no Shift+X swap binding, so whether the gap is the capability or only the shortcut is unestablished.
review.varveAssessment: Varve fill and stroke editing and shortcut registration would be the affected area.

title: Isomtric /3D Extrusion & Rotation Engine

review.reason: The isometric and 3D extrusion feature request is marked a duplicate of #3325. The report describes Illustrator's extrusion rounding decimals, being limited to local coordinates, and wanting per-path offsets and bounded shading.
review.varveAssessment: Varve has no 3D extrusion engine; the canonical request is tracked in #3325.

title: Boolean Difference/Exclude operation got broken

review.reason: Graphite's difference and exclude regression came from its vector node code producing plausible points while the display path was wrong. Varve computes boolean results in @varve/scene through booleanOp, with subtract and exclude cases covered in boolean.test.ts and live boolean integration on top, and renders the resulting geometry directly.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's own boolean module is the analogous area and does not share Graphite's node display path.

title: SVG importer does not apply root viewBox scaling to stroke widths

review.reason: Graphite scaled viewBox geometry but not stroke widths, so equal visual thickness diverged. Varve applies root viewBox and viewport scaling as a transform on the imported nodes, so both geometry and stroke weights scale together.
review.varveAssessment: Varve SVG import already scales stroke widths with the root viewBox.

title: rectangle dimensions not syncing

review.reason: Graphite keeps rectangle width and height on the generator node while resizing writes a scale on a Transform node, so the property values never match the canvas. Varve has no node graph: resize handles and the Inspector both write the node's own geometry through resizeNodeGeometry, so the numbers and the drawn size are the same values.
review.varveAssessment: Varve rectangle geometry and resize handles already share one source of truth.

title: Hide Transform in properties

review.reason: The confusion comes from Graphite's properties panel listing transform as a disableable operation, so hiding Transform returns the object to (0,0) while position fields keep their values. Varve has no operation stack in the Inspector; transform is a node property and visibility is a separate layer flag.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve has no properties-as-operations panel.

title: Performance issue: >160 squares usability limit

review.reason: The slowdown came from Graphite's node-graph evaluation of each copied object, with the workaround being repeat nodes instead of pasted copies. Varve renders through IR replay with a subtree replay cache and is benchmarked at 10k nodes (canvas10k.bench.test.ts), so object count does not drive graph re-evaluation.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's IR replay and replay cache are the relevant performance path and avoid graph re-evaluation per object.

title: [Bug report] dragging corner handle on a rectangle scales rather than resize

review.reason: Corner-handle resize scales the rectangle instead of changing its width and height, and Keavon closes it as fixed by the same change discussed in #4544. The reproduction (500x500 rectangle, drag a corner, scale changes while W/H stay) is retained here.
review.varveAssessment: Same Varve geometry-versus-scale area as #4544, where resize writes the node's own width and height.

title: Radial gradient fill should have at least 2 stops for colors

review.reason: The reporter's radial gradient appeared to allow only one colour because they edited the fill swatch rather than a gradient stop, and they resolved it themselves. Varve's GradientEditor provides a stop bar with add, delete and position editing, so radial gradients take two or more stops.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's gradient editor already supports multi-stop radial gradients.

title: Add .avif support

review.reason: Varve's format capability registry declares AVIF as a raster format for import (native in browser and desktop) and export, with runtime decode failures reported instead of silently substituted.
review.varveAssessment: Varve already declares AVIF import and export support.

title: Close all documents dialogue overflows with many open documents

review.reason: The close-all dialog grew past the viewport so its OK button was unreachable. Varve's dialog styles cap height against the visual viewport (max-height: min(calc(var(--visual-viewport-height) - 2rem), ...)), so long content scrolls instead of pushing actions off-screen.
review.varveAssessment: Varve dialog viewport sizing already prevents this overflow.

title: Test SVG importing

review.reason: The ask is regression coverage for SVG import correctness, ideally comparing against reference renderers. Varve has dedicated importer suites (svg.test.ts, svg-clipmask.test.ts, svg-color.test.ts, svg-security.test.ts, svg-naming.test.ts and format-honesty tests), though they are unit-level rather than a resvg or WPT pixel corpus.
review.varveAssessment: Varve already has SVG import regression suites; a reference-renderer corpus would be an enhancement.

title: Desktop IME support

review.reason: Desktop IME support requires piping winit events into Graphite's CEF webview and back. Varve's desktop shell is Tauri with WebKitGTK, where IME is handled by the platform webview rather than custom event piping.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve has no CEF event bridge.

title: Gradient tool snapping with locked angle

review.reason: When an angle constraint is active, Graphite's gradient tool stops snapping to the rectangle and leaves stale overlays until the drag ends. Varve has snapping infrastructure and a gradient handle overlay, but the packet does not show whether an angle-locked gradient drag still snaps.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's gradient tool and snapping integration would be the affected area.

title: We hope to accelerate software development progress

review.reason: A request to port an unrelated Swift/macOS Photoshop-like project into Graphite; the maintainers explain Graphite's different rendering architecture and close it as not actionable. It proposes no change to a shared graphics capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve capability is implicated; this is a Graphite project-direction request.

title: Extending from point allows a handle to be colinear with 2 others

review.reason: Extending from an anchor that already has two segments makes the new handle collinear with two existing handles, so later dragging behaves strangely. Varve's pen and node editing has its own handle-mode logic, and the packet does not establish whether extending from a two-segment anchor shares the defect.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen-tool extension and handle-mode logic would be the affected area.

title: Transform cage incorrect when layer has zero width

review.reason: With scale X set to zero the transform cage is offset because the renderer falls back to identity on a singular transform while the select tool inverts a slightly perturbed one, applying translation twice. The packet gives no evidence about Varve's handling of singular layer transforms in its cage.
review.varveAssessment: Varve selection transform-cage maths at zero scale would be the affected area.

title: Virtual scrolling in the layer tree

review.reason: Graphite's Svelte layer tree created a DOM row per layer and took 8 seconds at 10k layers. Varve's LayersTree is already virtualized with tanstack react-virtual, using a density-based row estimate, overscan 10, spacer rows and aria-setsize for virtualized rows.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's layer tree is already virtualized, so row count does not drive DOM size.

title: Crash when hiding the only layer in an artboard

review.reason: The crash came from Graphite's graph compilation when an artboard ended up with no visible child layers, described as a regression from #4625. Varve's scene model treats empty frames and groups as valid nodes and replay draws the empty container without a compilation step requiring a child.
review.varveAssessment: Varve scene and replay already tolerate containers with no visible children.

title: Allow rotation of isometric grid

review.reason: The request is to rotate an entire isometric grid rather than only changing the angle between axes. Varve's isometric grid model carries an authored rotation in degrees about the origin plus custom axis sets, so a horizontal or arbitrarily offset lattice is representable.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's isometric grid already supports whole-grid rotation and custom axes.

title: [Info] Update on the PR backlog

review.reason: A project-process notice explaining that Graphite closes external PRs during its 1.0 crunch. It requests no product capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected.

title: Setting more `GradientRamp` properties in fill node properties

review.reason: The request is for fill properties to expose more gradient data instead of requiring graph nodes. Varve's gradient editor exposes type, stops and positions, interpolation space, hue interpolation direction and tiling mode, and on-canvas handles set the start and end transform.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's gradient editor already exposes the properties this issue asks for.

title: Node to set start and end point on gradient

review.reason: The need is a discoverable way to set a gradient's start and end points rather than composing a Transform node. Varve's gradient handles edit the linear and radial start, end and axes directly on canvas, with the canonical fill transform as the single source.
review.varveAssessment: Varve gradient handles already provide direct start and end point editing.

title: [Crash Report] Crash on hide layer.

review.reason: The crash when hiding a text layer with a node feeding its Text input was re-identified by the reporter as the same defect as #4631 (hiding the only layer in an artboard). The reproduction context is retained here.
review.varveAssessment: Same empty-container rendering area as #4631, which Varve's scene and replay already tolerate.

title: Save Configuration, Lable parts and holes, and Visual changes

review.reason: A broad proposal for saving sheet and lumber configurations, naming parts and holes, and highlighting geometry from fields, with no visualisations; the maintainer asked for more detail and closed it as not planned. Nothing concrete enough is given to map onto a Varve workflow.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's inspector and document-settings persistence could host such a workflow, but the proposal is too underspecified to assess.

title: Bad performance with jpg layer

review.reason: A single low-resolution JPG layer dropped Graphite to single-digit FPS unless an Upload Texture node was added; raster support is described as experimental and the proper fix as future work. Varve decodes images and replays them, but the packet gives no evidence about Varve's raster-layer frame cost.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's raster image rendering and texture caching would be the affected area.

title: Add mesh deform/transform

review.reason: Varve already implements mesh deformation with MeshWarp and MeshTriangle geometry, createFlatMesh and mesh warp modifiers, edited through MeshWarpOverlay handles. The request additionally mentions animation and vector coverage, which the packet does not establish for those specific cases.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's existing mesh warp engine already covers the core mesh deform workflow.

title: File with text nodes that are pinned made browser version panic

review.reason: The panic is a recursive NODE_METADATA mutex acquisition in Graphite's Rust inspector widget overrides, affecting Text and QR Code optional-float inputs. Varve's Inspector is React and TypeScript with no such global metadata lock.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; the defect is in Graphite's Rust inspector internals.

title: Bug Report/UX Issue: Merging prefers merged contents colours

review.reason: The merge node prefers the bottom input's fill and stroke colour, so recolouring through the canvas does not survive merging. Varve has no merge node; paint stays on each node and group or boolean results do not resolve competing input paints this way.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no merge node.

title: UX Issue: Merged content's nodes can be on top of other nodes

review.reason: Merged nodes overlapping other nodes in the Graphite node-graph view is a graph-layout UX issue. Varve has no node graph view.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no node graph.

title: Feature Request: Extend path down it's own direction

review.reason: The request is to extend a path along its own direction, illustrated for straight segments and for curved segments where the tangent should continue. Varve's pen and node tools can add anchors but have no command that extends a terminal segment along its tangent.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's pen and node-editing tools would need a path-extension command.

title: Bug Report: The pen tool can add node not on pointer location

review.reason: The pen tool sometimes places a node away from the pointer, more often on paths created by the pen tool, with the offset drifting toward the line centre. Varve's pen tool has its own snapping and coordinate path, and the packet gives no evidence whether it reproduces this.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen-tool pointer-to-anchor placement would be the affected area.

title: Bug Report: Path tool adding anchors is inconsistant

review.reason: Adding an anchor with the path tool sometimes needs two clicks and can arrive with bezier handles added. Varve's node-edit tool adds points through a different gesture pipeline, and the packet contains no reproduction for Varve.
review.varveAssessment: Varve NodeEditTool anchor insertion would be the affected area.

title: Bug Report: Occasionally when using the pen tool, it starts as if it has been dragged

review.reason: The pen tool occasionally begins a segment as if it had already been dragged, more often after a previous dragged curve. Varve's pen tool tracks its own handle state, and the packet gives no Varve evidence.
review.varveAssessment: Varve pen-tool handle-state initialisation would be the affected area.

title: `third-party-licenses` fails on Windows when the parent process is PowerShell

review.reason: cargo about refuses to write JSON to stdout when PowerShell is an ancestor process, which breaks Graphite's third-party-licenses build step and cargo run desktop. It is Graphite build tooling, not editor behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected; Varve has no cargo-about licence step.

title: Bug Report: Using blend/morph with a shape that has a boolean operation produces unexpected results

review.reason: Morphing a shape that carries a boolean operation produces unexpected interpolation because the boolean node's topology changes under the graph. Varve has no Graphite-style blend or morph layer between shapes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected; Varve has no blend layer over vector nodes.

title: Bug Report: Scaling a shape with boolean operation can be offset when screen moves

review.reason: Scaling a shape that has a boolean operation can be offset when the view moves, which the reporter suspects relates to pivot handling during scaling. The report is video-only, and Varve recomputes live boolean results from operand geometry without evidence about placement stability under scaling.
review.varveAssessment: Varve live boolean placement during scaling would be the affected area.

title: Bug Report: Moving shapes inside blend layer in layers panel messes with transform

review.reason: Reordering shapes inside a blend layer in the layers panel alters their transform, because the blend layer's node inputs carry the transforms. Varve has no blend layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path is affected because there is no blend layer.

title: Feature Request: Colour picker panel

review.reason: Varve already provides the requested colour workflow through ColorPicker (hex entry, colour modes, opacity), InspectorColorPopover with document and recent swatches, and the eyedropper tool. It is an inspector popover rather than a separate floating panel.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's colour picker already covers the requested capabilities.

title: Feature Request: Dedicated stroke panel

review.reason: Varve's Inspector has a dedicated StrokeSection with weight, alignment, cap, join, dash and paint controls, including multi-select mixed values and one-undo-step batching. It is a dedicated section rather than a combined fill and stroke control.
review.varveAssessment: Varve's stroke editing already has a dedicated inspector section.

title: UX Issue: Using any boolean operation should add a fill and stoke node after it

review.reason: The request is for fill and stroke *nodes* inserted after a Boolean node, which is a node-graph concept Varve does not have. Varve's live Boolean is a group whose operand children keep their own fills and strokes (editable via the Inspector Pathfinder section's Edit operands), and Expand Boolean materialises one editable compound path that carries its own fills and strokes, so a result's colour and stroke remain directly editable after the operation.
review.varveAssessment: Affects the Boolean/Pathfinder workflow (packages/scene/src/liveBoolean.ts, Inspector/sections/BooleanSection.tsx), where result styling is already owned by editable paint on real nodes rather than an upstream style node.

title: Self-hosting?

review.reason: This asks about self-hosting a hosted web editor; Varve is local-first desktop software and its browser target is a static demo build. apps/web was removed from the pnpm workspace and task 0.9 deferred indefinitely, so there is no served editor application, deployment pipeline, or self-hosting contract in Varve to document or support.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow is affected: there is no hosted web editor deployment whose self-hosting could be enabled or documented.

title: Redo Keyboard Shortcut Incorrectly Labeled?

review.reason: Graphite closed this as not-a-bug: the reporter's keyboard could not register Ctrl+Shift+Z simultaneously, and the same behaviour appeared in Inkscape. Varve derives every displayed shortcut label from the same binding that keyboard matching uses (getEffectiveBinding + formatShortcut in ShortcutManager, used by the menubar, tooltips and aria-keyshortcuts), so a label cannot drift from the combination that actually fires, and users can rebind.
review.varveAssessment: Would touch the shortcut registry and label formatting in packages/editor/src/shortcuts/ShortcutManager.ts, which already uses one binding as both the matcher and the label source.

title: Support clicking and dragging on a non-selected shape to select it

review.reason: Varve's SelectTool already resolves a press on a non-selected node into select-and-move within one gesture. The press is deferred, and when the drag threshold is crossed beginMoveGesture runs applyHitSelection before any geometry moves; only a sub-threshold press resolves as a plain click.
review.varveAssessment: Selection and move gestures in packages/editor/src/tools/SelectTool.ts already implement the single-interaction behaviour the issue requests.
